data.jd_text:
Looking for a Program Manager with 9–10 years of experience.
   

  

 Candidate should have strong end\-to\-end program/project management experience, from initiation and requirements gathering through delivery and closure.
   

  

 Must have experience managing multiple programs, along with strong skills in:
   

  

 Financial management
   

  

 Budget estimation and tracking
   

  

 Risk management and mitigation
   

  

 Stakeholder management
   

  

 Banking domain experience is mandatory, with Wealth Management, Personal Banking, or Business Banking experience preferred.
   

  

 This is a business\-facing IT Program Management role, requiring coordination between technology and business teams.
   

  

 PMP certification is preferred but not mandatory; relevant banking and program management experience is more important.
   

  

**Description**
 We are seeking an experienced and proactive Delivery Manager to lead and manage projects from initiation to completion. The ideal candidate will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and ensuring timely delivery of projects while managing stakeholders, risks, budgets, and resources effectively.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Plan, execute, and monitor project activities to ensure successful delivery within scope, timeline, and budget.
   

  

 Develop detailed project plans, schedules, and milestones.
   

  

 Coordinate with internal teams, vendors, consultants, and stakeholders.
   

  

 Track project progress and provide regular status updates to management.
   

  

 Identify project risks, issues, and dependencies and implement mitigation plans.
   

  

 Manage resource allocation and ensure efficient utilization.
   

  

 Conduct meetings, prepare MOMs (Minutes of Meeting), and follow up on action items.
   

  

 Ensure quality standards, compliance, and project governance are maintained.
   

  

 Handle stakeholder communication and manage expectations throughout the project lifecycle.
   

  

 Support procurement, budgeting, and reporting where required.
   

  

**Requirements \& Skills**
 Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business, Management, or related field.
   

  

 Proven experience as a Project Manager or similar role.
   

  

 Strong knowledge of project planning and tracking tools such as Microsoft Project, Excel, or equivalent.
   

  

 Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
   

  

 Strong problem\-solving and risk management abilities.
   

  

 Ability to manage multiple priorities and work under deadlines.
   

  

 PMP/PRINCE2 certification is an added advantage.
   

  

**Preferred Skills**
 Experience in project scheduling, budgeting, and reporting.
   

  

 Strong coordination and team management skills.
   

  

 Experience handling cross\-functional teams and external stakeholders.

**Position** 
 :
 **AVP, Head of Service, Operations \& Transformation (Gulf / GCC)**
**Job Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates (UAE hub supporting Qatar, Oman, Bahrain \& Kuwait)**
**The Role** 
 : The Head of Service \& Operations is responsible for end\-to\-end operational delivery across employee benefits and protection solutions, including implementation and onboarding, policy administration, billing, claims, collections and customer service. Products are expected to include, as applicable by market, Group Life, Medical, Dental, Personal Accident, Critical Illness and Group Savings/Benefits, including End\-of\-Service and gratuity\-related solutions. Based in the UAE as the primary operations hub, the role will oversee and support Qatar, Oman, Bahrain and Kuwait, ensuring consistent service delivery, effective controls and scalable processes across markets. The incumbent will enhance the customer experience, drive efficiency, leverage technology, build strong partner relationships and ensure product compliance with applicable UAE and local market regulations, as well as internal governance requirements. Working with other department heads, the incumbent will ensure the working environment, processes, guidelines and values are aligned with One MetLife and the Global Operations strategy. This role is a critical business partner in achieving financial goals, improving operating performance and maintaining a controlled environment that mitigates operational risk across policy issuance, servicing and claims processes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and implement an operations strategy that supports commercial commitments, financial objectives, regulatory compliance and scalable service delivery across the organisation.
* Execute on operational and customer service strategy to drive an improved end\-to\-end customer experience, drive operational efficiency and make it easier for customers to do business with us.
* Manage issuance, claims, services, and collections processes with the objective of meeting agreed service levels, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Establish operations guidelines to ensure the effective functioning of the provider/medical network and the appropriate parameters for claims adjudication, pricing tables, and associated cost controls.
* Define and manage recovery payments and collections strategy across business lines to protect earnings and improve cash\-flow discipline.
* Oversee the timely and accurate consolidation of operational financial information, particularly collections and claims data, to support reporting to authorities, home office requirements, regulatory compliance and effective decision making.
* Supervise compliance with internal policies and applicable regulatory requirements across the UAE and the supported markets (Qatar, Oman, Bahrain and Kuwait) to mitigate regulatory and conduct risks, including (as applicable) anti\-money laundering (AML), counter\-terrorist financing (CTF), sanctions screening, FATCA/CRS, and other local requirements. Define and manage preventive and corrective action plans associated with internal and external audits to ensure adherence to regional and global operational policies and local regulatory expectations.
* Lead continuous improvement and service process re\-engineering to improve operational effectiveness, customer outcomes, control standards and business\-line profitability.
* Responsible for strategic technological improvements/implementation to streamline processes from the UAE hub and standardize service delivery across Qatar, Oman, Bahrain and Kuwait.
* Lead the Digital Transformation and PMO agenda for the Gulf/GCC operations function, including prioritisation and governance of transformation initiatives, delivery tracking, benefits realisation, process automation, change management, and alignment with regional and global technology roadmaps.
* Create an effective and efficient work environment across all locations that will engage and enable associates to improve the customer experience.
* Attract, retain and motivate high\-performing talent across the operations function.
* Set goals, monitor performance and evaluate results to ensure departmental and organisational objectives are met and aligned with business priorities.
* Develop differentiated operational capabilities and services by leveraging technology, people and shared best practices.
* Embed a Lean mindset across operations to reduce risk, remove waste and strengthen continuous improvement.
* Support the agency strategy by shaping the operating model, resourcing requirements and operational processes needed to serve this channel effectively.
* Ability to travel across the GCC as required (estimated 10–20%).


**Key Relationships**
* Reports to: Regional Head of Operations
* Direct reports/team: 7 direct reports: Claims Lead; Billing \& Reconciliation Lead; Underwriting/Policy Administration Lead; Customer Service Manager; Group Savings/Benefits (End\-of\-Service) Operations Manager; Dental/Provider Network Lead; Digital Transformation and PMO Lead.
* Key Stakeholders: UAE business heads and Functional VP’s/Directors; country leads/points of contact in Qatar, Oman, Bahrain and Kuwait; local regulators and external advisors; clients, brokers and key partners


**Candidate Qualifications**
**Essential Business Experience and Technical Skills:**
* 10\+ years’ experience managing large teams within the insurance industry, with strong strategic judgement and commercial acumen.
* Demonstrated leadership experience across a large, multi\-site insurance service or operations organisation.
* Deep understanding of key business and operational metrics, including integrated analytics and strong business and technology acumen to support data\-driven transformation decisions.
* Significant change agent and innovator, with the ability to drive meaningful operational transformation while balancing effectiveness, efficiency, customer experience and control.
* Insurance product experience across Group and Retail lines.
* Strong understanding of the regulatory and legislative environment and its impact on insurance products and operations.
* Strong influence, negotiation and conflict resolution skills
* Proven ability to work effectively in a matrixed environment.
* Excellent analytical, decision\-making and problem\-solving skills.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and strong project management skills, including PMO governance, milestone tracking, dependency management and escalation of delivery risks.
* Strong understanding of market needs that influence excellent customer service, with the ability to adapt MetLife’s operational delivery to create customer value.
* Ability to identify and create opportunities where processes and technology can converge to improve productivity, service quality, automation and scalability.
* Digital transformation leadership, including automation, workflow redesign and adoption of scalable technology solutions.
* Strong PMO discipline with the ability to govern complex initiatives, manage dependencies and translate strategy into measurable delivery outcomes.
* Data\-led operational management, using analytics and performance metrics to identify opportunities, monitor benefits and improve decision making.
* Change management and stakeholder engagement skills to embed new ways of working across multi\-market operations.
* Strong compliance, risk management and audit orientation.
* Ability to partner effectively with senior executives across distribution, operations, product, finance, Human Resources and other enabling functions.
* Ability to attract, coach, mentor and develop talent.
* Fluent in English required. Arabic preferred; additional languages relevant to the Gulf market are an advantage.


**Leadership Competencies**
* Thinks Strategically – Sets direction aligned to the company’s strategy, applying external and global perspective to meet local and global needs.
* Motivates People – Gains people commitment to achieve business objectives through clear communication of the company’s vision and flexing leadership styles to inspire high performance.
* Seizes Opportunity – Seeks new opportunities and ways to create balanced business growth while improving operational capabilities.
* Models our Values – Creates a culture that promotes the company’s values and standards through role modeling, accountability and ownership of decisions.
* Focuses on Customers – Promotes customer centricity and ensures focus on creating great customer experiences to achieve competitive advantage.
* Drives Results – Sets aggressive goals and is accountable for continuously driving improved performance, leading change and ensuring high standards.


**MetLife**
 MetLife, through its subsidiaries and affiliates, is one of the world’s leading financial services companies, providing insurance, annuities, employee benefits and asset management to help its individual and institutional customers navigate their changing world. Founded in 1868, MetLife has operations in more than 40 countries and holds leading market positions in the United States, Japan, Latin America, Asia, Europe and the Middle East.
   

  

 We are one of the largest institutional investors in the U.S. with more than $588\.7 billion in total assets under management as of December 31, 2018\. We are ranked \#43 on the Fortune 500 list for 2018\. In 2018, we were named to the Dow Jones Sustainability Index (DJSI) for the third year in a row. DJSI is a global index to track the leading sustainability\-driven companies.

data.jd_text:
**Department:** 
 MENA
   

  

**Team:** 
 Policy – MENA region
   

  

**Location:** 
 Dubai with homework flexibility
   

  

**Position type:** 
 12 month contract with view to renew; full\-time
   

  

**What The Hiring Manager Says**
*“The GSMA’s MENA team is expanding and we have an exciting opportunity for a high\-performing Policy Director to work with the MENA team to engage all stakeholders with GSMA programs and policy \& technology orientated activities. The role entails a lot of travel, ability to work under pressure and a deep technical and policy background”.*
 Head of MENA
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a creative and energetic Director to lead GSMA programmes in the Middle East and North Africa. The Director will be responsible for advancing GSMA’s objectives in the MENA region. This will involve leading engagements on policy and regulations as well as being the technical expert and reference point for broader GSMA activities both within the organisation and in relations with our members. You will need to demonstrate clear understanding of mobile industry comfortable communicating this at a range of levels of detail. You will also be required to attend some GSMA working groups when needed, to provide descriptions of general industry topics and specific GSMA projects. You may be required to attend meetings of other industry forums.
   

  

 You will have a good understanding of existing and future mobile technology and be able to demonstrate knowledge of the future industry trends and their likely impacts on mobile network evolution and development. You will be able to articulate potential industry positions in areas of confluence of Mobile with other verticals, including, but not limited to, banking and finance, healthcare, education, and other service industries where mobile technology plays a critical role in shifting paradigms for solution delivery.
   

  

 You will also be able to demonstrate the ability to understand the commercial implications of technical decisions and vice versa.
   

  

 You will also engage all stakeholders with GSMA Technology programmes and technology orientated activities (MC, IoT, RCS, 5G, IMEI, Mobile Money, etc.).
   

  

 The Policy Director reports to the Head of MENA. This role works very closely with the rest of the small MENA team.
   

  

**You Will**
* Lead industry engagement and projects on spectrum and policy matters as well as broader GSMA activities in region.
* Manage Working Group and Regional Interest Group activity in region.
* Engage with member leadership in region.
* Responsible for input towards regional business planning.
* Manage programme delivery in region against HQ KPIs and member expectations.
* Responsible for delivering within the annual regional budget allocation.
* Responsible for regional reporting in accordance with HQ requirements, presenting progress against regional KPIs and defining corrective action where appropriate.
* Foster the necessary consultation, communications and good relations within the wider organisation, including staff of member organisations.
* Line and performance management of regional team.
* Ability to work cooperatively and flexibly with stakeholders and facilitate a collaborative approach.
* Acts as a role model in demonstrating commitment to GSMA values and internal processes.
* Ensure compliance by team with all GSMA polices, processes and procedures.


**About You**
* Relevant experience working in the telecoms industry is essential. Ideally with an operator or vendor.
* Strong technical plus commercial understanding background.
* Capable of delivering presentations to a technical audience on these services.
* You will be fluent in English. Arabic and/or French would be an advantage.
* A proven track record of proposition development and the ability to influence and add value to your area of business.
* Strong writing skills, messaging, leadership positioning and narrative development.
* Experience working in an international environment, ideally in the MENA/SSA region.
* Advanced knowledge of MS Office (Excel, Word and PowerPoint).
* Experience of working with multiple internal stakeholders and with geographically dispersed teams in a matrix structure.
* Willingness to travel, as and when required by the role.


**About Your Skills**
* Communication
* Delivery
* Project Management
* Teamwork
* Analysis


**Contract type**
 Department Contractor
   

  

**Worker type**
 Contingent Worker
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Working at the GSMA offers you unparalleled access to the mobile industry. We offer a chance to truly shape the direction of mobile, whatever your role. By joining the GSMA, you will be exposed to a fast\-paced rapidly evolving environment, working on global solutions, genuinely fascinating and industry\-changing projects and a stimulating and dynamic environment designed to enable you to flourish.
   

  

 In addition to architect\-designed offices and competitive compensation, our benefits include fantastic learning \& development opportunities, generous holiday allowances, four additional days off for professional development and many others.
   

  

 To learn more about the GSMA, visit our career site, our LinkedIn page and our Twitter page.
   

  

 Being You at the GSMA
   

  

 We care deeply about diversity, equity and inclusivity and aspire to be the best at it. Your well\-being and work/life balance is important, so flexi\-time and remote working is available to all staff. We're keen to ensure everyone is equal, represented and connected so we particularly encourage applications from all demographics. The sucess of the GSMA year on year will continue to be contributed by people from all walks of life.
   

  

**GSMA Values**
 Our values not only drive our culture – they shape how we work and interact inside and outside our global organisation.
   

  

**Passionately driven**
 We approach everything we do with unparalleled capability, tenacity and commitment, knowing that the challenging scale, pace and complexity of our work is what leads to its world\-changing impact.
   

  

**Insightful leaders**
 We continually develop and engage our expertise, insight and creativity so that we’re always ready to respond to the changing landscape with authority, agility and nuance.
   

  

**Stronger together**
 We lean on each other so the industry can lean on us, embracing our diversity by actively seeking out perspectives and skill sets beyond our own, fuelling each other’s successes and constantly asking how we can help.
   

  

 Underpinning our values is our collective mindset to show up purposefully as good human beings every day, in every situation. When we’re at our best – we are collaborative, considerate and compassionate to others, and we create a safe space for one another to thrive, assuming positive intent in our colleagues. And if we aren’t at our best and the pressure is on – we feel free to be ourselves but still remain curious, lean into the tough stuff and we are always respectful to others and accountable for the part we play.

 We design, build, manage and maintain infrastructure for the energy industries. Our comprehensive and tailored service offering covers each stage of the project life cycle and a variety of commercial models, giving our clients the flexibility, they need.
   

  

**Primary Duties**
 Develop systems and procedures for Project control functions on the onset of the project and as and when there are additional requirements from the client in order to facilitate the process of project monitoring.
   

  

 S To determine the staffing requirements based on the workload and allotment of available resources to various phases of the project.
   

  

 S Provide leadership and guidance to the project planning team to develop, implement \& maintain the project controls procedure, project schedules (level 1\-4\), and reporting systems specific to project.
   

  

 S Prepare the progress measurement system such as manpower histograms, which indicate the number of people required each month, progress S curves which will indicate the progress that the project makes at a given point of time etc., which are reviewed at periodic intervals.
   

  

 S Monitoring progress of the work for timely execution of the project through weekly/monthly reports with respect to review of the overall project. Progress monitoring on a regular basis and resolve any problems, bottlenecks/scheduling conflicts.
   

  

 S Co\-ordinate internal project team reviews followed by an approval and review by the client of the work schedule, progress measurement and reporting systems.
   

  

 S Review the status continuously and keep the Project director/ Manager apprised of the progress and the areas needing attention for schedule adherence.
   

  

 S Ensure that field project controls documents such as construction schedules, resources histogram, reporting systems, commodity data base, material controls systems, etc. are fully developed \& implemented by the designated personnel and reviewed by Construction Management and that engineering \& procurement activities are properly interfaced.
   

  

 S Carry out diagnostic studies on ongoing project/ construction, to measure what is achieved vis\-à\-vis the plan by the project control team based on progress reports and feedback to ensure timely completion and formulate an action plan for schedule adherence.

 S Perform any other duties and responsibilities as and when directed by the HOD.

 Graduate engineer with approximately 20 years of experience in the oil and gas industry conversant with projects and execution. Experience in HO \& Site planning.

 Our Colleagues are at the heart of who we are and what we do. With an international team of over 10,000 Colleagues and strong strategic growth on the horizon, we offer unrivalled career opportunities around the world. We are committed to provide our Colleagues at all levels with opportunities to grow and develop within the organisation through personalised development plans and tailored succession planning. We invest in our communities to sustain the environment where we operate and minimising our own footprint. Whether it is through animal conservation, education or tree\-planting, we like to give back in as many ways as we can to help our communities flourish.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Reporting to the Chief Digital \& Information Officer, theVP Applications \& IT PMO is responsible for the strategy, delivery, and governance of Kerzner's enterprise and hospitality application landscape and for leading the IT Project Management Office. The role oversees the full lifecycle of core business and guest\-facing systems, including PMS (Oracle Opera), F\&B (Sevenrooms), Spa \& Gym (Zenoti), HR (SuccessFactors), Finance \& Procurement (TBD), Salesforce, and Commercial \& Distribution (Opera Cloud Distribution, SynXis), ensuring they are modern, integrated, secure, and aligned with brand and business objectives. The VP partners with Brand Presidents, Global Heads of HR, Finance, Procurement and Commercial, Resort GMs, Resort IT Directors/Managers, and external vendors to translate business priorities into scalable, well\-governed technology solutions that drive operational excellence, guest\-experience innovation, and long\-term enterprise value.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Application Strategy \& Architecture
   

  

* Define and execute Kerzner's application strategy aligned with business and guest\-experience goals.
* Lead the architecture, integration, and governance of Kerzner's application landscape, establishing brand\-level standards and a target\-state architecture that balances innovation, scalability, and security.
* Own the application technology roadmap across hospitality systems (PMS, POS, F\&B, Spa, Guest Engagement), business systems (Finance, Procurement, HR), CRM (Salesforce), and commercial distribution (Opera Cloud Distribution, SynXis), ensuring systems remain current, fit\-for\-purpose, and fully integrated.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, platforms, and vendors to continuously modernise the application portfolio and unlock new business capabilities.


 IT PMO \& Project Governance
   

  

* Establish and lead the IT Project Management Office, defining standards, frameworks, and delivery methodologies for consistent, on\-time, on\-budget execution of technology initiatives.
* Oversee complex, multi\-region application implementations, upgrades, and integrations, ensuring clear scope, disciplined delivery, and transparent stakeholder communication.
* Maintain a consolidated project portfolio view, enabling data\-driven prioritisation and resource allocation across all Digital \& IT workstreams.


 Operational Excellence \& Integration
   

  

* Ensure all enterprise and hospitality applications are reliable, performant, and tightly integrated through API\-based architecture.
* Drive adoption of AI\-enabled capabilities and automation within core application platforms to improve operational efficiency and decision\-making.
* Partner with the Data \& AI function to ensure applications feed clean, timely data into the enterprise data platform, enabling analytics, personalisation, and a unified guest profile.


 Vendor, Partner \& Ecosystem Management
   

  

* Manage strategic vendor and partner relationships across the application portfolio, monitoring performance against SLAs and identifying opportunities for consolidation, cost optimisation, and innovation.
* Lead vendor selection, contract negotiation, and procurement processes for new application platforms in close collaboration with Procurement and Cybersecurity.


 Development, Pre\-Opening \& Expansion
   

  

* Act as the application technology advisor for new resort developments, renovations, and pre\-openings, ensuring system architectures are designed and deployed on time and aligned to brand requirements.
* Define and maintain brand\-standard application specifications for each Kerzner brand (Atlantis, One\&Only, SIRO, Rare Finds).


 People \& Organisational Leadership
   

  

* Build, lead, and mentor a high\-performing applications and PMO team through coaching, talent development, succession planning, and a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Foster strong cross\-functional relationships with resort IT teams, business stakeholders, and global shared\-service functions to ensure seamless application adoption and support.


 Risk, Security \& Compliance
   

  

* Collaborate closely with Cybersecurity to ensure applications meet security, data privacy, and regulatory compliance standards across all jurisdictions.
* Embed technology resilience, disaster recovery, and risk management into application design, vendor selection, and architecture decisions.


**Skills, Experience \& Educational Requirements**
* Bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 12\+ years of progressive experience in enterprise applications management, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.
* Deep knowledge of hospitality technology ecosystems, including PMS (Oracle Opera / Opera Cloud), POS, F\&B, Spa, CRM (Salesforce), and distribution systems (SynXis, OXI/OHIP).
* Proven experience with ERP and business applications (Finance, Procurement, HR/SuccessFactors).
* Strong understanding of integration platforms and middleware (e.g., MuleSoft) and API\-based architectures.
* 10\+ years of IT project / programme management experience, including large\-scale, cross\-functional implementations and PMO leadership.
* Demonstrated ability to align application strategy with business outcomes, including growth, efficiency, and guest experience.
* Strong financial acumen with experience in CAPEX/OPEX planning, budgeting, and vendor contract management.
* Proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and persuasively to executive and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience leading and developing diverse, high\-performing global teams.
* Collaborative leadership style with the ability to drive cross\-functional alignment across corporate and resort operations.
* Hospitality industry experience is strongly preferred; luxury hospitality experience is an advantage.
* Certifications in project management (PMP, PRINCE2\) or ITIL are an advantage.
* Willingness and ability to travel internationally.


 Our company is expanding faster than ever before. We are investing in the growth of our company, and that means we are committed to investing in you. Join a team that is open\-hearted, innovative, inclusive, and inspiring in spirit. We believe in making our guests happy beyond anything they have ever imagined. We wow them at every turn and create memories that will last a lifetime. You will be at the heart of this vision, to constantly innovate to deliver Amazing Experiences and Everlasting Memories.

**Role Overview/Purpose**
 The Lead – Business Operations, Global Oncology will play a critical role in driving launch excellence and early access strategies across small to mid\-sized markets where Glenmark Oncology does not have dedicated in\-country oncology leadership.
   

  

 This role will act as a strategic and operational partner to the Head of Global Commercial Oncology, ensuring organizational readiness, optimal resource allocation, and execution of commercial infrastructure (including CRM and analytics). The incumbent will also serve as support to the Global Head in governance, decision\-making, and cross\-functional alignment.
   

  

**Overall Job Responsibilities**
* Launch Excellence \& Early Access Strategy
* Lead the development and execution of launch strategies for oncology assets in small\-to\-mid\-sized markets.
* Design scalable, repeatable “go\-to\-market” models tailored for distributor\-led or hybrid markets.
* Drive early access strategies including:
* Named Patient Programs (NPPs)
* Compassionate use programs
* Managed access agreements
* Collaborate with Medical, Market Access, Regulatory, and Supply teams to ensure timely market entry.
* Develop launch readiness frameworks, KPIs, and tracking mechanisms.
* Market Development (Non\-Core / White Space Markets)
* Identify, prioritize, and assess new market opportunities where Glenmark lacks oncology presence.
* Build market entry playbooks (partner vs. direct vs. hybrid models).
* Support distributor selection, onboarding, and performance management.
* Ensure alignment of local execution with global brand strategy.
* Commercial Operations \& Infrastructure
* Lead implementation and optimization of CRM systems (e.g., Veeva, Salesforce Health Cloud).
* Establish standardized commercial processes, reporting dashboards, and performance tracking.
* Drive data\-driven decision\-making through analytics and insights generation.
* Oversee commercial excellence initiatives including:
* Sales force effectiveness (where applicable)
* Omnichannel engagement frameworks
* Digital enablement tools
* Organizational Readiness \& Capability Building
* Partner with the Head of Global Commercial Oncology to ensure readiness for upcoming launches.
* Define target operating models for new markets.
* Support hiring strategy, role design, and capability frameworks (especially for distributor markets).
* Develop training frameworks and onboarding programs for new teams/partners.
* Resource Allocation \& Financial Planning
* Lead commercial budgeting and resource allocation across emerging markets.
* Optimize deployment of financial and human resources based on market potential and strategic priority.
* Track ROI on launch investments and commercial initiatives.
* Support long\-range planning (LRP) and annual operating plans (AOP).
* Strategic Planning \& Governance
* Act as a strategic advisor and deputy to the Head of Global Commercial Oncology.
* Support development of global oncology commercial strategy.
* Lead cross\-functional governance forums and business reviews.
* Drive alignment across global, regional, and local stakeholders.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership
* Serve as a central coordination point across: Medical Affairs, Market Access, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Finance
* Ensure integrated execution of launch and commercialization plans.
* Competitive Intelligence \& Market Insights
* Monitor competitive landscape across oncology markets.
* Benchmark best practices from leading oncology players (MNCs).
* Translate insights into actionable strategies for Glenmark.
* Compliance \& Risk Management
* Ensure all commercial activities adhere to global compliance standards and local regulations.
* Identify and mitigate risks related to distributor\-led markets and early access programs.
* Key Deliverables / Success Metrics
* Successful launch of oncology assets in priority emerging markets.
* Time\-to\-market reduction in non\-core geographies.
* CRM implementation effectiveness and adoption rates.
* Achievement of early access program targets.
* Budget adherence and ROI optimization.
* Distributor performance and market expansion outcomes.


**Key Relationships/Stakeholders**
**External**
* Oncology KOLs and treatment centers
* Oncology societies and networks
* Strategic partners and service providers


**Internal (other Than Direct Reports)**
* Regional/Country Commercial Leadership Teams
* Global Oncology Franchise \& Brand Teams
* Country Medical Affairs, Market Access, Regulatory, Finance, and Supply Chain


**Desired Experience And Knowledge**
**Educational**
* MBA or master’s degree in business, Life Sciences, or related field preferred


**Experience**
* 12–15\+ years of pharmaceutical / biotech experience, with a strong focus on innovative oncology.
* Proven track record in global or regional commercial roles
* Experience in launch excellence, emerging markets, or distributor\-led markets.
* Experience operating in complex, fast\-evolving oncology markets.
* Prior country\-level or franchise leadership experience is strongly preferred.


**Knowledge And Skills (Functional And Technical)**
* Strong understanding of oncology market access and early access pathways.
* Experience with CRM systems (e.g., Veeva, Salesforce).
* Ability to work in cross functional groups and teams with a complex matrix organization.
* Ability to operate in ambiguity and build new market structures
* Exceptional stakeholder management, influence, and communication skills.
* Data\-driven decision\-making
* Entrepreneurial mindset with strong ownership
* High ethical standards with uncompromising compliance orientation.

 Principal Package Management Specialist utilizes their technical acumen, commercial acumen, management skills, and leadership skills to oversee all aspects of delivering a package from the cradle to the grave. Their core responsibility is ensuring the package is delivered on budget and on schedule while abiding by Quality, Health, Safety, Environment, and Security (QHSES) and project requirements. A successful Principal Package Management Specialist identifies risks and opportunities sets up mitigation and captures plans accordingly. This entails developing a strategic outlook for the package and ensuring that all matters are resolved with the involvement of the right stakeholders and in a timely fashion. Principal Package Management Specialist must report status and outlook at an executive level to the Project Management team and, at times, Corporate Management.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Key Tasks and Responsibilities:**
* Deliver a package (purchase orders and/or subcontracts) on budget and schedule, and abide by QHSES and project requirements; Complexity, criticality, and value of packages typically vary and are assigned and adjusted at the discretion of the function and project
* Maintain a clear and thorough dialogue with the Project Management Team, and provide accurate and periodic status updates as well as both short and long\-term outlooks
* Identify risks and opportunities, and maintain a strategic outlook throughout the execution of the package; Such discussion is to be held periodically with the Project Management team for buy\-in
* Maintain an accurate account of the package cost, commitments, changes, and forecast
* Provide inputs and ensure alignment with Project Controls on current and forecasted cost and schedule.
* Maintain an accurate account of the package cost, commitments, changes, and forecast
* ROS dates to be analyzed with the schedulers to identify priorities and, if applicable, Installation Work Packages and Advance Work Packages to be set up and implemented
* Track cost and schedule bid basis against actuals
* Interface with all stakeholders to achieve package goals; Stakeholders include but are not limited to the Supplier/Subcontractor, Engineering, Supply Chain, QHSES, Construction, Installation (if applicable), Commissioning, Joint Venture Partners, and, as needed, the client
* Arrange and attend periodic status meetings with suppliers and clients as required
* Manage formal correspondence with suppliers, clients, and other involved parties
* Attend key meetings such as the progress meeting, kick\-off meeting, PIM, and others
* Oversee and enforce all day\-to\-day applicable processes involved and interface across various functions to identify and resolve any technical or commercial matters, and if unavoidable, then resolve any bottlenecks
* Enforce the Management of Change process and Project Change Notices
* Oversee the documentation process and manage priorities to ensure the most effective delivery from a cost and schedule aspect; This conversation must be coordinated between the suppliers, McDermott, and the client as applicable
* Review key documents such as Technical Bid Evaluations, Commercial Bid Evaluations, Purchase Orders, and supplier data
* Work with the end user to ensure alignment and expectations are met
* Ensure that the prime contract flow downs are correctly administered, including variations
* Oversee the planning, performance, and resource allocation of their team throughout the project
* Could potentially report to the Package Manager or Senior Package Manager on a project
* Develop and maintain contingency planning and lessons learned


**Qualifications**
**Essential Qualifications and Education:**
* Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) in Engineering or Supply Chain Management (or a relevant discipline).
* 8\-12 years of relevant experience (ideally in Engineering, Project/Package Management, Manufacturing, or similar)
* Technical knowledge of all phases of an Engineering, Procurement, Construction, and Installation (EPCI) project and specific knowledge in the domain of the proposed packages is preferred
* Commercial knowledge of contracts, purchase orders, and relevant disciplines within the Supply Chain function, such as proposals, purchasing, expediting, logistics, and material management
* Strong understanding and adherence to QHSES requirements and ability to ensure compliance
* Understands the requisitioning process from the bid stage through clarifications until Purchase Order award and post\-award activities such as execution, receiving, and at time commissioning
* Proactive attitude in determining opportunities and risks, particularly those attributed to Quality, Safety, Budget, and Schedule
* Characteristics of a leader that naturally relates to all members of the team, from the floor to the project team and executive management
* Effective communicator with strong written, verbal, and public speaking skills
* Willing to travel to various locations such as the shops, supplier offices and headquarters, job sites, labs, and other relevant locations as needed; At times, there may be a requirement for an extended deployment at a supplier’s location or the job site
* PMP and/or PE is a plus


**About Us**
 Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.
   

  

 For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.

**Description**
 Amazon is seeking an experienced Program Manager to help scale our operations network through the launch of new facilities and expansion initiatives across the UAE. This role offers the opportunity to lead complex, high\-visibility programs that directly impact customer experience, business growth, and operational excellence.
   

  

 As a Program Manager, you will own end\-to\-end delivery of expansion projects from site selection and design through construction, launch readiness, and operational handover. You will work across multiple stakeholder groups including operations, engineering, finance, procurement, real estate, technology, and external partners to deliver new facilities safely, on time, and within budget.
   

  

 This role requires strong program management skills, the ability to navigate ambiguity, influence stakeholders across different functions, and drive execution in a fast\-paced environment where priorities evolve quickly.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of network expansion and launch programs, ensuring projects are completed safely, on schedule, and within budget.
* Develop project plans, launch schedules, governance mechanisms, and risk mitigation strategies across multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Partner with operations, engineering, finance, procurement, technology, and real estate teams to define requirements and ensure successful project execution.
* Manage external vendors, consultants, contractors, and service providers throughout the project lifecycle.
* Track project performance through data, metrics, and reporting mechanisms, identifying risks and driving corrective actions when required.
* Own stakeholder communication, providing clear updates on milestones, dependencies, financial performance, risks, and launch readiness.
* Drive process standardization and continuous improvement initiatives to improve launch speed, reduce cost, and increase scalability across markets.
* Support business planning activities including capital planning, budget forecasting, resource planning, and long\-term network expansion strategies.
* Conduct site visits and audits to validate project progress, operational readiness, quality standards, and compliance requirements.
* Build scalable tools, mechanisms, and operating models that enable efficient execution of future expansion programs.


 A day in the life
   

  

 As a Program Manager, your primary focus will be delivering expansion and launch projects that help Amazon grow its operational footprint across the UAE.
   

  

 A typical day may include reviewing project milestones, coordinating with stakeholders, resolving execution risks, and tracking launch readiness activities. You will work closely with operations, engineering, finance, procurement, and external partners to keep projects on schedule and within budget.
   

  

 You will regularly analyze performance metrics, drive process improvements, and communicate progress, risks, and key decisions to senior leaders. Success in this role comes from balancing strategic thinking with hands\-on execution and delivering results.
   

  

**About The Team**
 In the Amazon Now team, you will be part of a high\-velocity, high\-visibility group responsible for launching programs that unlock new growth and capabilities for Amazon globally. You’ll have the opportunity to build new processes, shape how we scale, and make a measurable difference. Working from UAE, you will collaborate with global teams, drive significant impact, and help elevate Amazon’s capabilities in a market of strategic importance.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* Bachelor's degree in BI, finance, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics, finance or equivalent quantitative field
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* 3\+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
* Experience in project management including resource planning, managing schedules, reporting project status and prioritizing own tasks and those of other team members for multiple projects


**Preferred Qualifications**
* PMP certificate
* Experience communicating results to senior leadership


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 The Vice President, Operations \& Systems, is responsible for defining and executing the P\&T operational systems vision, architecture, and roadmap for all operational systems across the P\&T Pillar. This executive role ensures that operational technology platforms, software applications, integrations, and digital solutions align with business objectives, operational excellence goals, and long\-term growth strategies.
   

  

 The VP leads the development of system strategies, functional and technical specifications, roadmaps, and implementation plans while working closely with business leaders, operations teams, technology teams, vendors, and executive leadership. The role is accountable for maximizing business value through technology innovation, standardization, automation, and scalable digital solutions.
   

  

* Develop and maintain the P\&T strategy for operational systems and software platforms.
* Define the long\-term vision, target architecture, and digital transformation roadmap for operational technologies.
* Align technology initiatives with corporate strategy, operational objectives, customer requirements, and industry trends.
* Act as the executive sponsor for major operational technology and software transformation programs.
* Provide thought leadership on emerging technologies, automation, AI, analytics, IoT, and digital operations.
* Establish governance frameworks for operational systems, software selection, architecture standards, and lifecycle management.
* Ensure consistency, scalability, interoperability, and standardization across operational platforms.
* Define system ownership models, decision\-making processes, and performance measurement frameworks.
* Provide guidance to Business Units, Regional offices and HO with regards to all in\-house P\&T Systems (Zodiac, CCS, Rostering, Oracle, Maximo, Smart Solutions, Business Analytics) and other related technology across Ports and Terminals.
* Implement guidelines, processes, procedures for Terminal Operating Systems smart applications, system utilisation and fine tuning, quality and productivity, over the entire portfolio of terminals.
* Promote collaboration and best practice sharing amongst Business units, setting up TOS user groups and form a centralized TOS knowledge base for system implementation, testing and system migration. Assist the Business Units in selecting and implementing the right systems and related periphery technologies.
* Ensure accurate data collection from each P\&T business across the DP World Portfolio.
* Oversee successful integration globally of all in\-house P\&T Systems.
* Ultimately responsible for successful and customer service issue free go\-live of P\&T systems.Managing and ensuring fluid movement between ideation and project delivery stage, delivering a committed portfolio of Innovation projects and programs that add value.
* Deliver solutions to DP World Group challenges in all disciplines.


**Key Accountabilities**
* Develop and maintain multi\-year operational systems roadmaps aligned with strategic business priorities, capability gaps, modernization opportunities, and future technology requirements.
* Prioritize initiatives based on business value, risk reduction, operational efficiency, and return on investment, while monitoring technology trends and recommending strategic investments.
* Define and oversee implementation strategies for new systems, upgrades, integrations, and digital transformation initiatives, ensuring successful program execution and a smooth transition into operational support and continuous improvement.
* Lead organizational change, stakeholder engagement, training, adoption, and user readiness strategies to support successful implementation and sustained value realization.
* Establish enterprise architecture principles and technology standards for operational systems, including cloud, hybrid, and on\-premises solutions where appropriate.
* Ensure seamless integration between operational systems, ERP platforms, customer\-facing applications, data platforms, and third\-party solutions, promoting data consistency, interoperability, scalability, and real\-time information sharing.
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand operational needs and translate them into business cases, functional specifications, technical requirements, and solution designs.
* Ensure operational systems and solution designs support current and future business processes while meeting security, compliance, reliability, performance, and design integrity requirements.
* Lead evaluation, selection, and management of software vendors and technology partners for Ports \& Terminals, including negotiation of strategic agreements, monitoring of performance and innovation roadmaps, and management of contractual obligations.
* Govern the commercial and contractual relationship between business units and internal/external system providers.
* Ensure operational systems comply with cybersecurity, regulatory, privacy, and industry standards, and identify, assess, and mitigate technology\-related operational risks.
* Establish business continuity and disaster recovery strategies for critical operational systems.
* Standardize processes and align key performance indicators to reduce customization across system implementations and improve consistency across disciplines.
* Support comparison, selection, and implementation of operational systems and technologies across the Ports \& Terminals portfolio.
* Assess TOS utilization effectiveness across business units and strengthen adoption through training recommendations in collaboration with DP World Hub and relevant learning tools.
* Direct the development roadmap of the internal TOS, Zodiac, in alignment with the global TOS strategy.
* Manage TOS and peripheral technology vendor relationships from a central head office perspective, including regular user groups to build alignment, knowledge sharing, and operational adoption.
* Advise senior management on AFE for P\&T Systems.
* Act as liaison and quality control point for collecting business requirements for operational system implementations and system enhancements.
* Maintain relationships with all third\-party service providers and vendors supporting operational systems and technology.
* Direct and improve the Group’s Innovation portfolio, strengthening innovation maturity across all pillars, including Ports \& Terminals, Logistics, Digital Solutions, and Marine.
* Champion an innovation culture across DP World by encouraging idea generation, experimentation, knowledge sharing, and adoption of new solutions across all pillars.
* Measure the impact of innovation outcomes on DP World’s business, including value creation, cost savings, customer satisfaction, and human safety and wellbeing.
* Direct the groupwide Innovation Platform (INNOGATE) development roadmap and ensure innovative projects and solutions are integrated into commercial, marketing, supply chain, and operational processes.
* Manage geographically dispersed and functionally diverse internal and external teams to maintain a single view of the innovation portfolio and ensure effective delivery.
* Stay abreast of industry and technology trends and market developments, and make recommendations to DP World accordingly.


**Education**
 Qualifications, Skills and Experience:
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Logistics, Technology Management, Computer Science or related field. Master's degree (MBA, Technology Management, Logistics, Engineering, or equivalent) preferred.
   

  

 Experience in managing the terminal business.
   

  

* 15\+ years of experience in terminal operations, enterprise software, operational systems, digital transformation, or technology leadership roles.
* 8\+ years in senior leadership positions managing large\-scale technology portfolios and transformation programs.
* Proven experience defining technology strategy, roadmaps, architecture, and implementation plan for complex operational environments.
* Experience leading enterprise\-wide software implementations and business transformation initiatives.
* Strong understanding of operational technology platforms, enterprise applications, integration architectures, cloud technologies, and data platforms.
* Experience in global container/non\-container terminal industry with a keen interest in TOS planning, implementations, and optimization.
* Experience in terminal automation and the various modes of operation, ASC/RTG/RMG/SC
* Business leader with proven track record of change management. Is widely recognised and respected and well known to BU and regional leadership.
* Ability to influence the decision makers in executive management.
* Detailed process thinker and strategist.


**Project Management**
* Strong negotiation and relationship management skills. Ability to work with program / project managers and teams from other areas.
* Previous project management experience within the container / non\-container terminal industry


**Subject Knowledge**
* Must have in\-depth knowledge of terminal processes.
* Detailed knowledge of all terminal concepts and modes of operation ASC/RTG/RMG/SC/RS/AGV
* The desire to learn and take on\-board business\-related matters regarding business practices and assessments.
* Knowledge of Safety, Environmental and Security related matters and how they relate to terminal operations and company commitments.
* An ability to maintain current knowledge of developments related to business matters of interest to internal assessment particularly legislation changes and developments as they affect DP World operations.


**Catalyst**
* An ability to be catalyst to new ideas and technologies
* Embrace new technologies and processes


**About Us**
 Trade is the lifeblood of the global economy, creating opportunities and improving the quality of life for people around the world. DP World exists to make the world’s trade flow better, changing what’s possible for the customers and communities we serve globally.
   

  

 With a dedicated, diverse and professional team of more than 115,000 employees from 160 nationalities, spanning 78 countries on six continents, DP World is pushing trade further and faster towards a seamless supply chain that’s fit for the future.
   

  

 We’re rapidly transforming and integrating our businesses \-\- Ports and Terminals, Marine Services, Logistics and Technology – and uniting our global infrastructure with local expertise to create stronger, more efficient end\-to\-end supply chain solutions that can change the way the world trades.
   

  

 What's more, we're reshaping the future by investing in innovation. From intelligent delivery systems to automated warehouse stacking, we’re at the cutting edge of disruptive technology, pushing the sector towards better ways to trade, minimizing disruptions from the factory floor to the customer’s door.
   

  

 DP World is on a mission to transcend boundaries and bridge the gap between all nations and cultures – not just in what we do but also in how we behave.
   

  

 We are dedicated to creating a culture where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to reach their full potential. We believe that embracing inclusion and diversity, drives innovation and growth and helps us connect people, businesses, and societies. Free minds and different perspectives are changing our world, and together we can change what’s possible.
   

  

 WE MAKE TRADE FLOW

**Life at Dubai Future Foundation** 




 Dubai Future Foundation (DFF) aims to realize the wise vision of Dubai’s leadership to institutionalize the envisioned future and forward\-thinking methodologies, while positioning Dubai as the leading city of the future. In partnership with its local and global partners from governments, companies, startups, and entrepreneurs, DFF drives joint efforts to collectively imagine, design, and execute the best possible future for humanity.
 



 Under the supervision of His Highness Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Crown Prince of Dubai, Chairman of the Executive Council of Dubai, and Chairman of the Board of Trustees of DFF, the DFF runs and oversees many future\-facing projects and initiatives, such as the Museum of the Future, Area 2071, The Centre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution UAE, Dubai Future Accelerators, One Million Arab Coders, Dubai Future Academy, Dubai Future Solutions, Dubai Future Labs, Dubai Future Forum, etc.
 



 DFF’s efforts to share knowledge, adopt innovation, support entrepreneurs and innovative startups, build capacity, and promote forward\-thinking and foresight principles contribute to Dubai’s ambitions to be a role model for the cities of the future through the power of imagination, innovation, foresight and disruptive mindset.
 



 For more information on the initiatives, projects, and programmess of Dubai Future Foundation, please visit the website: www.dubaifuture.ae
 



  





  





**Where does this role fit into the bigger picture?** 




 Senior Programme Manager \- lead the design, governance, and delivery of high\-impact Dubai Future Academy programs, translating strategic priorities into structured learning journeys and managing partners, stakeholders, risks, and outcomes across the full program lifecycle.
 



 Dubai Future Academy (DFAc) is the capability building arm of Dubai Future Foundation. It supports Dubai by developing learning opportunities through collaborations with world\-class education providers and subject matter experts. The Senior Program Manager leads complex academy programs by shaping program scope, coordinating partners and subject matter experts, managing delivery governance, and ensuring each learning journey is delivered with strategic clarity, operational excellence, and a strong participant experience.
 



 Senior Program Manager – Dubai Future Academy

 As Senior Program Manager at DFAc, you will own assigned academy programs from concept and planning through delivery, reporting, and continuous improvement.  Position: Senior Program Manager – Dubai Future Academy Dubai Future Foundation
 



 • Manage participant selection and onboarding processes in coordination with internal stakeholders, partners, and senior reviewers where required.
 



 • Use feedback, attendance, engagement, and operational insights to improve participant experience before, during, and after each program.
 



 • Prepare clear written updates, talking points, summaries, and briefing materials for academy leadership and senior stakeholders.
 



 • Ensure sensitive information, participant data, and stakeholder communications are handled with discretion and appropriate confidentiality.

 • Define program success measures and ensure relevant data is captured consistently across attendance, satisfaction, learning outcomes, stakeholder feedback, and delivery quality.

 This role makes a visible impact by turning Dubai Future Academy priorities into high\-quality learning programs that build capability, strengthen future readiness, and connect leaders with world\-class expertise. The Senior Program Manager protects program quality by bringing structure to complex work, aligning stakeholders, managing risks, and ensuring delivery decisions are made with clarity and pace. This role is important to strengthening the Academy's reputation, scaling its impact, and reinforcing Dubai Future Foundation's position as a regional and international thought leader in future\-focused capability building.
 



  





  





**What does the Dubai Future Foundation offer?** 




 We will offer you a unique opportunity to support learning journeys that build leadership capability and future skills. You will work closely with an experienced academy team, engage with senior stakeholders, and support delivery alongside world\-class partners.
 



 You will build practical skills in program delivery, coordination, communications, and reporting, with the chance to learn across multiple initiatives and grow your confidence through hands\-on experience.

 • You can translate strategic priorities into practical plans, milestones, governance mechanisms, budgets, and delivery decisions.

 • You bring strong judgment, attention to detail, and discretion when managing sensitive information, competing priorities, and shifting timelines.
 



 • You are a clear communicator and facilitator who can lead meetings, brief speakers, prepare senior\-level updates, and represent the Academy professionally.
 



 • You are proactive, curious, collaborative, and future\-oriented, with the ability to motivate teams and deliver high\-quality learning experiences.

data.jd_text:
Equiti is a pioneering fintech firm and world\-class provider of multi\-asset fintech products \- from liquidity solutions to in\-house tech hubs to online trading platforms. With over 400 global specialists in 9 languages, Equiti provides clients with access to individual, professional, and institutional brokerage services in Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.
 



  





 At Equiti, we believe that financial opportunities can unlock potential for everyone, everywhere. We’re on a mission to deliver accessible online trading products around the world through education and accessibility.
 



  





 Think finance is stuffy? Think again.
 



  





 At Equiti, we’re building fintech with a purpose: making wealth tools accessible to everyone. As we continue to grow, we’re seeking talented individuals who thrive in innovative environments. , and we are on the lookout for talented individuals who can perform and excel in a dynamic and innovative working environment. Our Technology department would like to welcome a detail\-oriented.
 



  





**Head of Engineering Excellence** 
 in our office in Dubai.
 



  





 As the Head of Engineering Excellence, you will…
 



 Be the force that turns Equiti’s engineering principles into everyday practice. Reporting directly to the CTO, you will own the operating system of the technology organisation — the standards, processes, delivery cadence and metrics that keep a fast\-scaling, multi\-domain engineering org accountable, aligned and continuously improving. You will be the CTO’s trusted partner for execution: making sure the right things get done, by the right owners, to the right standard — without the CTO having to chase.
 



 You will define and enforce how the engineering org works — ways of working, communication and accountability standards, and delivery governance — and make performance visible through engineering KPIs and dashboards. You will lead a culture of Kaizen (continuous improvement), running the cadences and retrospectives that turn data and incidents into lasting improvements across mobile, web, backend, data, platform, QA and trading teams.
 



 You will also be Equiti’s engineering voice to the outside world — championing our work through blogs, talks and conferences, growing our presence in the developer community, and building the technical brand that draws great people to us.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Own and enforce Equiti’s engineering principles, standards and ways of working across all technology domains.
* Define, track and report engineering KPIs — delivery throughput and predictability, DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time, change\-failure rate, MTTR), responsiveness/SLA attainment and quality — and turn them into action.
* Run the engineering operating cadence: planning, delivery reviews, incident/postmortem reviews and the operations review that holds owners accountable to SLAs.
* Drive a culture of Kaizen / continuous improvement — facilitate retrospectives, identify systemic bottlenecks, and land process improvements that stick.
* Embed the communication \& accountability framework — ownership/RACI, triage lanes, escalation and channel standards — so nothing falls through the cracks.
* Govern cross\-team delivery for major programmes and product launches; surface risks and dependencies early and unblock them.
* Partner with domain leads to raise engineering maturity, consistency and governance — without slowing teams down.
* Act as the CTO’s go to on execution — translate strategy into tracked outcomes, prepare leadership and board\-ready updates, and ensure follow\-through on decisions.
* Champion engineering quality, change management and operational excellence in partnership with SRE / Engineering Platforms.
* Establish lightweight tooling and dashboards (within the ticketing and observability stack) that make standards and metrics self\-serve for every team.
* Lead Equiti’s external engineering evangelism — represent the technology org through conference talks, meetups and panels, and grow our standing in the wider engineering community.
* Own the Equiti engineering blog and technical thought leadership, and shape the engineering employer brand that helps attract and retain top talent.



  





**Experience Requirements** 



* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 10\+ years in software engineering, technical programme management, or engineering operations, with at least 5 years leading process or delivery excellence in scaled engineering organisations.
* Proven track record defining and enforcing engineering principles, ways of working and delivery governance across multiple teams.
* Deep fluency in engineering KPIs and metrics (DORA, delivery predictability, quality, reliability) and in building dashboards that change behaviour.
* Hands\-on experience leading continuous improvement / Kaizen, Agile, and incident/postmortem practices at scale.
* Strong technical credibility — able to hold weight with senior engineers and architects — without needing to be the deepest coder in the room.
* Exceptional influence and stakeholder management; able to enforce standards through trust and clarity, not authority alone.
* A confident public communicator — a track record of external technical writing, conference speaking, or developer\-community engagement (engineering blogs, talks, open source).
* Experience operating as a trusted partner to a CTO or VP of Engineering (programme leadership / execution\-focused role) strongly preferred.
* Experience in fintech, brokerage, or regulated industries preferred.
* Based in, or willing to relocate to, Dubai.



  





  





**Perks** 




  





 Each of our offices has its special perks; be it ‘no ties’, free lunches, charity events, or a hybrid work policy – but whenever you walk into an Equiti office, you’re sure to see a friendly face. We encourage international collaborations and always keep our eyes open to how we can do more.
 



 The benefits you can expect at your Equiti workplace include:
 


* Competitive salary package
* Performance\-based bonus
* Medical insurance coverage for employees and family members
* Smart working options
* Employee wellness initiatives
* Personalized career development
* Company lunch in the office
* Regular company events



  





 With energy, drive, and imagination, there’s no limit to where your career can go at Equiti. With a diverse workforce and geographical spread of offices, we strongly support career development initiatives as well as provide a range of opportunities for professional and life experiences.
 



  





 Equiti is an equal opportunity employer.
 



  





 “Equiti” refers to a group of companies consisting of seven regulated financial services companies licensed to operate in the respective jurisdictions of their incorporation, in addition to our tech and marketing hubs. Equiti has presence in Africa, Europe, and the Middle East.

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose** 




 Provide high‑level strategic, financial, governance, and performance advisory to the CEO’s Office. Lead integrated financial–strategic consulting workflows, strengthen financial and KPI frameworks, and steer cross‑domain financial and investment studies to support institutional direction.
 



 Provide advisory and support leadership in shaping long‑term strategy by delivering advanced financial assessments, feasibility analysis, investment evaluation, risk modelling, and financial impact assessments of strategic initiatives. Leverage AI, foresight, and analytics to enhance financial sustainability, resource allocation efficiency, and institutional value creation.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**Strategy** 



* Provide Authority/sector‑level strategic financial and corporate strategy advisory to the SCG CEO, including financial policy insights, investment analysis, and governance recommendations.
* Facilitate cross‑domain financial, innovation, and technical advisory for SCG, integrating financial modelling into corporate strategy, excellence, and innovation initiatives.
* Lead and advise the sector on financial foresight, scenario planning, and economic trend analysis to anticipate financial and regulatory shifts affecting strategic priorities.
* Advance institutional excellence by developing financial performance frameworks, investment evaluation criteria, and financial sustainability indicators aligned with national priorities and excellence programs.
* Enhance governance and policy oversight by reinforcing financial governance systems, monitoring compliance, and ensuring alignment with regulatory frameworks and financial controls.
* Evaluate strategic initiatives by reviewing financial feasibility, investment returns, capital structure implications, and long‑term financial impact of projects and partnerships.
* Translate long‑term financial insights into actionable financial roadmaps, investment guidelines, and transformation programs.
* Champion the adoption of AI, analytics, and financial modelling tools to enhance strategic planning, investment evaluation, and performance management.



  





**Operations** 



* Provide input on and lead teams to implement Director General/Board/CEO directives, translating them into financial governance actions, investment‑related committee decisions, KPI resets, and documented closures.
* Monitor sector programs and projects from a financial and strategic perspective; evaluate risks, analyze financial KPIs/benefits, and contribute to enterprise reporting to the CEO.
* Identify and mitigate financial, operational, and institutional risks, proposing mitigation measures to safeguard financial resilience.
* Review and coordinate with relevant units on financial data, investment cases, financial proof‑of‑concepts, and ensure alignment with institutional documents.
* Coordinate with units on financial governance safeguards, regulatory alignment, and documentation for investment‑related initiatives.
* Assist in formation and supervision of agility groups and teams; contribute to implementation of the institutional financial agility map
* Identify and mitigate institutional risks across safety, financial, operational, and reputational domains. Propose effective mitigation measures to safeguard organizational resilience
* Coordinate with relevant units on data, AI, proof\-of\-concept studies, and use cases; ensure alignment with institutional documents.
* Coordinate with relevant units on data/AI items for policy alignment, governance safeguards, and documentation (while technical build/validation sits with Engineering).
* Assist in formation and supervision of agility groups and teams; contribute to implementation of the institutional agility map.



**Product/Process Improvement** 



* Review sector service development plans; validate financial data accuracy; assess governance/business‑case change requests prior to submission; support follow‑up on improvement plans (benefits realization, KPI integrity, financial signoffs).
* Support feasibility studies and financial analyses related to financial sustainability, revenue growth, investment performance, and operational efficiency.
* Provide advisory observations on templates, procedural manuals, and guidelines to enhance financial governance quality and consistency of analytical outputs.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s/Master’s in Public Administration, Policy, Business, Management, Engineering Management, Finance, Economics, Future Foresight, Technology/AI
* Must have 12\+ Years of experience in case of Master’s degree (14\+ years in case of Bachelor’s degree)
* Must have experience in financial strategy, investment analysis, KPI frameworks, governance, and executive reporting in a large public entity
* Preferred certifications: Certifications such as PMP, ACP, EFQM Assessor, CFA, FRM, or equivalent financial certifications.

**Summary**
 The role of the Project Manager in the Major Projects \& Engineering Services Department is to lead and guide the execution of all engineering, design, procurement, fabrication, field construction (if applicable), and scope changes from project award, to kick\-off, through project execution, and to field commissioning of natural gas projects in the United States.
   

  

****Principle Responsibilities and Duties****
* Provide overall leadership and governance for large, complex, and high\-risk EPC (turnkey) projects, managing technical, commercial, contractual, and fabrication requirements from initiation through closeout in alignment with Enerflex processes and the Project Execution Plan. Ensure full integration of scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, procurement, and stakeholder management. Establish project governance structures, decision authorities, and escalation protocols appropriate to major capital projects. Lead and optimize multi\-disciplinary teams while managing multiple concurrent projects with significant execution and commercial risk. Demonstrate ethical leadership, sound judgment, and adherence to Enerflex core values. Advise executive management on project performance, risks, client relationships, and strategic impacts through formal reporting and governance forums.

Build and maintain strong customer relationships through proactive engagement, structured communication, and effective issue resolution. Translate customer requirements, changes, and commercial positions into clear internal direction aligned with the approved scope baseline. Lead high\-impact internal and external meetings, negotiations, and executive reviews. Travel domestically and internationally as required to support customer engagement, commissioning, and start\-up activities.

Oversee performance reporting, including schedule and cost variance, forecast\-to\-complete, and recovery planning. Proactively identify schedule risks and implement mitigation or acceleration strategies using advanced planning tools and critical path analysis.

Oversee cost control activities and apply earned value management, cost forecasting, and commercial risk principles. Lead or support high\-value change orders, variations, and claim negotiations.
* mitigation and constructability. Resolve complex technical, commissioning, and warranty issues, ensuring alignment across engineering, procurement, fabrication, and construction.

* Ensure compliance with quality, health, safety, security, and environmental (HSSE) requirements. Promote a proactive safety and compliance culture and provide leadership in addressing serious quality or HSSE risks and incidents.

* Strong self\-starter skills and ability to perform successfully with limited supervision.
* Versatile team building skills and ability to coordinate multifunctional teams.
* Solid Computer/Software/Program skills.
* Strong working knowledge of industry codes and safety legislation.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, organizational skills, and the ability to work closely in a team environment with all internal / external stakeholders.
* Fully comfortable in dealing with customers, vendors, manufacturing and management teams in the USA and international landscapes.
* Strong negotiation and conflict resolution skills.
* EPC Project experience along with exposure to fabrication facilities is a must.
* Entrepreneurial attitude, aptitude for innovation and long term career interests.BS Degree in Engineering is preferred and a Professional Engineering License is a plus.

 Fast\-paced general office environment. Many tasks have high degrees of time sensitivity. Domestic and international travel is possible on occasion.
