**Job Description**
 WSP Middle East is seeking an experienced AI Business Partner to work in direct partnership with the Property \& Buildings (P\&B) Business Unit leadership. This senior role sits at the intersection of design, engineering, and applied intelligence, driving the integration of emerging technologies into core business and project delivery processes.
   

  

 The successful candidate will combine deep architectural or engineering expertise with the ability to apply AI, computational design, and digital tools to deliver measurable performance improvements across major programmes.
   

  

 As the single point of accountability for the P\&B AI agenda, you will define priorities, lead delivery, and embed scalable solutions that enhance design quality, operational efficiency, and client outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Strategic Partnership \& Leadership**
* Act as the dedicated AI Business Partner to P\&B leadership across the Middle East.
* Develop and maintain a clear AI and digital roadmap aligned to business priorities and project demands.
* Provide informed, experience\-led advisory to senior stakeholders on opportunities, risks, and investment decisions.


**Use Case Development \& Value Realisation**
* Identify and prioritise high\-impact use cases across the full project lifecycle—from concept design to delivery.
* Build structured business cases with clear KPIs, ROI, and measurable outcomes.
* Maintain a transparent pipeline from opportunity identification through to scaled deployment.


**Computational Design \& Technical Enablement**
* Lead the integration of AI and computational design approaches into project workflows.
* Drive AI adoption within tools including Revit, Dynamo, Rhino, Grasshopper, AutoCAD, and Power BI to support data\-driven design.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement and innovation within design and engineering teams.


**Delivery \& Change Management**
* Oversee the end\-to\-end implementation of AI solutions within live project environments.
* Ensure solutions are practical, scalable, and adopted effectively by multidisciplinary teams.
* Lead change management efforts to embed new ways of working across large programmes.


**Governance, Risk \& Compliance**
* Establish and maintain governance frameworks for AI deployment within P\&B.
* Ensure adherence to WSP standards relating to data security, intellectual property, and risk management.
* Support client engagement on responsible and ethical use of AI technologies.


**Performance Tracking \& Reporting**
* Track and report on performance, benefits, and adoption of AI initiatives.
* Provide clear, executive\-level reporting aligned to business outcomes.
* Continuously refine strategy based on performance insights and evolving requirements.


**Qualifications**
* Degree in Architecture, Engineering, or a related discipline; professional accreditation (e.g. RIBA, ARB) is advantageous.
* Minimum 10 years’ experience within a Design Manager, Architect, or equivalent role, delivering large\-scale projects.
* Strong understanding of multidisciplinary engineering principles within the built environment.
* Proven experience managing complex, multi\-stakeholder programmes.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive strategic initiatives.
* Experience delivering digital, data\-driven, or AI\-enabled solutions within the AEC sector.
* Strong regional experience within the Middle East market.


**Technical Capability**
* Proficiency in BIM and computational design tools (Revit, Dynamo, Grasshopper, Rhino).
* Understanding of data workflows, automation, and emerging AI capabilities within design and engineering contexts.


**Desirable Experience**
* Exposure to Generative AI, advanced analytics, and automation platforms.

* Experience working within structured enterprise governance environments.
* Background in digital engineering, BIM leadership, or design technology roles.

It is designed to be more hands\-on and cross\-cutting than a traditional PMO function, while also being broader in scope than a TPM role focused on delivering within a single engineering team or system.
 



  





 You will PM the security roadmap across Platform Security, Application and Product Security, GRC, and engineering partners. You will own the planning system, the delivery rhythm, the reporting model, and the closure standards for security initiatives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Own the cybersecurity portfolio execution model including planning, governance rhythm, risk, reporting, and closure standards
* Drive quarterly planning for the security roadmap including sequencing, resourcing assumptions, and critical path
* Translate CISO projects and priorities, regulatory commitments, and audit requirements into executable program plans with owners, milestones, dependencies, and measurable outcomes
* Run weekly execution reviews with security leadership, enforce action closure, and manage decision deadlines
* Build and maintain the Group Security Scorecard across entities and functions, defining the metric set, targets, owners, and data sources and including it in the monthly reviews.
* Maintain the cybersecurity portfolio system of record covering initiative status, milestones, risks, dependencies, and decisions
* Produce executive\-ready reporting packs with consistent format across progress, risks, decisions required, and next milestones
* Write one\-pager program briefs for major initiatives covering scope, success metrics, owners, milestones, acceptance criteria, and timelines
* Track hiring and onboarding critical path for roadmap delivery milestones, without owning recruiting execution
* Improve execution visibility through automation, tooling, and dashboards that keep portfolio health current with minimal overhead on teams



  





**Who we need?** 




  




* Senior PM experience running cross\-functional portfolios across multiple teams with tight delivery expectations
* Strong ability to drive accountability through clarity, structured pressure, and escalation, without relying on formal authority
* Strong ability to build a delivery system including cadence, artifacts, templates, dashboards, and consistent reporting
* Executive\-grade writing and communication with concise updates, clear risk framing, and clean decision asks
* Strong judgment on prioritization, sequencing, and tradeoffs under competing demands and constrained capacity
* Ability to convert ambiguity into scope, milestones, owners, and measurable outputs
* Strong program management fundamentals with a bias toward execution, not ceremony
* Security fluency across variety of security domains, enough to pressure\-test plans and timelines without being the technical decision maker.
* High ownership and maturity handling sensitive information while representing the security leaders and CISO.



  





**Preferred experience** 




  




* Experience in a CISO office, security leadership office, or security program portfolio in a large tech company
* Experience delivering security transformation programs across multiple geographies and business units.
* Experience PM’ing security roadmaps that include detection and response maturity, platform security modernization, secure engineering programs, and governance remediation.
* Experience building governance rhythms and reporting packs used by executives, audit committees, or senior leadership stakeholders
* Experience in high\-scale consumer internet, e\-commerce, fintech, payments, logistics, or marketplace environments
* Strong program management tooling depth (or equivalent) and dashboarding habits that leadership can actually consume.



  





 Is this you?

data.jd_text:
**Job Description Summary**
 The Project Planning Digital Transformation \& Scheduling Systems Leader is a critical hybrid role responsible for designing, maintaining, and continuously improving the digital scheduling ecosystem that enables integrated project planning and execution across ITO and OTR.
   

  

 This role combines deep Primavera P6 scheduling expertise, project controls process knowledge, automation capability, enterprise systems understanding, and data\-driven analytics to support the One Project Schedule (OPS) operating model and wider planning transformation.
   

  

 The role will act as a bridge between Planning \& Scheduling, Engineering, Equipment Planning, Project Management, Factory teams, IT/UDC developers, PLM, PMx, Data Lake, and other enterprise tool owners. The position will lead the development and governance of scheduling tools, automation workflows, system integrations, dashboards, and data quality controls required to support baseline creation, schedule updates, project readiness, proposal analysis, field test learnings, and execution reporting.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* OPS Digital Scheduling Architecture
* Own and support the digital architecture required to enable the OPS scheduling model across projects.
* Maintain and enhance the Primavera P6 enterprise scheduling setup required for integrated Engineering, Equipment, Factory, Logistics, PM Key Dates, and project baseline schedules.
* Support OPS template governance, baseline schedule creation, rebaseline workflows, and schedule update/reporting processes.
* Ensure scheduling architecture supports integrated logic, cross\-product dependencies, PM Key Dates, CUD/Vendoc requirements, and baseline readiness.
* Partner with planning, engineering, equipment, and tool teams to convert field test learnings into repeatable digital scheduling solutions.
* Primavera P6 Administration \& Enterprise Scheduling Support
* Provide advanced Primavera P6 expertise across EPS/OBS structure, project codes, activity codes, calendars, baselines, layouts, global changes, user access, and schedule configuration.
* Support P6 project creation, template copying, baseline assignment, project coding, and integration readiness.
* Troubleshoot P6 issues related to scheduling options, F9 simulation, constraints, loops, negative float, baseline mismatches, and integration failures.
* Ensure P6 data structures are compatible with downstream tools such as GER, OTD Tracker, PMx, PLM, dashboards, and reporting environments.
* Support controlled deployment of P6 configuration changes in alignment with governance requirements.
* Tool Development, Automation \& Integration
* Lead or support development of automation tools that reduce manual planning effort and improve schedule quality.
* Partner with UDC / IT / development teams to define requirements, test solutions, validate outputs, and manage deployment of planning tools.
* Support integrations between P6 and enterprise systems such as PLM, PMx, Data Lake, UDC, OTD Tracker, LTDB, Vendoc/CDH loaders, and reporting dashboards.
* Translate business process requirements into functional tool specifications, user stories, validation logic, and test cases.
* Own user acceptance testing, defect tracking, and continuous improvement of planning automation tools.
* Ensure automation solutions are scalable, auditable, and aligned with project controls governance.
* ITO Proposal Planning \& Analysis Support
* Support ITO planning teams with proposal schedule analytics, standard cycle validation, lead time analysis, and bid readiness reviews.
* Handle complex TK and EEP projects scheduling during ITO phase including coordination with Partners, support deal teams for discussions with Customer during clarification phase.
* Help strengthen ITO\-to\-OTR handover by ensuring proposal assumptions, standard cycles, customer commitments, and OPS schedule logic are aligned.
* ITO analysis tools and dashboards maintenance / upgrade to compare contractual commitments against OPS/LTDB standard cycles.
* Identify disconnects between as\-sold dates, standard cycles, and execution templates before OTR baseline development.
* Provide analytical support for proposal risk reviews, schedule feasibility checks, and planning assumptions.
* Data Quality, Reporting \& Analytics
* Develop and maintain data quality checks for schedule readiness, baseline completeness, project codes, activity coding, MLI mapping, baseline type, and reporting eligibility.
* Support dashboards and analytics for schedule health, readiness gates, negative float, critical path, variance, cycle compliance, and tool sync status.
* Partner with reporting and data teams to ensure schedule data is accurately extracted, transformed, and consumed by downstream reporting tools.
* Support root cause analysis when projects do not appear correctly in trackers, dashboards, GER, OTD, or PMx/PLM reporting.
* Create structured diagnostics and issue\-resolution playbooks for recurring tool and data problems.
* Governance, Process \& Standardization
* Support creation and maintenance of QMS / governance documents for OPS tools, template management, baseline creation, rebaseline, reporting, and integrations.
* Define standard work instructions for tool users, planners, schedulers, and functional teams.
* Support monthly working team reviews and quarterly governance reviews for OPS tools and scheduling architecture.
* Maintain clear RACI alignment between Planning, Engineering, Equipment, Factory, PM, IT/UDC, and tool owners.
* Ensure lessons learned from pilot projects and field tests are converted into sustainable process and tool improvements.
* Stakeholder Engagement \& Change Management
* Act as a key interface between business users and technical development teams.
* Facilitate workshops, tool demos, issue\-resolution sessions, and schedule readiness reviews.
* Train and coach planners, schedulers, and stakeholders on tool usage, P6 configuration, automation workflows, and data governance expectations.
* Communicate technical issues in a clear, business\-oriented manner to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Promote adoption of standardized, integrated, and digitally enabled project controls practices.


**Required Qualifications**
 For candidates in UAE \& Canada
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Project Management, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum 10 Years of experience in project controls, planning, scheduling, project management systems, or enterprise tool implementation.
* Strong working knowledge of Primavera P6, including project structures, baselines, codes, scheduling options, logic, calendars, and reporting data.
* Experience supporting complex projects, preferably in power generation, energy, infrastructure, engineering, manufacturing, or EPC environments.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business process needs into tool requirements, functional specifications, test scripts, and automation logic.
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams including Planning, Engineering, Equipment, Project Management, IT, and data/reporting teams.
* Strong Excel and data analysis skills.
* Ability to diagnose complex system, data, and process issues and drive them to closure.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.


 For candidates in Hungary
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Project Management, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related technical discipline.
* Significant years of experience in project controls, planning, scheduling, project management systems, or enterprise tool implementation.
* Strong working knowledge of Primavera P6, including project structures, baselines, codes, scheduling options, logic, calendars, and reporting data.
* Experience supporting complex projects, preferably in power generation, energy, infrastructure, engineering, manufacturing, or EPC environments.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business process needs into tool requirements, functional specifications, test scripts, and automation logic.
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams including Planning, Engineering, Equipment, Project Management, IT, and data/reporting teams.
* Strong Excel and data analysis skills.
* Ability to diagnose complex system, data, and process issues and drive them to closure.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.


**Desired Characteristics**
* Systems thinker with the ability to connect project controls processes, scheduling logic, enterprise tools, and business outcomes.
* Strong problem solver who can diagnose issues across people, process, data, and system layers.
* Comfortable operating between technical developers and business users.
* Proactive, structured, and execution\-focused.
* Able to challenge assumptions while maintaining strong stakeholder relationships.
* Detail\-oriented with strong ownership mindset.
* Curious and willing to learn new tools, integrations, and business processes.
* Strong facilitator who can lead working sessions, issue reviews, and governance discussions.
* Capable of converting lessons learned into standard work, governance, and scalable solutions.


 For candidates applying to a Canadian\-based position, the pay range for this position is between $145,700 and $195,700 CAD. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set.
   

  

 Bonus eligibility: discretionary annual bonus.
   

  

 This posting is for an existing vacancy.
   

  

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 No
   

  

* This is a remote position

Role Summary The IT Project Manager is responsible for representing the IT function across new Site Opening initiatives and for driving Crucial and High Priority IT projects to successful, on\-time completion. This role acts as the single point of accountability for IT within site launch programs, coordinating across all IT functions and external vendors, while also managing a portfolio of high\-impact projects that require close stakeholder engagement, rigorous tracking, and proactive risk management. The role requires a hands\-on leader who is equally comfortable on the project floor at a new site and presenting a consolidated status to senior leadership and the Steering Committee. Key Responsibilities
 



**1\. Site Opening – IT Representation \& Coordination** 




 • Act as the single point of contact representing IT for all Site Opening projects, end to end. • Coordinate with all IT stakeholder teams to ensure readiness, including: ‒ Entertainment Business Teams ‒ Projects / Construction Teams ‒ Applications Teams (Entrprise / Business) ‒ Operations \& Telecom ‒ Infrastructure (Infra) ‒ Service Delivery and Managed Services ‒ Asset Management ‒ System Vendors and Integrators • Drive coordination across all IT departments to ensure aligned planning, sequencing, and execution of site readiness activities. • Consolidate inputs from all IT workstreams and present a single, unified IT project update to the Program team and the Steering Committee (SteerCo). • Prepare and maintain the Bill of Quantities (BOQ) for IT scope at each site, ensuring accuracy and alignment with site requirements. • Track all site milestones closely, proactively flag deviations, and drive corrective actions to keep delivery on target. • Obtain formal sign\-offs at each milestone and at project closure from relevant stakeholders and business owners. Visit sites frequently to validate on\-ground readiness, inspect installations, and resolve issues directly with site and vendor teams.
 



**2\. Crucial \& High Priority IT Projects** 




 • Coordinate with business stakeholders and vendors to develop detailed project plans, timelines, and resource requirements. • Follow up individually with each stakeholder and vendor to ensure accountability and timely completion of action items. • Prepare and circulate a weekly project status update, clearly highlighting progress, key activities, and upcoming milestones. • Proactively identify, document, and escalate project risks and issues, along with recommended mitigation plans. • Maintain a risk and issue log, and drive resolution through to closure in coordination with relevant owners. • Ensure project documentation, plans, and trackers are kept current and accessible to all stakeholders.
 



**3\. Other Responsibilities** 




 • Balance time between Head Office (HO), to manage key projects, planning, and stakeholder reviews, and frequent site visits to oversee execution and readiness. • Build strong working relationships with internal IT teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and system integrators. • Support continuous improvement of site opening playbooks, templates, and project governance processes. • Ensure adherence to organizational project management standards, change control, and reporting cadence.
 



**Key Skills \& Competencies** 




 • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across multiple IT functions, business teams, and external vendors. • Proven project management experience, including planning, scheduling, milestone tracking, and risk management. • Experience managing IT scope for site openings or rollouts (BOQ preparation, infrastructure and systems coordination) is highly preferred. • Excellent communication and reporting skills, with the ability to consolidate complex, multi\-team updates into clear executive\-level summaries. • Strong follow\-through and accountability mindset; comfortable driving individuals and teams to meet deadlines. • Ability to manage multiple concurrent high\-priority projects under tight timelines. • Willingness and ability to travel frequently to project sites. • Proficiency with project management and reporting tools (e.g., MS Project, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, or equivalent).
 



**Qualifications \& Experience** 




 • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. • Minimum 5\-8 years of experience in IT project management, with exposure to site rollouts, infrastructure projects, or large\-scale program delivery. • PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification is an advantage. • Prior experience coordinating with multi\-disciplinary IT teams (Applications, Infra, Telecom, Service Delivery, Asset Management) and external vendors/integrators. Key Stakeholders Internal Business Stakeholders, Application \& Digital Teams, Operations \& Telecom, Infrastructure, Service Delivery, Asset Management, Program Management Office, Senior Management / SteerCo External System Vendors, Integrators, Site Contractors / Civil \& MEP teams (as applicable)
 



**Work Conditions** 




 • Primary base: Head Office (HO). • Frequent travel to site locations required, including for project kick\-offs, readiness checks, and go live support. • May require flexibility in working hours during critical milestones, go\-lives, or risk\-mitigation activities.

data.jd_text:
**THE OPPORTUNITY** 




  





 The Senior Manager of ERP \& Process Excellence for the Group will be responsible for the standardization and harmonization of finance processes across the group. You will be responsible for designing, standardizing and embedding world\-class finance processes across the group. You will act as the primary owner and guardian of the process templates, ensuring a single harmonized way of working is adopted across all opcos while also acting as the functional authority on the ERP configuration and design. You will have deep functional finance process expertise along with knowledge of ERP functionalities.
 



 You will be expected to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including ERP vendor teams, functional and implementation consultants, country teams, internal IT factory and corporate functions (Finance, Procurement, IT, HR, Risk \& Compliance, Audit and Business Controls).
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





 Process Standardization and Ownership
 


* Design and own the Group\-wide finance process template covering Record to Report (R2R), Procure to Pay (P2P), Order to Cash (O2C), Acquire to Retire (A2R) Treasury to bank(T2B) and Tax processes in line with best practices.
* Produce and maintain high\-quality process documentation including process flows, standard operating procedures (SOPs), RACI matrices, and control frameworks.
* Define and enforce the principle of standardization and adoption of best practices.Minimize customizations \- distinguishing genuine statutory local requirements from habits or preferences.
* Maintain and govern the process template throughout the program lifecycle, managing change requests through a formal governance process.
* Lead current\-state process mapping across all operating entities, identifying variations, gaps, and opportunities for harmonization
* Ensure Finance processes align with reporting, financial control and audit requirements



  





 Business Process Optimization
 


* Define KPIs, review and continuously optimize end to end finance processes.
* Continue to identify new ERP functionality adoption, automation opportunities and eliminate inefficiencies
* Ensure accurate integration between ERP and other systems
* Monitor system performance and recommend improvements
* Provide ongoing functional support and troubleshooting



  





 ERP Functional Lead
 


* Act as the senior functional lead for ERP Finance modules including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash Management, Fixed Assets, and Expenses.
* Lead the design of the Chart of Accounts, accounting field structure, period close calendar, and consolidation framework.
* Work closely with the implementation partners to translate process designs into system configurations, ensuring adherence to the agreed template.
* Review and challenge configuration decisions, ensuring they support standardisation objectives and long\-term scalability.
* Lead functional testing including SIT and UAT, ensuring test scenarios reflect real business processes across all entities.



  





 Stakeholder engagement
 


* Work with OpCo CFOs and finance teams for ERP deployment and engage them in designing processes.
* Facilitate design workshops and process validation sessions with country finance teams and driving consensus.
* Serve as the key liaison between Group Finance, the implementation partner, ITCo and Group IT on all functional and process matters.
* Support the change management workstream by contributing to training design, communications, and readiness assessments.



  





 Data \& Reporting Standards
 


* Define master data standards for key financial data entities including the chart of accounts, cost centres, supplier master, customer master etc to support a standardized one ERP data structure across the group
* Establish Group\-wide ERP reporting requirements, defining what reports every entity produces, in what format, and to what timelines to monitor each process and KPIs.
* Define Dashboards and KPIs for Finance processes and analytics to gain visibility of such processes across the group and optimize processes
* Work with the data migration team to ensure mapping from legacy systems to the new CoA and data structures is accurate and complete.



  





 Programme Governance
 


* Represent process and functional workstreams in programme governance forums, providing clear status updates and escalating risks and issues promptly.
* Manage a small team of functional analysts and process specialists, providing direction, quality oversight, and development support.
* Contribute to the phased rollout strategy, supporting the design, pilot, and replication approach across operating entities.



  




* **REPORTING LINES** 
 You will report to the Group Director of Finance Transformation



  





**COMPETENCIES \& REQUIREMENTS** 



* Professional accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent).
* Minimum 8 years of post\-qualification experience in finance, with at least 5 years in a process design, ERP implementation, or finance transformation context.
* Demonstrable experience as a functional lead on at least one full\-cycle ERP implementation.
* Deep knowledge of core finance processes: R2R, P2P, O2C, and Treasury.
* Experience working in or with multi\-country, multi\-currency group structures.
* Strong facilitation and stakeholder management skills, able to work with Group teams and country CFO and finance teams.
* Highly structured and analytical, able to produce clear, professional process documentation and functional specifications
* Key competencies: Process Leadership, ERP Expertise, Take Ownership, Ability to influence, Structured thinking, Results oriented
* Willingness to travel in Africa

data.jd_text:
**About the Company**
 Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
   

  

 Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2\.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70\+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.
   

  

***We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem\-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.***
**About The Role**
 As a Program Manager within the Product organisation, you will be the bridge that brings colleagues together to deliver complex, cross\-functional technical initiatives — often with tight deadlines and multi\-layered dependencies. You will build relationships grounded in trust and integrity across the organisation and with third\-party partners, enabling you to break through collaboration barriers, resolve conflicts, and manage risks effectively.
   

  

 This role sits within the Rides Product team, which leads product strategy and delivery for the Rides vertical to simplify mobility for customers. You will play a critical role ensuring complex programmes land on time, to a high standard, and with full visibility across the organisation — including across third\-party integration boundaries.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Work closely with engineers, product managers, designers, researchers, data analysts, commercial leaders, and operations teams to conceptualise cross\-functional initiatives with layered dependencies and plan their execution
* Organise and align multiple stakeholders — including third\-party partners — to drive timely, accountable execution
* Develop a solid understanding of the technical architecture to exercise sound judgment on risks, trade\-offs, and cross\-team dependencies
* Drive progress transparency through structured communication of status, blockers, and upcoming milestones across all levels of the organisation
* Lead incident coordination, post\-mortems, and closure of action items to build systemic resilience over time
* Own go\-live orchestration for major launches — including rollout gates, rollback triggers, and cross\-functional readiness sign\-offs
* Track and flag resourcing risks to support delivery pace and quality
* Maintain the programme's source of truth: decision logs, dependency registers, and status documentation
* Contribute to process improvement within the programme scope — identifying friction points and proposing better ways of working
* Support and contribute to tools and dashboards that surface delivery health, pace, and quality for the Rides vertical
* Embed AI tooling into core programme workflows — synthesizing meeting intelligence, surfacing dependency risks, and maintaining high\-quality stakeholder comms at pace — and actively raise the team's capability to do the same


**What You'll Need**
* 5\+ years of experience as a Program Manager in a fast\-paced engineering organisation
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand distributed systems and architectural trade\-offs
* Background in fundamental engineering concepts including SSDLC, testing methodologies, API monitoring metrics, and SLAs
* Proficiency with Agile delivery frameworks (Scrum, SAFe, or equivalent)
* Experience managing programmes with significant third\-party integration dependencies
* Familiarity with programme management and analytics tooling (e.g. Jira, Confluence, dashboarding tools)
* Operationally fluent with AI tools: for programme synthesis, risk stress\-testing, and communication
* Deep familiarity with the delivery complexity of programmes with significant external API and third\-party integration dependencies — including SLA implications, incident ownership boundaries, and rollback constraints across organisational lines
* Strong communication skills — able to distil complex information clearly for both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Demonstrated ability to work across multiple teams and manage cross\-organisational stakeholders
* Proven ability to operate with confidence in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments with frequent priority shifts
* Passionate problem solver who adapts their approach to evolving requirements and organisational contexts


**What We’ll Provide You**
 We offer colleagues the opportunity to drive impact in the region while they learn and grow. As a full time Careem colleague, you will be able to:
   

  

* Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.
* Put your passion to work in a purposeful organisation dedicated to creating impact in a region with a lot of untapped potential.
* Explore new opportunities to learn and grow every day.
* Work remotely from any country in the world for 30 days a year with unlimited vacation days per year.
* Access to healthcare benefits and fitness reimbursements for health activities including gym, health club, and training classes.

data.jd_text:
**Job Role** 




 The Chief Executive Officer (CEO) will provide visionary leadership and strategic direction for a diversified Shipping, Logistics, Supply Chain, Freight, and Warehousing business. The role is responsible for driving sustainable growth, profitability, operational excellence, business expansion, and organizational transformation while ensuring the achievement of short\- and long\-term strategic objectives.
 



  





 The CEO will oversee all aspects of the business, including commercial operations, supply chain management, logistics, freight forwarding, warehousing, financial performance, customer experience, people leadership, and business development. The successful candidate will play a critical role in expanding market presence, identifying new growth opportunities, and strengthening the organization's position as a leading logistics solutions provider.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Strategic Leadership \& Corporate Direction** 



* Develop and execute the company's long\-term vision, growth strategy, and business plans.
* Lead the organization in achieving sustainable growth, profitability, and competitive advantage.
* Identify emerging industry trends, market opportunities, and potential risks impacting the business.
* Drive innovation, digital transformation, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Establish strategic objectives and ensure alignment across all departments and business units.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including customers, partners, government entities, and industry leaders.



  





**Business Growth \& Expansion** 



* Identify new business opportunities, markets, and revenue streams.
* Lead market expansion initiatives across local, regional, and international markets.
* Evaluate acquisitions, partnerships, joint ventures, and strategic alliances to support growth objectives.
* Develop and implement commercial strategies to increase market share and strengthen competitive positioning.
* Drive customer acquisition, retention, and overall business development initiatives.



  





**Operational Excellence** 



* Oversee end\-to\-end logistics, shipping, warehousing, and supply chain operations.
* Ensure efficient utilization of assets, resources, infrastructure, and technology platforms.
* Promote continuous improvement initiatives to enhance productivity, service quality, and operational effectiveness.
* Ensure operational performance meets established KPIs, service levels, and customer expectations.
* Drive best\-in\-class safety, quality, and compliance standards across the organization.



  





**Financial Management \& Governance** 



* Lead the development and execution of annual budgets, business plans, and financial forecasts.
* Ensure achievement of revenue, profitability, and cash flow objectives.
* Optimize working capital, asset utilization, and overall financial performance.
* Monitor business performance and implement corrective actions when required.
* Present business performance, strategic plans, and key initiatives to the Board and stakeholders.
* Ensure sound corporate governance, risk management, and regulatory compliance.



  





**Leadership \& People Management** 



* Build, lead, and inspire a high\-performing executive leadership team.
* Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and customer focus.
* Develop succession plans and leadership development programs.
* Drive organizational effectiveness and workforce planning initiatives.
* Promote employee engagement, diversity, and a strong performance\-driven culture.
* Mentor senior leaders and ensure the organization attracts and retains top talent.



  





**Customer \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Strengthen relationships with key clients and strategic partners.
* Drive customer\-centric strategies to improve client satisfaction and long\-term business growth.
* Represent the organization at industry forums, conferences, and strategic business engagements.
* Build the company's reputation and brand presence within the logistics and shipping industry.



  





**Risk Management \& Compliance** 



* Ensure compliance with all applicable local and international regulations governing shipping and logistics operations.
* Establish effective risk management frameworks and business continuity plans.
* Oversee ESG, health, safety, environmental, and quality initiatives across the organization.
* Implement policies and controls to safeguard company assets and reputation.



  





**Candidate Profile** 




**Education** 



* Master's Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Maritime Studies, Operations Management, or a related discipline.
* Executive leadership certifications and professional memberships are advantageous.



  





**Experience** 



* Minimum 20\+ years of progressive experience within Shipping, Logistics, Supply Chain, Freight Forwarding, Transportation, Port Operations, or related sectors.
* Minimum 5\-10 years in a CEO, Managing Director, General Manager, Business Unit Head, or equivalent executive leadership role.
* Demonstrated success in scaling businesses, driving profitability, and leading organizational transformation.
* Experience managing large\-scale, multi\-site, or multi\-country operations is highly desirable.
* GCC/UAE experience preferred.



  





**Key Competencies** 



* Strategic Vision \& Business Acumen
* Executive Leadership
* Commercial \& Financial Management
* Business Development \& Expansion
* Supply Chain \& Logistics Expertise
* Stakeholder \& Relationship Management
* Corporate Governance
* Change Management \& Transformation
* Decision\-Making \& Problem Solving
* Negotiation \& Influencing Skills
* Risk Management
* Customer\-Centric Leadership



  





**Personal Attributes** 



* Visionary and entrepreneurial leader.
* Results\-oriented with a strong commercial mindset.
* Highly proactive and resilient.
* Strong executive presence and communication skills.
* Exceptional interpersonal and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Able to lead through change and drive business transformation.
* High integrity, professionalism, and accountability.

With a fully SFC\-licensed Hong Kong headquarters, they are ac
data.jd_text:
Our client is a well\-established Hong Kong\-based regulated securities brokerage firm with core expertise in Hong Kong \& US equities trading, serving institutional investors, family offices and high\-net\-worth individuals across Asia. With a fully SFC\-licensed Hong Kong headquarters, they are accelerating global expansion and prioritizing the Middle East as their key strategic growth market. To lead our ground\-up market entry, they are hiring a seasoned executive to serve as our Chief Operating Officer for the Middle East region, reporting directly to the Group CEO in Hong Kong.
 



  





 Location: Long\-term base in UAE, regular Hong Kong HQ alignment.
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 As the regional COO for Middle East, you will act as the core executive driving our full market launch across DIFC / ADGM. Your
 **\#1 critical mandate is end\-to\-end ownership of securing a securities brokerage license from DFSA or FSRA** 
 , enabling our regulated offering of HK \& US stock brokerage services in the UAE. You will oversee full greenfield setup of the Middle East office, build and lead the local cross\-functional team, own all regional daily operations, and maintain seamless cross\-regional alignment with our Hong Kong headquarters.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Regulatory Licensing \& Compliance
 


* Own full lifecycle of securities license application for DIFC (DFSA Category 3A Broker) or ADGM (FSRA Securities Broker); formulate and execute the licensing roadmap and strategy
* Serve as the primary official liaison with DFSA, FSRA, SCA and all UAE financial regulators for all inquiries, document submissions, hearings and ongoing supervisory communications
* Lead drafting and compilation of complete licensing submission materials: business plan, compliance manuals, risk management frameworks, financial forecasts, governance structures and policy documents
* Establish robust regional compliance frameworks aligned with UAE regulatory standards, covering AML, CTF, KYC, client asset protection and market conduct rules
* Sustain continuous post\-licensing compliance: deliver periodic regulatory filings, coordinate regulatory inspections, and update internal policies to match evolving supervisory requirements



  





 2\. End\-to\-End Middle East Regional Operations Management
 


* Lead full greenfield office establishment in DIFC or ADGM: entity incorporation, office tenancy, corporate bank account opening, local vendor onboarding and admin infrastructure setup
* Recruit, train, mentor and manage the full local team (trading, compliance, operations, sales \& client servicing); build a localized, self\-sufficient regional operating team
* Take full P\&L and operational accountability for all regional workflows: trade execution, settlement \& clearing, client onboarding, risk monitoring, HR, legal and daily admin
* Design, standardize and optimize end\-to\-end client lifecycle workflows from account opening through trading and post\-trade settlement to boost operational efficiency and risk mitigation
* Lead selection, deployment and ongoing oversight of regional trading, risk control and back\-office technology systems, collaborating with Hong Kong tech teams on integration



  





 3\. HK \& US Equities Business Development in Middle East
 


* Develop and execute go\-to\-market strategy for HK \& US brokerage services, including client segmentation, product localization, pricing framework and growth KPIs
* Lead institutional client acquisition and relationship management across the Middle East: sovereign wealth funds, pension funds, family offices, hedge funds and ultra\-high\-net\-worth individuals
* Drive product localization adjustments to match regional investor preferences, enhance client service experience and expand market penetration



  





 Mandatory Qualifications \& Requirements
 


* **Language : Chinese is mandatory** 
 (core requirement), with cross\-border financial business cognition and ability to efficiently connect Hong Kong headquarters and Middle East local business.
* Minimum 10 years of progressive experience within securities brokerage, investment banking or global financial services; minimum 5 years in senior leadership roles at VP level or above.
* Hands\-on, proven track record leading Middle East financial license applications (DFSA / DIFC or FSRA / ADGM preferred), with deep knowledge of submission workflows, regulator expectations and negotiation practices.
* Comprehensive expertise in HK \& US equity brokerage value chains (trade execution, clearing, settlement, client regulation) with solid understanding of Hong Kong SFC regulatory regime.
* Bachelor’s degree or above in Finance, Economics, Law, Accounting or other relevant financial disciplines.
* Fluent written and spoken English \& Mandarin; both languages to be used as primary working languages.
* Geographic flexibility: based long\-term in the Middle East, accept frequent regional travel, and conduct regular monthly/quarterly reporting visits to Hong Kong HQ.

data.jd_text:
**Job Summary**
* The Global Trading Operations (GTO) brings together the Global Markets Middle Office Team, In\-Country Markets Operations, Markets Reference Data, Markets Trade Control \& Supervision and the CoE footprint to foster consistency in client and business face\-off across products and geographies.
* Reporting directly to the Global Head of Trading Operations and Int Markets Oversight, the successful candidate will lead the Global Trading Middle Offices for Credit (Credit Flow \& Repo, Structured Credit, Loans, Issuance, GCM). The candidate will manage an organisation of c.65 employees across NYC, London, Warsaw, Dubai, Bangalore, Singapore, KL, Hong Kong.
* The Global Markets Middle Office is a trusted partner to the business and delivers operational efficiency and superior risk management practices, providing critical trade support to Front Office whilst generating data\-led actionable insights to drive informed decision\-making.
* Key services include Trade Capture, Trade Lifecycle Management, Exception Mgmt., Deal Mgmt, Project Mgmt., Risk \& Control Governance, T0 Control Performance, Relationship / Stakeholder Mgmt. and Industry Representation.


**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**
* Instil effective and robust operating models within the Global Credit Middle Office
* Incorporate strong risk \& control frameworks, clear \& concise policies \& procedures, and optimal business\-as\-usual (BAU) processes to ensure alignment with the latest regulatory \& industry standards.
* Delivery of the roadmap aligned with the strategy for Middle Office, which incorporates principles from the Process \& Controls Simplification programme, Re\-platforming agenda and Fit for Growth (FFG) strategy.
* Represent the Global Credit and Commodities Middle Office in key business meetings \& forums.
* Provide effective challenge across the organisation to ensure remediation actions, organisational design and technology development / implementation is best\-in\-class \& covering all scenarios.
* Become a trusted advisor to Credit Senior FO mgmt. to enable their strategy and vision.


**Business**
* Management of the Global Credit Middle Office Group across US, UK, Europe, Dubai, Singapore, Hong Kong, Malaysia, and India
* Optimise the Follow the Sun (FTS) model in Middle Office functions to ensure exceptional levels of business enablement and client service.
* Drive global consistency and transparency by defining and maintaining a premium catalogue of services and capability matrix.
* Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Markets businesses operates.
* Drive new business initiatives to aid revenue and growth priorities. Promote controlled growth through enabling efficient processes and effective controls.


**Processes**
* Ownership and stewardship of the Middle Office catalogue of services and process universe
* Including, but not limited to, Trade Capture, Lifecycle Processing, Exception Mgmt., Query Management, Client Liaison and Service Delivery, Project Mgmt.
* Document best practices and guidance for process execution – Integrate standardised, globally consistent approaches across Credit \& Commodities
* Provide direction to processing and control functions within Middle Office to create high performing, effective teams.
* Optimise and automate processes to reduce exposure to manual and operational risk intensive processes.


**People \& Talent**
* Manage performance effectively through 1\-2\-1s and skip meetings.
* Promote a speak up culture within the team and host regular team feedback sessions.
* Engagement – Foster a one team culture.
* Ensure alignment with Span of Control guidelines and de\-layer the organisation.
* Be a strong culture carrier for the organisation, model the behaviours desired in Middle Office


**Risk Management**
* Define strategy for processes and technology needed for controlled growth.
* Regular review of the control framework to progress towards a preventative, and automated control landscape.
* Own, drive, and / or participate in remediation programs to mitigate risk to the business.
* Develop and maintain documentation that will provide minimum standards and guidance for all Middle Office R\&Rs
* Ensure adherence to the Enterprise Risk and Operational Risk Frameworks


**Governance**
* Embed strong \& effective governance principles across the Middle Office organisation.
* Develop metrics to monitor business processes, and to supply indicators of risk and performance.
* Model supervisory behaviours and embed into BAU across span of control.
* Provide effective challenge on forums, above and beyond those owned by Global Credit Middle Office.
* Live and breathe the \#NeverSettle value.


**Regulatory \& Business Conduct**
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate, and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
* Provide leadership within the Middle Office organisation to comply with the highest standards of regulatory and business conduct and practices as defined by internal and external requirements.
* Takes a proactive approach to implementing Just Culture and emphasising the importance of the groups’ valued behaviours regularly through retrospective sessions with the team and Channels townhall sessions.
* Embed the Group’s Values and Group Code of Conduct to ensure adherence with the highest standards of ethics. Comply with relevant policies, processes, and regulations, as part of the culture.


**Our Ideal Candidate**
**Qualifications**
* Strong understanding of IB / Markets businesses, product life cycle, and the operating environment
* Previous experience in leading global teams across the Operations lifecycle – Global Middle Office Management, Operations Lead, Risk Mgmt.
* Evidenced track record of high\-profile project delivery (Regulatory, External / Internal Policy, Industry Standards, Technology)
* Leadership \- Strong personal brand with the gravitas and presence to create a movement.
* External network with awareness of the latest industry developments
* Strategic mindset \& forward\-thinking vision
* Strength in problem solving, process re\-engineering and project management.
* Data\-driven mindset – Able to use data to produce a “story” and present a roadmap / solution to target state.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Influencing skills – Able to simplify complex problems / scenarios to a wide audience and gain stakeholder buy\-in


**Role Specific Technical Competencies**
* Market Industry Knowledge
* Process Design \& Re\-engineering
* Data Analysis
* Client Service \& Experience
* Risk \& Controls
* Presentation Skill
* People Management Skill


**About Standard Chartered**
 We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
   

  

 Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
   

  

**Together We**

* Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term


**What We Offer**
**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,** 
 we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
   

  

* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time\-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.

* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.

 Lead the operational operating model of a regulated retail investment platform, ensuring the business can safely scale client growth, maintain robust outsourcing governance, deliver reliable platform operations, and demonstrate strong operational resilience and control.  ‍

 You will work across Last Mile, Middle Mile, and Under\-The\-Roof (UTR) operations to find inefficiencies, build the business case, and drive cross\-functional execution.  The right candidate is analytically sharp, comfortable with ambiguity, and operates with a bias for action. You think in systems, not silos. You’re as comfortable in the data as you are in a room with senior stakeholders making the case for change.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Store Capacity \& Cost Management
   

  

* Own programmes to optimise store capacity utilization, including bin density, ASIN rationalisation, gas tank management, and space allocation across darkstores.
* Drive cost\-per\-order reduction across the end\-to\-end operation: UTR pick efficiency, DA (Delivery Associate) productivity, hub\-to\-store transhipment costs, and middle mile truck utilisation.
* Analyse operational cost structures to identify the highest\-leverage opportunities for unit economics improvement. Build business cases with clear ROI and execution plans.
* Partner with UTR, Last Mile, and Middle Mile teams to implement changes that reduce waste, improve throughput, and lower cost\-to\-serve without degrading customer experience.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting mechanisms to track capacity utilisation and cost metrics across KSA stores.


 Delivery Speed \& Click\-to\-Door (C2D)
   

  

* Own the programme roadmap for C2D reduction, identifying bottlenecks across order acceptance, pick \& pack, dispatch, and last mile delivery.
* Analyse delivery defects, early delivery marking, Did\-Not\-Receive (DNR) patterns, and other CX pain points to drive root cause resolution.
* Identify and eliminate handoff delays between UTR, Middle Mile, and Last Mile that contribute to C2D inflation.


 Project \& Programme Delivery
   

  

* Scope, plan, and execute operational improvement projects end\-to\-end, from opportunity identification through to measurable business impact.
* Build and manage a portfolio of initiatives across capacity, cost, and speed, with clear prioritisation based on CX and P\&L impact.
* Create mechanisms for project tracking, stakeholder communication, and escalation. Maintain a clear view of project status, risks, and dependencies.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment with ACES, Tech, Finance, Category, and operations teams to remove blockers and deliver on commitments.
* Contribute to the development of scalable solutions that can be replicated across KSA stores, solve once, scale everywhere.


 Cross\-Functional Influence \& Visibility
   

  

* Operate as the connective tissue between operational channels, ensuring improvements in one area don’t create problems in another.
* Build visibility into operational performance through data, dashboards, and regular reporting cadences (WBR/MBR contributions).
* Influence without authority, drive outcomes through data\-backed recommendations, clear communication, and stakeholder management.
* Support Automation \& AI initiatives that drive efficiency, reduce manual effort, and improve decision\-making across operations.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Master's degree
* Experience in program requirements definition, together with data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 5\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL

**Summary:** 




 The role holder should be a highly experienced and visionary Technology and Operations Transformation leader who will be responsible for leading the technology and operations transformation of Amicorp Fund Services ("AMIF") globally, driving innovation, efficiency, and scalability across all operational areas. **OPERATIONAL TRANSFORMATION AND MANAGEMENT:**

* Develop and implement global systems and processes which increase the efficiency of the organization and its offices
* Provide strategic leadership and oversight of all operational functions of Amicorp Fund Services

* Identify opportunities for process improvements, automation, and cost savings through the effective use of technology and operational best practices

data.raw_snippet:

data.jd_text:
**About Moove**
 Moove is one of the world's fastest\-growing mobility infrastructure companies.
   

  

 We finance and supply vehicles to mobility platforms across Africa, the Middle East, Asia, and Latin America and we're building the infrastructure layer that the next generation of mobility will depend on. The company is pre\-IPO, operating at scale across multiple geographies, and moving through one of the most consequential phases of its growth.
   

  

 The pace is fast and the stakes are high. The decisions being made now will define the company for a decade. We are building the next phase of this business to be AI\-native from the ground up and the people around the leadership table need to be operating at their best.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Director of Strategy \& Operations serves as a trusted partner to the Co\-CEO and President, ensuring that ambitious growth plans are executable, aligned, and supported across the organisation. The role will be crucial in operationalizing the vision of Moove.
   

  

 On the execution side, this role owns the operating rhythm of the leadership team, converts strategic direction into clear accountabilities, and ensures decisions are structured, actioned, and embedded across business units. On the strategic side, the Director of Strategy \& Operations researches and constructs long\-term corporate strategy, embeds governance and decision rights, and provides forward\-looking scenario analysis to feed into any corporate planning.
   

  

 Because much of the company’s operating infrastructure is still being built, this role carries significant build responsibility. The Director of Strategy \& Operations will design the ways of working, stand up performance frameworks, and embed the OKR and scorecard systems through which the business runs. This is an execution role with strategic range, the ratio matters, and the ceiling is high.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 Strategy and Governance
   

  

* Research, construct, and support the development of long\-term corporate strategy in partnership with the Co\-CEO and President; ensure it is cascaded into business unit priorities through structured communication channels including town halls, leadership briefings, and BU\-level planning.
* Operationalise the operating model, ensuring business units are aligned, accountable, and able to deliver against growth priorities
* Guide the decentralisation effort, embedding governance structures and clear decision rights across business units
* Partner with senior functional leaders to identify and close capability gaps that impact business performance
* Provide forward\-looking scenario analysis to feed into future strategy


 Operating Rhythm and Execution
   

  

* Own the executive operating rhythm, leadership meetings, offsites, board and committee reviews, ensuring decisions are structured, actioned, and embedded
* Translate strategic direction into clear actions, owners, and timelines across the organisation; hold stakeholders accountable to commitments
* Identify and remove blockers; drive stalled decisions to resolution with pace and rigour
* Facilitate integration across functions and business units, aligning resources and priorities to avoid silos
* Identify and escalate risks that may impact business performance or growth, ensuring mitigation plans are in place


 Performance and Organizational Effectiveness
   

  

* Embed OKRs and business performance scorecards in collaboration with the People Team; provide data\-driven insights to the Co\-CEO and executive team to inform decisions
* Ensure business performance outcomes are supported by aligned people performance priorities
* Manage information flow to and from the Co\-CEO, surface what requires attention and filter what does not


**Strategic Outputs**
* Prepare and own high\-stakes outputs: board materials, investor updates, strategic documents, and executive briefings
* Lead specific strategic and operational workstreams directly when required, including platform development and capital markets preparation
* Identify and deploy AI tools and workflows to increase the velocity and quality of the Co\-CEO’s office


**Experience**
**What You will need for this position**
* 6–10 years of experience owning outcomes in high\-growth or high\-complexity environments
* Prior experience as a Chief of Staff, Director of Strategy \& Operations, COO, or senior operator at a high\-velocity technology company, or equivalent seniority from top\-tier strategy consulting with demonstrated operational delivery
* Experience building or running a critical function through a period of rapid growth, transformation, or M\&A activity
* Demonstrable track record of closing things, decisions, commitments, workstreams, at pace and without loss of quality


**Skills And Capabilities**
* Exceptional written communication; produces board\-quality documents, strategic memos, and executive briefings independently
* Ability to process complexity quickly, communicate it clearly, and operate with minimal direction
* Genuinely AI\-native; uses AI to increase personal and team velocity, with experience managing AI\-enabled workflows or operating system design
* Sufficient fluency across technology, capital markets, and business transformation to engage credibly across Moove’s active workstreams
* Strong product and technology instincts; understands how software is built, how platforms scale, and how technology and physical operations intersect
* Sound judgment on when to act independently and when to escalate
* Available across geographies and time zones as required


**What Does Success Look Like**
* The Co\-CEO and President’s office operates as a high\-performance execution engine, no decisions stall, no commitments drop
* The company’s operating cadence is designed, implemented, and running effectively within the first 90 days
* OKRs and performance scorecards are embedded and generating actionable insights for the executive team
* Governance structures and decision rights are documented and operational across all business units
* Board and investor outputs are produced on time, to a consistently high standard
* Strategic workstreams move faster and with greater clarity as a direct result of this role’s involvement


**Who You'll Be Working with:**
 Directly reporting to our CO\-CEO \& President, and closely working with our office of the CEO team.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our team is collaborative, positive, curious, and engaged. We think fast, work smart, laugh often, and are looking for like\-minded people to join us in our mission to disrupt vehicle ownership and make financial freedom within reach.
   

  

 Moove is strongly committed to diversity within its community. The Company’s approved Employment Equity Plan and Targets will be considered as part of the recruitment process. As an Equal Opportunities employer, we welcome people from all backgrounds who seek the opportunity to help build a future where everyone and everything can move independently.
   

  

**Pre\-hiring Notice:** 
 Moove relies on the accuracy of information contained in employment applications, as well as the accuracy of other data presented throughout the hiring process and during employment. Any misrepresentations, falsifications, or material omissions in any information or data provided by an applicant may result in the applicant being excluded from further consideration for employment or if an individual has already been hired, termination of employment.
   

  

**EEO Statement:** 
 Moove is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, race, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, political affiliation or any other protected characteristic.

 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective
data.jd_text:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.
 



 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.
 



 Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.
 



 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
 
 our wins – big and small.
 



 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next \- together!
 



**Are you ready to lead from the front?** 




 Anaplan is on a mission to revolutionise business planning, and our Presales team is the engine of that ambition. We are looking for a visionary and strategic leader to take the helm of our high\-performing Solution Consulting team in the UAE.
 



 This isn't just a management role; it's a chance to be a pivotal member of the EMEA Go\-To\-Market and EMEA Presales leadership teams. You will be the architect of our regional success, empowering a team of up to 8 brilliant individuals to push boundaries, challenge the status quo, and drive customer success. If you thrive in a culture that embraces diverse perspectives and rewards bold ideas, we want to hear from you.
 



**Your Impact** 




 You won't just be managing a team; you'll be building a legacy. As a business partner to our sales leaders, you will:
 


* **Shape the Vision:** 
  Craft and execute a winning regional strategy for the Solution Consulting team, aligning your vision with our EMEA and global goals.
* **Drive Transformational Change:** 
 Act as a change agent, driving operational excellence and transforming the Germany Solution Consulting team to new heights of performance and agility.
* **Master the Business:** 
  Take ownership of the regional Book of Business, ensuring tight account alignment and accountability across your team to maximise our impact.
* **Lead with Agility:** 
  Proactively partner with regional sales teams to strategically allocate Presales resources, pivot engagement strategies, and drive a winning momentum.
* **Build a World\-Class Team:** 
  Be a magnet for top talent. You will hire, mentor, and develop a team of high\-readiness professionals, defining clear career paths to foster retention and growth.
* **Forge Key Relationships:** 
 Make a direct impact on our UKI business by building unshakeable trust and credibility with key stakeholders at our most strategic customers and partners.



**Your Qualifications** 




 You are a leader who can both strategise from 30,000 feet and execute flawlessly on the ground. You bring:
 


* **Deep Domain Expertise:** 
  Hands\-on knowledge of SaaS applications.
* Specific experience in EPM/CPM\-based technologies, preferably around FP\&A or Supply Chain platforms (preferred).
* **Proven Presales Leadership:** 
  Demonstrable experience managing and inspiring a team of individual Presales contributors while navigating a complex, multi\-stakeholder sales environment. Ideally you will have grown and managed a team in the region.
* **Regional Experience:** 
 A track record of successfully managing a team in UAE or the middle East.
* **A Change\-Maker's Mindset:** 
  You have led teams through transformation and are comfortable driving and managing change.
* **A Player\-Coach Mentality:** 
  The ability to both lead and execute, rolling up your sleeves to help your team win.
* **A Fluent Arabic Speaker** 
 required for this role.



 If you're ready to make your mark and lead a team at the forefront of business transformation, let's talk.
 



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!
 



 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  
 



**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** 
  
 



 It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.
 



 Anaplan does not:  
 


* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.



 All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

1\. Position Overview
 



 As a core member of CoinW's executive leadership team, the COO will oversee the establishment and execution of the exchange's global operations framework. Working closely with the CEO to define corporate strategy and drive execution, this role is responsible for efficiency improvement and performance delivery across operations, product, marketing, customer support, and compliance operations, supporting the exchange's global expansion and business growth objectives.
 



 2\. Key Responsibilities
 



 Strategy \& Business Management
 


* Collaborate with the CEO to develop the company's mid\-to\-long\-term strategy and annual business targets, cascade goals across business lines, and drive execution; own overall operational KPIs including user growth, trading volume, retention, and revenue.
* Establish business analytics and dashboard systems, deliver regular operational health reports, and conduct business reviews with the Board and executive team to proactively identify business risks and propose optimization solutions.
* Orchestrate cross\-functional resources across product, engineering, marketing, risk, compliance, and finance to improve overall organizational efficiency.



 Operations System Building
 


* Build and optimize the exchange's end\-to\-end operations framework, including user operations, campaign operations, content operations, community operations, and VIP operations.
* Lead the formulation of global multi\-regional operations strategies, design localized operation plans for key markets (Middle East, Southeast Asia, Europe, Latin America, etc.), and drive regional user acquisition and trading activity growth.
* Establish operations SOPs and standardized processes, drive tooling, data\-driven, and automation upgrades to continuously improve operational efficiency.



 Product \& User Growth
 


* Collaborate with the product team to define product priorities and roadmap, surface product requirements from an operations perspective, and drive implementation to continuously optimize user experience and conversion funnels.
* Own the full user lifecycle management, build the acquisition–activation–retention–monetization–referral growth model, and drive core metric growth.
* Oversee the key account/VIP user operations system to improve high\-net\-worth user retention and ARPU.



 Marketing \& Brand Alignment
 


* Align with the Head of Marketing on global integrated marketing strategies to ensure operations campaigns are synchronized with brand cadence and drive efficient traffic conversion.
* Oversee operations conversion across KOL, community, and media channels, establish channel performance measurement systems, and optimize ROI.
* Participate in business negotiation and execution of major industry events and strategic partnerships.



 Organization \& Team Management
 


* Build and develop a global operations team (estimated 30–50 headcount), establish talent pipelines and performance management systems.
* Optimize organizational structure and collaboration workflows to enable efficient cross\-regional and cross\-functional coordination.
* Shape the operations team culture, fostering a data\-driven, results\-oriented, and fast\-iterative team environment.



 Compliance \& Risk Alignment
 


* Work with the Risk and Compliance teams to ensure all operations activities meet regulatory requirements across jurisdictions, balancing business growth with compliance risk.
* Participate in the design and implementation of AML, KYC, user suitability, and other compliance operations processes.



 3\. Requirements
 



 Basic Qualifications
 


* 8\+ years of operations experience in internet, fintech, or crypto; 3\+ years in team leadership or senior management roles.
* Prior experience as COO / VP of Operations / Director of Operations at a crypto exchange, brokerage, fintech platform, or payment company is strongly preferred.
* Bachelor's degree or above in finance, economics, computer science, business, or related fields.



 Professional Competencies
 


* Deep understanding of crypto exchange business models and industry ecosystem; familiarity with core product logic including spot, futures, and derivatives.
* Proven user growth methodology with successful track records of building operations systems from scratch or driving scaled growth.
* Strong data acumen and analytical capabilities; ability to drive business decisions through data; proficiency in data analysis tools.
* Global mindset with multi\-market operations experience; familiarity with Middle East, Southeast Asia, or European market characteristics is a plus.



 Soft Skills
 


* Balanced strategic thinking and execution capability — able to contribute to top\-level design and lead teams to deliver results.
* Exceptional cross\-functional coordination and execution ability to integrate resources and achieve goals in complex environments.
* High stress tolerance; able to adapt to the 24/7 fast\-paced and volatile crypto industry.
* Professional working proficiency in English for international business communication.



 4\. Preferred Qualifications
 


* Previous core operations experience at top\-tier exchanges.
* End\-to\-end experience building overseas exchange operations teams from zero to one.
* Established local networks and resources in the Middle East, North Africa, or Southeast Asia.
* Compliance operations background with CAMS, ACAMS, or related anti\-money laundering certifications.
* Startup experience with hands\-on system\-building experience.

Vantor is forging the new frontier of spatial intelligence, helping decision makers and operators navigate what’s happening now and shape what’s coming next.
