Come be part of a mission, not just a job, where you can: Shape your own future, build the next big thing, and change the world.
   

  

**Please review the job details below.**
 We are hiring a
 **General Manager (GM), Sovereign Satellite Product Line \& Commercialization** 
 to serve as the global leader for Vantor’s next\-generation Pulse satellite constellation. This senior executive will own the entire global lifecycle of the Sovereign Satellite product line—bridging the gap between international commercial capture and final program delivery.
   

  

 The GM will combine deep global market knowledge, regulatory insights, and competitive intelligence with the technical acumen necessary to steer engineering, production, and execution teams. This leader will help build the Sovereign Satellite portfolio into a standalone, scalable business unit globally, collaborating cross\-functionally with Product, Engineering, Operations, Finance, and regional sales teams to ensure that when sovereign programs are captured, they are successfully executed, localized, and delivered on time.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Executive Leadership \& Product Line Governance**
* End\-to\-End Program Ownership: Own the ultimate delivery and execution roadmap for the sovereign satellite product line globally, transitioning programs seamlessly from design and development into production, launch, and delivery.
* Cross\-Functional Delivery Authority: Drive delivery responsibility across the global partner base; act as one of the key decision\-makers on delivery slots, backlog prioritization, and resource allocation in coordination with technical teams.
* P\&L and Business Unit Management: Establish the cross\-functional structure, KPIs, and operational frameworks required to build the sovereign satellite business as a high\-performing, and ultimately standalone product line on a global scale.
* Matrixed Alignment: Bridge the gap between GTM teams and engineering/constellation build teams to build a unified, cross\-functional delivery machine.


**Global GTM \& Commercial Architecture**
* Global GTM Strategy: Define and execute the worldwide GTM strategy, market segmentation, route\-to\-market, and strategic prioritization across all key international regions.
* Pricing, Packaging \& Monetization: Design, operationalize, and iterate complex commercial models (e.g., subscription capacity, tasking\-as\-a\-service, tiered access, and enterprise/sovereign bundles) tailored for international defense and civil ministries.
* Sales Enablement \& Execution: Build institutional hunting playbooks, capture strategies, and standardized pricing tools. Partner directly with the company’s ELT and the Regional Sales VPs worldwide as the executive commercial lead to shape, position, and close high\-value, complex sovereign pursuits.


**Technical Oversight, Localization \& Industrial Participation**
* Technical \& Market Convergence: Translate complex technical satellite capabilities, payload specifications, and orbital mechanics into high\-value commercial offerings and robust business cases worldwide.
* Sovereign Localization \& Offsets: Design and execute in\-country industrial participation, technology transfer, and offset programs to meet strict country\-specific contracting, regulatory, and licensing requirements globally.
* Ecosystem Development: Build strategic partnerships and cultivate local industrial/technology ecosystems to accelerate international adoption and satisfy sovereign ownership frameworks.
* Lifecycle Planning: Oversee end\-to\-end operational planning, encompassing hardware production, launch integration, on\-orbit commissioning, and local operator training.


**Qualifications**
**Minimum Qualifications**
* Global Senior Leadership Experience: Extensive experience in a GM, Business Unit Leader, or Senior Director role managing complex, high\-value product lines or strategic business units within the satellite, aerospace, defense, or space sectors with a clear international or global scope.
* Proven Delivery Track Record: Demonstrable success not just in closing deals, but in managing the full lifecycle of launching, commercializing, and delivering a new satellite constellation, Earth Observation product, SAR Product, or spatial intelligence platform internationally.
* Market \& Technical Acumen: Strong foundational knowledge of satellite and aerospace technologies paired with an expert\-level understanding of the global GEOINT market, international competitive landscape, and EO and SAR value chains.
* Sovereign Procurement Expertise: Deep understanding of international government procurement, military/civil buying cycles, EXIM limitations, and national security licensing/regulations across multiple regions.
* Financial \& Commercial Mastery: Proven experience designing sophisticated pricing architectures, managing P\&L dynamics, and building data\-driven GTM forecasts.
* Executive Presence: Exceptional communication skills with a track record of serving as a trusted advisor to senior government officials, defense ministries, and global C\-suite executives.
* Willingness to Travel: Ability to travel extensively internationally as required to support key pursuits and global partner reviews.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Established Global Network: Existing high\-level relationships within European, Middle Eastern, APAC, or allied global government space and defense organizations.
* Industrial Participation Expertise: Direct experience managing sovereign localization models, offsets, or complex international joint ventures across diverse regulatory environments.
* Scale Experience: Experience successfully scaling a business unit within a high\-growth technology or aerospace organization, transforming "one\-off" project deliveries into a standardized, repeatable global product line.


**EEO Policy: Vantor is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace. We believe in fostering an environment where all team members feel respected, valued, and encouraged to share their ideas. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.**

 The Program Manager\- Engineering Training Programs leads the planning and delivery of customer\-focused training programs that accelerate product adoption and strengthen technical capability.  Most senior engineering roles are about maintaining something someone else built.
 



  





 This one isn't.
 



  





 We've just come off a briefing with the leadership team of one of the most ambitious aerospace programmes in the world right now, and we need to talk to you. Because if your career has been building towards a moment where you get to stand something up from scratch \- a genuinely novel aircraft, a founding team of world\-class domain engineers, a programme with the kind of commercial backbone that most ventures can only dream about \- this might be it.
 



  





 What is it?
 



 A Director of Engineering \- Platform role on a confidential eVTOL programme based in Dubai South. The aircraft is a next\-generation electric platform designed to deliver life\-saving emergency response capability. Novel configuration. Genuinely unsolved engineering problems. And a mission that, unlike a significant chunk of what the aerospace industry produces, is unambiguously good for the world.
 



  





 The company is both OEM and operator \- they will certify the aircraft and operate a fleet at scale. That combination essentially doesn't exist anywhere else in the industry today. And they're doing it under a 20\-year sovereign customer agreement, which gives this programme the kind of forward visibility that venture\-backed eVTOL companies simply cannot offer.
 



  





 What does the role involve?
 



 You will own engineering operations for the Platform stream. That means building the team, running the technical maturity cadence, managing the gate review rhythm, allocating resources across the domain Chief Engineers, and keeping the programme moving from early architecture through to certification and production. You sit alongside the Chief Engineer \- Platform as an equal counterpart, and you report directly to the CTO.
 



  





 This is not a technical design role. It is a programme execution and people leadership role. The CE decides what gets built. You make sure it gets built.
 



  





 Who are we looking for?
 



 Someone who has led teams of serious engineers \- Chief Engineers or equivalent \- on certified civil aerospace programmes. Someone who has built an engineering organisation in the early stages of a complex programme, not just joined one that was already running. Someone who is comfortable with greenfield ambiguity and thrives in it rather than tolerating it.
 



  





 If you have spent your career in mature OEM programmes with hundreds of engineers and a decades\-old process framework, this will feel different. That's not a warning \- it's a filter. The people who've already joined this programme left very senior roles at very large companies to do it. They did it because the scale of the challenge and the quality of the mission was worth it.
 



  





 The package
 



 Tax\-free in Dubai. Relocation package included. Senior leadership level. Salary details available on application.
 



  





 A note on the location
 



 Dubai South is adjacent to Al Maktoum International Airport \- one of the most significant aviation infrastructure developments in the world. If you have always wanted to be somewhere that takes aerospace seriously, this is it.
 



  





 If this sounds like the kind of opportunity you've been waiting for, apply now or reach out directly. We screen every applicant personally \- no AI filters.
 



  





 We welcome diverse applicants and are dedicated to treating all applicants with dignity and respect, regardless of background.

data.jd_text:
**The Team**
 We are a global, independent, multi\-disciplinary consultancy delivering sustainable engineering and design solutions across the built environment. With over 1,200 engineers and designers across 29 locations, we apply our expertise to local market conditions to deliver resilient, low\-carbon engineering solutions. We are 100% partner\-owned and are proud to have been named Building Magazine’s Engineering Consultant of the Year in 2024, 2022, and 2021\.
   

  

 Our data centre team has been leading mission\-critical design since 2006, delivering over 2,000MW of capacity globally. With a reputation for engineering excellence and sustainability, we’ve partnered with some of the world’s most high\-profile clients to create energy\-efficient, low\-emission data centres that set new standards for resilience and innovation. Recognised as Data Centre Consultancy of the Year in 2025, our team continues to push boundaries in design and delivery.
   

  

 Based in Dubai, this role forms a key part of our growing presence across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA). You will play a central role in establishing and expanding our regional data centre capability, working collaboratively with our global network and local partners.
   

  

**The Role**
 This is a strategic leadership opportunity for an experienced, client\-focused data centre specialist to establish, develop and grow our data centre capability from Dubai, serving clients and projects across the wider MENA region. For the right candidate, this may represent a step up from their current role; they will be supported in making that transition through close collaboration with regional leadership and access to our established global sector experts. The successful candidate will be expected to combine sector credibility, technical leadership and commercial drive to build a sustainable regional business unit.
   

  

 You will be accountable for the full lifecycle of the sector’s growth and delivery: identifying and mapping priority clients, developing opportunities, leading bids and proposals, shaping project strategies, overseeing multidisciplinary design delivery, and ensuring robust quality assurance and quality control throughout each commission.
   

  

 Working closely with regional leadership and our established global data centre specialists, you will set the direction for the MENA offer, develop trusted client relationships, build a high\-performing local team, and ensure that our technical, commercial and service standards are consistently delivered. You will not be expected to do this in isolation: you will have the support, guidance and technical depth of both the regional leadership team and our global network of sector experts.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Establish and grow the data centre business unit in Dubai as a regional platform serving the MENA market.
* Develop a clear regional growth plan, including target markets, priority clients, strategic partners, pipeline opportunities and sector positioning.
* Lead work winning activity, including client mapping, opportunity development, bid strategy, proposal leadership, fee development and commercial negotiation.
* Act as a senior client\-facing representative for the data centre sector, building long\-term relationships with developers, operators, hyperscale clients, investors, contractors and delivery partners.
* Lead multidisciplinary design delivery on data centre projects, ensuring solutions are technically robust, coordinated, buildable, resilient, sustainable and aligned with client requirements.
* Own project delivery governance, including programme, resourcing, risk management, change control, commercial performance, reporting and stakeholder communication.
* Implement and maintain rigorous QA/QC processes, including design reviews, technical approvals, interdisciplinary checks, lessons learned and compliance with relevant standards, codes and Cundall procedures.
* Recruit, mentor and develop engineers and technical specialists, creating a high\-performing team culture that supports growth, accountability and collaboration across the region.


**The Skills**
 You will be a Chartered Engineer, or working towards equivalent professional recognition, educated to degree level in a relevant engineering discipline. You will bring significant consultancy experience, with a proven track record in data centre, mission\-critical, high\-technology or similarly complex MEP\-led projects.
   

  

 The role requires someone who can operate as both a sector leader and a delivery lead: commercially aware, technically credible, highly organised, and confident engaging with senior clients, project teams and regional leadership.
   

  

 You will have demonstrable experience developing client relationships, identifying new opportunities, shaping winning proposals and converting prospects into live commissions. You will also understand how to build delivery teams, set expectations, manage resources and maintain strong commercial performance across multiple concurrent projects.
   

  

 Technically, you will be able to lead and review design outputs, manage multidisciplinary coordination, chair project and design reviews, oversee specifications and reports, and ensure that QA/QC procedures are applied consistently. You will be comfortable balancing hands\-on technical input with strategic leadership, business development and team management responsibilities.

Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As the Director Experience and Operational Excellence you will lead talabat's end\-to\-end experience function across four pillars — Customer Experience, Partner Experience, Fraud Operations, and CX Insights — spanning 8 markets in MENA. You will be accountable for setting and executing multi\-year strategies that drive customer and partner satisfaction, govern multi\-million EUR budgets with direct P\&L impact, and oversee the integrity of the platform through robust fraud governance.
   

  

 This is a high\-impact senior leadership role requiring the ability to operate at both a strategic and executional level — influencing product and commercial roadmaps, shaping cross\-functional policy, and developing a team of senior managers and specialists. You will serve as a key voice in the COO leadership team, championing data\-driven decision\-making, operational excellence, and a culture of continuous improvement.
   

  

 If you are passionate about building world\-class experiences at scale, this role is for you.
   

  

**WHAT’S ON YOUR PLATE?**
**Customer Experience Strategy \& Leadership**
* Own the end\-to\-end CX strategy across all verticals (Food, tMart, Local Shops, DineOut) and 8 MENA markets.
* Define and govern cNPS, cSAT, and other north star metrics — setting targets, driving methodology, and leading cross\-functional execution to move them.
* Translate customer data, behavioral trends, and support signals into prioritized initiatives that improve retention, satisfaction, and order frequency.
* Champion process automation, standardization, and digitalization of key CX workflows.


**Partner Experience \& Budget Governance**
* Oversee talabat's Partner Experience function, ensuring vendor satisfaction (vNPS/vSAT) is treated as a strategic competitive differentiator linked to commercial performance.
* Maintain full accountability for the Functional budgets \- customer and vendor compensation program — a multi\-million EUR annual budget — including annual planning, policy design, market rollout sequencing, and ongoing financial governance.
* Govern the complete portfolio of partner\-facing policies and SOPs across all markets and verticals.


**Fraud Operations \& Risk Governance**
* Provide strategic oversight of talabat's Fraud Operations function, covering prevention, detection, and response frameworks across the ecosystem.
* Ensure fraud governance is aligned with compliance, audit, and legal standards.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment between Fraud, Product, Finance, and Legal to balance risk mitigation with customer experience quality and platform growth.


**Insights \& Analytics**
* Oversee the Insights function, ensuring real\-time visibility into performance across all markets through robust dashboards and structured reporting.
* Champion a data\-first culture across the department — ensuring insights translate into action.
* Partner with BI, Data Science, and Product to build the data infrastructure that underpins reliable departmental performance visibility.
* Run primary research, NPS programs to gather structured, well represented qualitative feedback \- using these to inform local and regional priorities


**People Leadership \& Organisational Development**
* Lead and develop a team of middle managers and specialists and analysts.
* Design the department's OKR framework, KPI architecture, and Business Review structure.
* Set clear goals for the function and drive high performance and professional growth across all levels — fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, and customer\-centricity.


**Senior Stakeholder Management \& Cross\-Functional Leadership**
* Serve as the experience authority in senior leadership forums, influencing Product, Commercial, Finance, and Operations decisions.
* Present strategic insights, budget performance, and departmental OKRs to COO and ExCo leadership.
* Lead high\-complexity, cross\-functional programs assigned at department or company level with no existing playbook.


**Qualifications**
**WHAT DID WE ORDER?**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Operations, CX, Data Analytics, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of experience in customer experience, operations, or strategy, preferably in e\-commerce, food delivery, or a high\-growth tech environment.
* Proven track record of leading mid level managers and large team members across multiple functions in a matrixed organization.
* P\&L or budget accountability, experience ideally at a multi\-million EUR scale.
* Strong background in data analysis, performance management, and CX or operational strategy.
* Experience working across multiple markets and geographies.


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Exceptional leadership skills — able to inspire, align, and develop high\-performing teams.
* Strategic mindset with strong execution discipline; comfortable operating at both the 30,000\-foot and ground levels.
* Data\-driven decision\-making, with the ability to synthesize complex datasets into clear insights and recommendations.
* Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills — able to influence and present to ExCo and Board level.
* Deep customer and partner empathy, with a passion for delivering exceptional experiences at scale.
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills across Product, Finance, Legal, and Operations.
* Ability to lead through ambiguity and drive clarity in complex, fast\-moving environments.
* AI\-first mindset — comfortable leveraging automation and emerging tools to drive scale and efficiency.

**Description**
 Job Description
   

  

 Amazon Now is building the future of ultra\-fast grocery delivery across the Middle East. We are looking for a Program Manager to drive measurable improvements across store capacity management, cost\-per\-order reduction, and delivery speed (Click\-to\-Door).
   

  

 This role sits within the Operations Excellence function and is responsible for identifying, scoping, and delivering high\-impact programmes that improve customer experience and unit economics across Amazon Now’s network in Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 You will work across Last Mile, Middle Mile, and Under\-The\-Roof (UTR) operations to find inefficiencies, build the business case, and drive cross\-functional execution. This is not a reactive role, you will proactively identify opportunities before they become problems, connect the dots across operational channels, and ensure every initiative ladders up to CX outcomes and P\&L impact.
   

  

 The right candidate is analytically sharp, comfortable with ambiguity, and operates with a bias for action. You think in systems, not silos. You’re as comfortable in the data as you are in a room with senior stakeholders making the case for change.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Store Capacity \& Cost Management
   

  

* Own programmes to optimise store capacity utilization, including bin density, ASIN rationalisation, gas tank management, and space allocation across darkstores.
* Drive cost\-per\-order reduction across the end\-to\-end operation: UTR pick efficiency, DA (Delivery Associate) productivity, hub\-to\-store transhipment costs, and middle mile truck utilisation.
* Analyse operational cost structures to identify the highest\-leverage opportunities for unit economics improvement. Build business cases with clear ROI and execution plans.
* Partner with UTR, Last Mile, and Middle Mile teams to implement changes that reduce waste, improve throughput, and lower cost\-to\-serve without degrading customer experience.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting mechanisms to track capacity utilisation and cost metrics across KSA stores.


 Delivery Speed \& Click\-to\-Door (C2D)
   

  

* Own the programme roadmap for C2D reduction, identifying bottlenecks across order acceptance, pick \& pack, dispatch, and last mile delivery.
* Analyse delivery defects, early delivery marking, Did\-Not\-Receive (DNR) patterns, and other CX pain points to drive root cause resolution.
* Identify and eliminate handoff delays between UTR, Middle Mile, and Last Mile that contribute to C2D inflation.


 Project \& Programme Delivery
   

  

* Scope, plan, and execute operational improvement projects end\-to\-end, from opportunity identification through to measurable business impact.
* Build and manage a portfolio of initiatives across capacity, cost, and speed, with clear prioritisation based on CX and P\&L impact.
* Create mechanisms for project tracking, stakeholder communication, and escalation. Maintain a clear view of project status, risks, and dependencies.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment with ACES, Tech, Finance, Category, and operations teams to remove blockers and deliver on commitments.
* Contribute to the development of scalable solutions that can be replicated across KSA stores, solve once, scale everywhere.


 Cross\-Functional Influence \& Visibility
   

  

* Operate as the connective tissue between operational channels, ensuring improvements in one area don’t create problems in another.
* Build visibility into operational performance through data, dashboards, and regular reporting cadences (WBR/MBR contributions).
* Influence without authority, drive outcomes through data\-backed recommendations, clear communication, and stakeholder management.
* Support Automation \& AI initiatives that drive efficiency, reduce manual effort, and improve decision\-making across operations.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Master's degree
* Experience in program requirements definition, together with data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 5\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL

data.jd_text:
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drive everything we do. The Middle East markets (UAE and Kuwait) are one of our most dynamic and competitive markets. Functions include commercial, operations, and marketing, and teams in the Middle East partner closely with global functions such as product, technology, and consumer to deliver results for our customers.
   

  

 This role sits within Operations and leads all things Rider Experience. A large and impactful scope that includes Rider community management, Rider communications, several aspects of Rider Performance, Rider Support, and Rider Onboarding. The role entails building, improving, and implementing processes across the areas above, tracking and managing efficiency and effectiveness of how we are performing across a variety of metrics, and finally ensuring that we are able to deliver excellent support to riders across the region.
   

  

**The Role**
 Operating at scale in a hyper\-competitive, hyper\-growth environment is no easy feat. As such, you'll be faced with some of the most exciting problems across the food tech space. Reporting to the Director of Operations, Middle East, you’ll have a key role in ensuring the success of the logistics network in our Middle East markets. This centers around ensuring that we always have a fleet of highly engaged, highly satisfied, and highly performing riders on our network. Working with stakeholders within Ops to find the right approach through levers like communications, education modules, and rider events. This role is regional, and will be required to build world\-class frameworks and systems that are both effective and scalable. The objective is straightforward: build the best systems to ensure riders are able to deliver the best experience for our customers and merchants.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with other members of the Middle East rider operations teams, as well as wider teams within HQ Ops, Product, and Tech to ensure the best possible outcomes for our riders, restaurants, and customers.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 Here’s what your day\-to\-day might look like:
   

  

* Managing a large team that owns and runs several processes across the scope of the team
* Building effective, scalable, and efficient frameworks and systems that can be centralized to manage and track several key metrics across our network
* Make recommendations on how to allocate our resources to ensure the best possible outcomes, for instance, managing rider churn to optimal levels to ensure best\-in\-class service levels
* Ensuring the quality and engagement of riders newly onboarded on our network is conducive to our strategy of having best\-in\-class service levels
* Track our key metrics, look for unusual trends in our data, and uncover root causes to ensure that we preserve the health of the network.
* Work alongside other members of the Middle East Rider Operations team to ensure that we operate to budget
* Provide regular, relevant, concise updates on rider experience to senior business stakeholders.


**What You'll Need To Thrive**
 Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
   

  

* A high standard of university\-level education
* 8\+ years of experience in program management, consulting, banking, engineering, or a high\-growth start\-up
* Excellent problem\-solving skills – experience solving tough, complex problems
* An ownership mindset that means you know what is happening in your area of responsibility
* Experience managing a multi\-functional team
* Experience building scalable processes, tools, and structured change methodologies, and therefore enjoying working in a process\-driven environment
* Strong analytical mindset and comfortable with large data sets
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
* Comfortable handling multiple workstreams at the same time, working both individually and as part of a team


**Why Join Us?**
 At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real\-world problems in a three\-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.
   

  

 We’re Food Lovers, Problem Solvers, Community Builders, And More, Brought Together By a Shared Drive To Make Things Better. Working Here, You Can Expect To
   

  

**🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale** 
 Work on a complex, always\-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.
   

  

 🌱
 **See your impact, fast** 
 Ship, test, and improve ideas quickly in a low\-hierarchy, high\-ownership
   

  

 environment.
   

  

**🧠Grow through challenge and ownership** 
 Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.
   

  

**🌎A culture built for builders** 
 High standards, collaboration, flexible working, and continuous learning.
   

  

 We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3\-4 stages. Find more about how we hire
 **here.**
**Our Global Structure**
 Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
   

  

**Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**
 At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
   

  

 We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio\-economic background, religion, or belief.
   

  

 If you have a disability or long\-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.
   

  

 If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast\-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

data.jd_text:
Established in 1977, Arabian Ethicals takes pride in being a top healthcare player in the UAE. As the exclusive representative and distributor of many multinational pharmaceutical, consumer, and veterinary products in the UAE, the Company serves over 2,000 pharmacies, 150 hospitals, 600 hypermarkets, supermarkets and specialty stores, in addition to more than 100 veterinary clinics and farms.
   

  

**Job Description**
 This is a high\-impact, cross\-functional Director\-level leadership role for an experienced operations professional ready to own end\-to\-end distribution performance in a regulated healthcare environment. The incumbent will define and execute the operational strategy that keeps products moving safely, compliantly and efficiently — from warehouse to patient— across pharmaceutical, healthcare, animal health and consumer distribution (GDP\-regulated). Working closely with sales, market access, business development, regulatory and finance teams, the role builds the operational infrastructure that enables growth while upholding the highest standards of GDP compliance, cold chain integrity and service excellence. The role requires flexibility and willingness to travel across sites and, where applicable, to regulatory authority locations. The incumbent will be required to continuously improve operational efficiency.
   

  

**Operational Strategy \& Leadership**
* Define and execute a 3\-year operations strategy aligned to business growth and regulatory obligations.
* Lead transformation programmes to improve efficiency, scalability, and service across the distribution network.
* Drive a culture of continuous improvement, operational discipline, and safety\-first thinking.
* Act as the operational voice at the leadership table — translating business goals into executable plans.


**Pharma Supply Chain \& Logistics \& Procurement Management**
* Oversee warehousing, inventory management, transportation, and last\-mile distribution for pharmaceutical and healthcare products.
* Ensure rigorous GDP\-compliant handling, storage, and transportation protocols across all facilities.
* Manage cold chain operations for temperature\-sensitive products, including serialisation and traceability requirements.
* Own demand planning, forecasting accuracy, and stock availability to prevent stockouts or expiry losses.
* Manage the direct and indirect procurement processes, develop and maintain relationships with 3PL partners, freight forwarders, and regulatory\-approved logistics vendors.


**Regulatory Compliance \& Quality**
* Ensure full compliance with GDP (Good Distribution Practice) guidelines and local regulatory authority requirements.
* Maintain all distribution licenses, certifications, and regulatory filings; proactively manage renewals and audits.
* Lead internal compliance audits and manage regulatory inspections with professionalism and preparedness.
* Implement and maintain SOPs across warehousing, cold chain, recalls, and adverse event reporting.
* Oversee quality management systems (QMS) and deviation/CAPA processes.


**P\&L and Cost Management**
* Own operational budgets and drive cost optimisation without compromising compliance or service quality.
* Track and improve cost\-to\-serve, inventory turnover, shrinkage, and logistics unit economics.
* Identify and execute margin enhancement initiatives through vendor negotiation, route optimisation, and productivity gains.
* Deliver regular financial performance reporting to the AEC GM.


**Process Excellence \& Digital Transformation**
* Implement best\-in\-class SOPs and leverage ERP platform to drive operational visibility.
* Lead the adoption of digital tools — including data analytics, serialisation platforms, and automation — across distribution operations.
* Ensure all systems and processes are audit\-ready and aligned to regulatory expectations at all times.


**Team Leadership \& Development**
* Lead, and develop a high\-performing operations team across warehousing, logistics, compliance, and planning functions.
* Establish clear KPIs, performance management frameworks, and succession plans.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, psychological safety, and operational excellence.
* Coach and mentor functional managers to build organisational depth and capability.


**Commercial \& Customer Alignment**
* Partner closely with commercial teams to align operational capacity with sales growth plans and customer commitments.
* Own SLA delivery — OTIF, order accuracy, returns management — as a commercial differentiator.
* Represent operations in key customer meetings and tender/bid processes where operational credibility matters.
* Support business development by structuring scalable operational models for new principal agreements, distribution contracts, and market entry opportunities — providing cost\-to\-serve modelling, capacity assessments, and operational due diligence to underpin commercial negotiations.


**Risk Management \& Business Continuity**
* Identify, assess, and mitigate operational risks including supply disruptions, cold chain failures, and regulatory non\-compliance.
* Own and maintain business continuity plans (BCP) for critical distribution operations.
* Manage product recall and returns processes in line with regulatory requirements.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related field.
* MBA or postgraduate qualification in Supply Chain, Operations, or Business.


**Additional Information**
**Experience Requirements:**
* 10–15\+ years of progressive experience in operations and/or logistics within pharmaceutical, healthcare, or regulated FMCG distribution.
* Demonstrated experience managing GDP\-regulated distribution environments.
* Proven leadership of large, multi\-functional teams and multi\-site operations.
* Hands\-on experience with ERP/WMS systems and process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma).
* Track record of leading successful regulatory audits and maintaining clean compliance records.
* Experience operating in the GCC / MENA region, with knowledge of local regulatory bodies (MOH, SFDA, DHA, HAAD, or equivalent). Exposure to cold chain and serialisation/track\-and\-trace platforms.
* Experience with digital transformation programmes in warehouse or logistics operations.


**Skills And Abilities**
* Deep knowledge of GDP and pharma supply chain; data\-driven decision\-making and analytics; ERP/WMS/TMS system fluency; risk and compliance management; strategic thinking with strong execution.
* Lean / Six Sigma / process excellence certification; stakeholder influence at C\-suite level; commercially aware and customer\-focused mindset.

 The Associate Director – Data Protection \& Information Security is responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining the organization's enterprise information security program to protect information assets, systems, and business operations. **Key Responsibilities:**

data.jd_text:
You have articulated a transformative academic vision and delivered on it. Your leadership has been direct and visible, not indirect or behind closed doors. In learning science, you are not a casual observer—you have created tangible systems, generated measurable results, and earned credibility to present that work publicly. If this describes your track record, 2 Hour Learning is seeking its chief academic architect.
   

  

 2 Hour Learning has developed a system enabling students to learn at twice the rate in two hours per day. The model relies on AI\-driven tutoring, mastery\-based learning pathways, and a fundamental redesign of traditional classroom frameworks. Outcomes have been consistently strong. We now need a leader to harmonize implementation across varied school environments, elevate academic leadership standards, and represent this rigorous, science\-backed approach on a global stage.
   

  

 This position is not theoretical. It is a directive leadership role. You will control academic strategy in execution, establish explicit performance standards, surface operational shortfalls, and develop high\-performing teams to achieve concrete results. You will operationalize our learning science foundation and advocate for this model worldwide.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Designing academic frameworks that convert learning science principles into actionable direction for curriculum development, student motivation architecture, and application design.
* Conducting academic performance reviews with Heads of Academics to confirm school teams maintain alignment, accountability, and result delivery.
* Integrating data analysis, stakeholder interviews, and direct observation to produce academic ecosystem assessments that identify critical barriers to accelerated learning and recommend targeted solutions.
* Ensuring strategic coherence through planning processes, continuous feedback mechanisms, and milestone monitoring to sustain focus on learning objectives.
* Serving as the principal representative of 2 Hour Learning in high\-stakes forums, including keynote presentations and engagements with Ministries of Education, to influence systemic reform in global education thinking.


**What You Won’t Be Doing**
* Working on standalone curriculum initiatives that lack broader systemic impact.
* Producing theoretical research disconnected from student outcomes or operational execution.
* Transferring accountability for performance to middle management or external consultants.
* Depending on institutional credibility or academic theory alone to influence skeptical audiences.


**Director Of Academic Excellence Key Responsibilities**
 Expand and strengthen 2 Hour Learning's validated academic model by standardizing execution across school sites, raising leadership expectations, and serving as the authoritative public advocate for a movement rooted in rigorous science and demonstrated results.
   

  

**Basic Requirements**
* Advanced degree (Masters or Ph.D) in Learning Science, Educational Psychology, Instructional Design, or a related field
* At least 7 years in academic or EdTech leadership roles, leading a team of staff/employees (not an informal peer leader role, such as grade\-level lead); you must have been responsible for hiring, monitoring performance, coaching, and making termination decisions
* Experience driving learning outcomes for students and upholding student performance standards
* Experience applying AI or emerging technologies to improve education, such as through personalized learning, adaptive learning, AI agents, etc.
* Experience managing academic teams of 50\+ people (e.g., the teams you managed directly executed curriculum, instruction, or assessment)
* Experience interacting directly with students, teachers, or school leaders in a professional setting


**About 2 Hour Learning**
 Education is broken, but 2 Hour Learning is proving it doesn’t have to be. They’re tearing down the outdated one\-size\-fits\-all model and replacing it with AI\-driven personalized learning that helps kids master academics in just two hours a day.
   

  

**With students consistently ranking in the top 1\-2% nationally and the top 20% achieving an astonishing 6\.5x growth, they’re proving that smarter learning is possible. At 2 Hour Learning, it’s talent and performance that matter.**
 They offer a dynamic, on\-campus and remote\-friendly environment where innovators, educators, and AI specialists can be a part of fixing a broken school system.
   

  

**2 Hour Learning is reprogramming learning for the AI era.**
**Here’s How They’re Fixing It.**
 There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you!
   

  

**Working with us**
 This is a full\-time (40 hours per week), long\-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $200 USD/hour, which equates to $400,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. Consult www.crossover.com/help\-and\-faqs for more details on this topic.

data.jd_text:
We're hiring a Head of Network to own the supply side of Sharp Minds — a consulting talent platform placing former MBB consultants and Senior Advisors on high\-impact projects across the Middle East.
 



 Our network is our product. This role exists to make it the strongest bench in the region — so that when a mandate comes in, we can place within 48 hours, every time.
 



  





  





**🎯 The Opportunity** 




  





 Are you an ex\-MBB consultant who'd rather build the network than be placed on it?
 



 The matching engine only works if the bench is deep, sharp, and engaged. That's what you'll own — end to end. You'll set the network strategy, decide who gets in and who doesn't, keep 900\+ senior consultants close enough that they pick Sharp Minds over a direct client approach, and turn a database into a genuine community.
 



 This isn't recruiting and it isn't HR. It's closer to being a talent partner at a top fund: you treat consultants as assets to be cultivated, not records to be managed. You'll work directly with the founders and the COO, and as we scale, you'll build and lead the talent function under you.
 



  





  





**🧠 About Sharp Minds** 




  





 Sharp Minds places former MBB and Tier\-1 consultants on high\-impact projects across the Middle East — for governments, sovereign investors, consulting firms, and leading corporations.
 



 We started Sharp Minds to fix what we disliked about independent consulting: poor communication, zero transparency, and generic matchmaking.
 



 Since then, we've staffed 250\+ roles and built a network of 900\+ consultants. A new platform and website are currently in development — the next phase of how Sharp Minds operates at scale.
 



  





  





**📐 The Standard** 




  





 We move quickly, expect clear thinking, and hold a high bar for communication and judgment.
 



 We use AI tools actively and expect you to do the same — not as a shortcut, but as a force multiplier for good thinking.
 



 The network is only as strong as its weakest consultant. You hold that line on quality, and you're the reason consultants feel valued and loyal. If you enjoy building relationships with sharp people and operating close to the founders, you'll thrive here. If you prefer process\-driven, predictable recruiting work, this probably isn't the right fit.
 



  





  





**⚙️ What You'll Own** 




  




* **Network strategy** 
 — decide which talent we focus on, how we recruit it, and how we leverage the 900\+. You set the direction for how the network compounds into a competitive moat, and build the systems that let a small team run it at scale.
* **Events \& community** 
 — a major part of the role. We run monthly Dubai events with outside speakers and connecting time, plus two sessions a month training consultants on how to succeed as independents. You own the calendar, the content, and the room — these events drive retention, reputation, and turn consultants into clients.
* **Matching support** 
 — we're staffing 5–10 engagements a week. The COO owns the placement decision; you provide the depth at speed, naming the right consultants in real time — who's available, and who's actually a fit beyond their CV.
* **Recruiting \& onboarding** 
 — proactively source and vet new consultants from MBB alumni networks, LinkedIn, referrals, and events, holding the bar on quality and fit. Then make them deployment\-ready from day one: expectations, positioning, how mandates work, what clients expect.
* **Retention \& engagement** 
 — actively manage relationships across the network. Know who's engaged, who's between projects, who's drifting — and catch disengagement early, before a consultant goes cold or takes a client direct.



  





  





**🚀 What Success Looks Like** 




  





 In your first 12 months:
 


* **A sharper, deeper bench** 
 — you've added high\-caliber consultants and visibly raised the quality of the network, with a clear strategy for which talent we double down on.
* **Events that run like clockwork** 
 — monthly Dubai events and twice\-monthly training sessions consistently fill the room, with measurable lift in retention and referrals.
* **A network that stays close** 
 — measurably stronger engagement and responsiveness, with fewer consultants drifting or taking clients direct.



  





  





**🔎 Why You** 




  




* **MBB background** 
 — 4\+ years at McKinsey, BCG, Bain, or a Tier\-1 strategy firm. You know the tribe from the inside, and senior consultants take you seriously.
* **Relationship instinct** 
 — people trust you and stay close to you. You build a network naturally, not transactionally, and you're comfortable owning a room of senior people.
* **You've been in their shoes** 
 — ideally you've worked as an independent consultant yourself. You understand the isolation, the pipeline anxiety, and what real support looks like — and it shows in how you cultivate the network.
* **High bar on quality** 
 — you'd rather say no to a mediocre consultant than dilute the bench, and you source the next ten before anyone asks where the pipeline is.
* **Sharp communicator** 
 — clean, structured writing and confident in person; your first draft is most people's third.
* **Resourceful with ambiguity** 
 — shifting priorities don't slow you down, and you use the tools available to you, AI included, to produce better output than someone who doesn't.



**Bonus** 
 — an existing network across the Middle East. Not required, but a real head start in building the bench here.
 



  





  





**💎 What's In It For You** 




  




* **Real ownership from day one** 
 — you own the network end to end, and the strategy behind it.
* **Leadership trajectory** 
 — a Head role from the start. As Sharp Minds scales, you'll build and lead the talent function under you.
* **A seat in Dubai's consulting scene** 
 — at the center of a high\-caliber network, hosting the rooms where senior consultants and clients meet.
* **Competitive package** 
 — base salary, performance bonus, profit\-sharing upside, and a MacBook.



  





  





**🌍 Working Model** 




  





 Dubai\-based. You'll be running our monthly events and building the network on the ground, close to consultants and clients. The day\-to\-day is flexible — outcomes first, not hours — but this role lives in Dubai.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 We are looking for an exceptional Director of Inclusion – Whole School to join our team at GEMS Wellington Academy – Al Khail from January 2027
   

  

 Our vision at GEMS Wellington Academy Al Khail is to "Empower today, for a limitless tomorrow." We are seeking an outstanding leader who can help us achieve this goal through our belief in: Limitless Learning, Limitless Solutions, and Limitless Possibilities.
   

  

 As a cognitive science\-driven school, evidence\-informed practice is at the heart of everything we do. We are looking for an experienced Inclusion leader who can articulate a clear vision for outstanding inclusive education, ensuring every learner can thrive academically, socially and emotionally. Successful candidates will share our core values of Ambition, Responsibility and Courage and be passionate about creating a truly inclusive learning environment for all.
   

  

 The Director of Inclusion will provide strategic leadership for inclusive provision across our through\-school, leading the development of exceptional practice for Students of Determination while ensuring full compliance with the Dubai Inclusive Education Policy Framework. Working closely with the Senior Leadership Team, teachers, parents and external agencies, the successful candidate will drive a culture where inclusion is embedded in every aspect of school life.
   

  

 Successful candidates will be joining a fully inclusive, high\-performing school that is evidenced through:
   

  

* GCSE and A\-Level results far exceeding UK national averages
* 'Very Good' rating from the Dubai Schools Inspection Bureau (DSIB)
* Outstanding rating from British Schools Overseas (BSO)
* 'World Class School' status from High Performance Learning
* Being an invited member of the Cognitive Science School Network


 Through our comprehensive professional learning programme, we ensure our leaders have access to high\-quality development opportunities that not only support their own professional growth but also contribute to our continued success. StepLab instructional coaching, the Cognitive Science Network, Schools, Students and Teachers Network (SSAT), the Best Practice Network (BPN) and Evidence Based Education (EBE) are just some of the organisations we work with to ensure our staff continue to develop as outstanding practitioners and leaders.
   

  

**Skills Description**
 Successful candidates will need to:
   

  

* Hold a recognised teaching qualification (PGCE, PGDE or equivalent) together with a Bachelor's degree in Education or a relevant field.
* Hold a recognised postgraduate qualification in Special Educational Needs, Inclusion or a related discipline (Master's degree or equivalent preferred).
* Have significant experience leading Inclusion within a high\-performing international school.
* Demonstrate an excellent understanding of the British curriculum and inclusive practice across a through\-school setting (ages 3–18\).
* Have a proven track record of developing high\-quality provision for Students of Determination.
* Possess strong knowledge of the Dubai Inclusive Education Policy Framework, KHDA expectations and current international best practice.
* Have experience leading multidisciplinary Inclusion teams, including SEN, EAL and specialist support staff.
* Demonstrate expertise in developing and monitoring Individual Education Plans (IEPs), intervention programmes and evidence\-informed support strategies.
* Be highly skilled in coaching teachers and leading professional development to embed outstanding inclusive classroom practice.
* Be an exceptional communicator, able to build strong relationships with students, families, colleagues and external agencies.
* Have excellent analytical skills with the ability to use data to evaluate provision and improve outcomes for all learners.
* Demonstrate a growth mindset and a commitment to continuous improvement and innovation.


 All positions attract an excellent remuneration package including a competitive tax\-free salary, individual fully furnished accommodation, free schooling, private medical insurance, annual airfares to country of residence and end of Service Gratuity.
   

  

 GEMS teachers and leaders also have free access to our loyalty app, GEMS Rewards, which provides significant savings on day\-to\-day life in the UAE. Employees benefit from thousands of discounts and 2\-for\-1 offers on flights, hotels, restaurants and retail outlets, making your salary go further and enhancing your opportunity to save whilst working overseas.
   

  

 GEMS Education is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all of its students and staff. A UK\-enhanced DBS or equivalent police check is a pre\-requisite for all appointments.

data.jd_text:
**Head of ePMO**

**Location:** 
 Dubai, UAE
   

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time, Permanent
   

**Reports To:** 
 Chief Strategy Officer
 


**About myZoi**

 myZoi is a CBUAE\-regulated fintech on a mission to deliver financial inclusion for the underbanked workforce in the UAE and beyond. We serve employers, employees, and migrant workers across payroll, remittance, cards, and value\-added financial services — operating at the intersection of regulatory complexity, product ambition, and rapid growth.
   





 We are at an exciting stage of our journey. Our product portfolio is scaling, our governance infrastructure is maturing, and our strategic agenda is becoming more ambitious. The people and systems we put in place now will define how myZoi operates at the next level of scale.
   

  




**About the Role**

 As Head of EPMO you will be the central governance and delivery control function for myZoi's product and enterprise portfolios. This is a high\-authority, high\-visibility role that sits at the heart of how myZoi decides what to build, what to fund, and how to deliver — reporting directly to the Chief Strategy Officer with a close working relationship with the Chief Product Officer.
   





 You will own the end\-to\-end governance framework across two distinct portfolios — the product delivery pipeline and the enterprise initiative register — each with its own governance model, approval authority, and reporting cadence. You will be the single point of accountability for ensuring that engineering capacity is always allocated to the highest\-value work, that no initiative enters development without structured validation and executive authorisation, and that leadership has a live, accurate, and honest view of delivery health at all times.
   





 This is not a coordination role and it is not a reporting role. The right candidate builds governance systems, enforces them under pressure, and walks into every leadership meeting already knowing the answer.
   





 You will be stepping into a function that has an established framework and a clear mandate — and your role will be to own it, activate it, and make it the operating backbone of how myZoi delivers. Everything the EPMO governs connects directly to myZoi's strategic agenda and business plan — your job is to ensure that connection is visible, maintained, and enforced across every initiative in flight.
   

  




**Who You Will Work With**

 You will operate as a strategic partner to the Chief Strategy Officer and Chief Product Officer on a daily basis, with regular interaction with the CTO, CFO, COO and functional leadership across the business. You will lead a small EPMO team comprising an Agile Lead and a Project Manager, and you will be embedded in the delivery rhythm of three product squads.
   

  




**What You Will Own**

**Portfolio Governance**




 ● Ensure that initiative prioritisation across both portfolios remains anchored to myZoi's strategic objectives and annual business plan — flagging to the CSO and CPO when the portfolio mix drifts from agreed strategic priorities
   





 ● Own, refine, and enforce the structured intake and prioritization framework across product and enterprise portfolios — ensuring every initiative is classified, validated, and authorized before development begins
   





 ● Maintain a real\-time view of engineering capacity across delivery squads — surface prioritisation conflicts, swap recommendations, and capacity constraints to the CPO and CSO proactively
   





 ● Track the cost, timeline, and value delivery of every active initiative — maintaining visibility over budget consumption, milestone adherence, and whether initiatives are delivering the outcomes that justified their approval. Surface material deviations to the CPO and CSO before they become problems
   





 ● Own the single source of truth for all active initiatives across both portfolios — keeping status, milestones, dependencies, and risks current at all times
   





**Enterprise Portfolio Management**




 myZoi's enterprise portfolio spans the operating platform and support functions that underpin the business — the capabilities and infrastructure that enable the product to be built, operated, and scaled. Governing this portfolio means ensuring that operational and procurement initiatives across these functions are assessed, prioritised, and delivered with the same rigour applied to the product portfolio.
   





 ● Govern operational and procurement initiatives end to end — from initial classification through technical evaluation, financial approval, and delivery oversight
   





 ● Maintain portfolio visibility across transformational strategic initiatives without assuming delivery ownership — flagging resource conflicts and capacity dependencies to senior leadership
   





 ● Coordinate with the CTO on engineering capacity decisions and with the CFO on procurement governance
   





**Delivery Intelligence \& Risk Management**




 ● Own a live slippage log with root cause categorisation for every deadline and budget movement — no exceptions
   





 ● Identify systemic delivery patterns and bring structured recommendations to leadership — not status updates
   





 ● Flag forward risks 2–4 weeks before they materialise and drive accountability for recovery
   





**Reporting \& Governance Rhythm**




 ● Produce and own a distinct monthly portfolio status report for each of the CPO and CSO — concise, decision\-ready, and forward\-looking
   





 ● Own and facilitate the full governance calendar across weekly, bi\-weekly, monthly, and quarterly cadences
   





 ● Present delivery intelligence in governance meetings — the EPMO owns the narrative, not the slide deck
   





**Team Leadership**




 ● Lead and coordinate the EPMO team including an Agile Lead and Project Manager — ensuring clear ownership, consistent standards, and delivery continuity across the function
   

  




**What We Are Looking For**

**Experience**




 ● 12\-15 years in senior program management, portfolio governance, or enterprise PMO roles — with a track record of building governance frameworks from scratch, not just operating within them
   





 ● Proven experience governing multiple concurrent portfolios with differentiated governance models across product delivery and enterprise programs
   





 ● Direct experience designing and enforcing structured intake, classification, and gate approval processes in high\-velocity environments
   





 ● Background in a regulated fintech, payments, or financial services environment — familiarity with CBUAE or equivalent central bank regulatory obligations strongly preferred
   





 ● Experience managing upward across multiple C\-suite stakeholders simultaneously in a matrix or dual\-reporting environment
   





 ● Hands\-on familiarity with agile delivery environments and squad\-level capacity planning — sufficient to lead an Agile Lead credibly and challenge delivery estimates with authority
   





 ● Commercial orientation — able to frame governance and prioritisation decisions in business value terms, not just process compliance
   





**Certifications**




 ● PMP or PgMP required
   





 ● MSP Practitioner and SAFe SA or SPC strongly preferred
   





 ● MoP, PMI\-ACP, or PRINCE2 Practitioner an advantage
   





 ● Familiarity with UAE regulatory environment (CBUAE, SVF licensing) preferred
   





**The Kind of Person Who Will Thrive Here**




 You hold governance boundaries with authority and without apology — even when the pressure comes from senior product or engineering leadership. You know the difference between owning governance and owning delivery, and you never confuse the two. You bring commercial judgement to prioritisation decisions, not just process discipline. You are comfortable maintaining oversight of exploratory and transformational programs without needing to govern their delivery. You communicate differently to different audiences — operationally detailed with delivery teams, concise and decisive with executives. And you are genuinely forward\-looking — you surface risks before they become problems, not after.

**About Jumeirah** 




 Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates an exceptional portfolio of 29 properties across 11 countries in the Middle East, Europe, and Asia. In 1999, Jumeirah changed the face of luxury hospitality with the opening of the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab and the brand is now renowned worldwide for its distinguished beachfront resorts, esteemed city hotels and exclusive residences. From the contemporary Maldivian island paradise at Jumeirah Olhahali Island to the art\-inspired Jumeirah Capri Palace in Italy and the modern twist on a British classic at Jumeirah Carlton Tower in London, the brand has become synonymous with warm and generous service and the ability to craft distinctive and purposeful experiences that bring joy to guests from across the world.
 



  





**About Jumeirah Burj Al Arab:** 




 Jumeirah Burj Al Arab is more than a hotel, it is a global icon of luxury hospitality. Since opening in 1999, it has defined the pinnacle of the industry, setting new benchmarks in personalised service and creating truly unforgettable guest experiences.
 



 Today, it enters a bold and defining new chapter. After more than 25 years at the forefront of the industry, the property will undergo a carefully considered restoration led by renowned designer Tristan Auer, bringing a refined contemporary vision while preserving the legacy, craftsmanship, and spirit of this extraordinary landmark.
 



  





**About the Job** 




 An exciting opportunity has arisen for a
 **Director of Learning \& Development** 
 to join
 **Jumeirah Burj Al Arab** 
 .
 



 The main duties and responsibilities of this role include:
 



  




* Define and lead the Learning \& Development strategy for Jumeirah Burj Al Arab at a pivotal moment in its restoration journey, shaping the capability, mindset, and service culture required to relaunch one of the world’s most iconic luxury hotels.
* Partner closely with the Director of HR and senior leadership team to translate the property’s restoration roadmap, operational readiness priorities, and renewed brand ambitions into a focused people\-development agenda.
* Lead high\-volume onboarding, re\-induction, and colleague integration with the discipline of a luxury pre\-opening environment, ensuring every colleague is immersed in the Burj Al Arab legacy, service philosophy, brand rituals, and elevated guest experience standards.
* Prepare leaders and colleagues for the next chapter of the property by building the behaviours, confidence, and operational capability required to deliver consistent, intuitive, and highly personalised service at scale.
* Embed a refreshed culture of excellence across all functions, connecting learning to service consistency, colleague engagement, operational readiness, guest experience, and the successful reopening of a landmark luxury property.
* Build a future\-ready talent pipeline through succession planning, career development, and high\-potential programmes that support business continuity, internal mobility, and leadership strength before, during, and beyond the restoration phase.
* Champion innovation across the learning landscape, using modern learning solutions, digital tools, best practices, and measurable insights to enhance capability, colleague experience, service consistency, and overall business performance throughout the hotel’s transformation journey.



  





**About You** 




 The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:
 



  




* Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in Learning \& Development, including at least 3–5 years in a leadership role within luxury hospitality.
* Demonstrated success in designing and delivering leadership development, capability\-building, and succession planning initiatives that strengthen organisational performance and prepare future leaders.
* Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with experience partnering with senior leadership teams to drive organisational change, talent growth, and cultural transformation.
* Passion for developing people and creating exceptional colleague experiences, combined with a forward\-thinking approach to learning innovation, digital learning solutions, and modern development practices.
* Strong commercial and operational awareness, with the ability to align learning priorities to business objectives, service excellence standards, and colleague engagement goals.



  





**About the Benefits** 




 At Jumeirah, we are dedicated to fostering a workplace where colleagues feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow. Our benefits package reflects this commitment by combining rewarding financial incentives, comprehensive healthcare, and opportunities for professional development.
 



 Benefits include:
 



  




* Supportive and inclusive work environment
* Access to Learning \& Development programmes and clear career pathways
* Opportunities for internal mobility within our global network
* Colleague discounts on food, beverage, and hotel stays worldwide
* Comprehensive healthcare and life insurance coverage
* Paid annual leave entitlement
* Incentive programmes aligned with leadership performance
* Competitive tax\-free salary paid in UAE Dirhams (AED)

**About Astrazeneca**
 At AstraZeneca we fuse the worlds of Medical and Commercial to spot opportunities and pioneer approaches that better serve our patients. Bridging Commercial and Scientific goals, we apply our people and leadership skills to launch cutting\-edge products into our growing healthcare ecosystem. It takes a holistic mindset to treat each unique patient and tailor the whole experience – from early diagnosis to treatment. We step up and take accountability to deliver new ways of doing things that will create a better future for our markets.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The role is responsible for leading a high\-performing Biopharmaceuticals Business Unit (BBU) Medical Affairs team across the CVRM and R\&I Therapy Areas in the AstraZeneca Gulf cluster. Prioritizes across both therapy areas according to BBU strategy and organizational impact, with a deep understanding of the Gulf healthcare systems, their priorities and challenges across the disease areas.
   

  

 Ensures excellence in the development and execution of integrated CVRM and R\&I Medical Affairs Plans – composed of confidence and evidence\-generation activities, as well as fundamental and sustainable clinical\-practice transformations that strengthen healthcare ecosystems, improve treatment outcomes, and enable equitable access to quality patient care in alignment with the BBU portfolio.
   

  

 Recognizes and leverages innovation wherever appropriate to drive strategic and sustainable impact internally and externally. Leads the team to identify, activate and measure scalable healthcare practice shaping initiatives across both therapy areas, with integrated partnership engagement plans composed of key traditional (e.g. HCPs and scientific leaders in cardiology, nephrology, endocrinology/diabetes, respiratory and immunology/rheumatology) and non\-traditional (e.g. policy and decision makers, PAGs, government, payers, innovative solution providers) stakeholders.
   

  

 Drives operational effectiveness, impact and efficiencies of the CVRM and R\&I Medical Affairs teams through measurable outcomes and a continuous improvement approach, balancing resources appropriately across the two therapy areas. Communicates on the quality, delivery and value of the BBU Medical Affairs teams with a good understanding of the internal business ecosystem.
   

  

 Leads the BBU Medical Affairs teams as a member of the Senior Leadership Team, partnering closely with the CVRM and R\&I commercial BUDs. Acts as part of the leadership team for the Gulf organization and participates in organizational decisions with an entrepreneurial mindset.
   

  

**Typical Accountabilities**
**Medical Strategy**
* Accountable for setting the integrated CVRM and R\&I Medical Affairs strategy for the Gulf cluster, ensuring appropriate resources and delivering the strategic Medical Affairs plans across both therapy areas with maximum impact and effectiveness.
* Accountable for the strategic direction, business planning and team leadership of the BBU (CVRM \& R\&I) Medical Affairs function within the Gulf cluster, aligning local plans with the global/area CVRM and R\&I medical strategies and the Gulf launch sequence.
* Translates the differing scientific, evidence\-generation and stakeholder needs of CVRM and R\&I into a single prioritized plan, balancing investment, capabilities and focus across the two therapy areas.
* Leads the BBU Medical Affairs organization as part of the cluster’s senior leadership team and represents the local company externally on the topic of science and healthcare across the cardiovascular, renal, metabolic, respiratory and immunology disease areas.
* Manages and leads change initiatives, challenges current thinking and assumptions within the organization, and collaborates with cross\-functional teams and across organizations at various levels.


**Team Leader**
* Manages and coaches the CVRM and R\&I medical teams – e.g. Medical Advisors, Medical Managers and MSLs – for performance with purpose, holding the team accountable for timely and effective delivery in the prioritized areas that drive the greatest impact across both therapy areas.
* Establishes required standards of medical core – and new capabilities, ensures medical operational excellence, business and resource planning and people processes (recruitment, talent management, motivation, retention).
* Drives performance with impact\-focused goals and measurable outcomes, continuously validating and improving strategies through data\-driven insights.
* Builds and sustains deep therapy\-area and scientific expertise across CVRM and R\&I, and drives a collaborative, patient\-centric culture with an innovative mindset that focuses on impact.


**External Engagements**
* Knowledgeable of the global and Gulf healthcare ecosystem – its priorities, challenges, opportunities and issues.
* Ensures scalable and sustainable strategic solutions to Transforming Care are incorporated and prioritized into the CVRM and R\&I Medical Affairs plans to strengthen healthcare ecosystems and improve treatment outcomes.
* Drives Scientific Leadership across cardiovascular, renal, metabolic, respiratory and immunology care.
* Establishes collaborative engagements with Key Opinion Leaders of the HC ecosystem (e.g. cardiologists, nephrologists, endocrinologists/diabetologists, pulmonologists, immunologists/rheumatologists, payers, policy makers, regulatory bodies and PAGs) to drive consensus and successfully advocate for policy changes that improve access to quality patient care.


**Medical Evidence Generation Oversight**
* Ensure building of high\-quality Gulf Medical Evidence Plans to generate Clinical, Payer, Policy evidence in line with brand strategy
* Ensure meeting local and above market RWE study program KPIs (startup timelines, recruitment, etc)
* Ensure high quality medical insights provided to area/regional Evidence Generation strategies
* Ensuring GCP Quality and compliance with local GCP Quality Management System (QMS) SOP and all applicable AZ policies and Standards


**Medical Excellence and Governance Oversight**
* Ensure Nominated Signatory, Medical Information, Ethical Interactions policies are implemented and tracked
* Ensure setting up and conduct regular review of Field Medical Quarterly Dashboard (KPIs) and assessment of MSL Capabilities
* Ensure Medical function are compliant with AZ Code of Ethics, Corporate Governance, Audit requirements, guidelines, policies, procedures, development/ updating of SOPs in timely manner. Ensures and monitors compliance by team members and third parties by (a) positively reinforcing the Code of Ethics and all relevant AstraZeneca Policies and Standards, (b) ensuring completion of all required training, (c) fostering a culture of openness in which employees are comfortable raising questions or concerns, and (d) immediately addressing and reporting, as appropriate, instances of non\-compliance.
* As a leader with accountability for GxP areas, understands the legal and regulatory requirements of the role in providing appropriate resources (human, financial, material, facilities and equipment) to maintain the Quality system and continually improve its effectiveness.
* Collaborates with Compliance to ensure full adherence to company standards on ethical interactions.


**Essentials For The Role**
* Science degree and/or Master’s degree in a scientific discipline.
* Extensive experience of the Medical Affairs function within the pharmaceutical industry.
* Therapy\-area knowledge across CVRM and/or R\&I (cardiovascular, renal, metabolic, respiratory or immunology).
* Experience leading or supporting Medical Affairs across more than one therapy area.
* Extensive experience in relationship and stakeholder management.
* Extensive team management / people\-leadership experience.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.


**Desirables for the role**
* Doctoral degree in a scientific discipline (e.g. M.D., Ph.D., Pharm.D.).
* In\-depth scientific expertise in one or more CVRM or R\&I disease areas (e.g. heart failure, chronic kidney disease, type 2 diabetes, severe asthma, COPD, immunology/rheumatology).
* Experience supporting product launches within CVRM or R\&I.
* Experience of the Gulf / GCC healthcare environment and stakeholders.
* Extensive knowledge of the latest technical and regulatory developments.
* Innovative and solution\-oriented mindset; ecosystem\-scaled project experience.
* Experience with research, drug discovery, drug development and drug lifecycle management.

**Closing Date**
