Across every role and department, our shared purpose is the same: to create amazing experiences and everlasting memories \- not only for our guests, but for our colleagues too.
   

  

**About The Job**
 As Director of Veterinary Services, you will lead the veterinary and laboratory function within a world\-class marine animal operation. Reporting to the Executive Director of Marine Animal Operations, you will be responsible for the overall health, welfare, and medical management of a diverse collection of marine mammals and aquatic species.
   

  

 This role combines hands\-on clinical expertise with strategic leadership. You will oversee preventative healthcare, diagnostics, treatment, quarantine protocols, and regulatory compliance, while driving continuous improvement in animal welfare standards. You will work cross\-functionally with animal care, life support, and operations teams to ensure best\-in\-class outcomes aligned with global zoological and aquarium practices.
   

  

 The role also includes responsibility for veterinary program development, applied clinical research, scientific publication, and acting as a professional spokesperson when required.
   

  

**Key Requirements**
* Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) from an accredited institution
* Valid veterinary license and eligibility for registration in the UAE
* Minimum 10 years’ experience in zoological or aquarium environments, with strong exposure to marine mammal medicine
* Minimum 5 years in a leadership role managing veterinary or animal health teams
* Advanced clinical capability across diagnostics, surgery, imaging (ultrasound, radiography, endoscopy), and postmortem analysis
* Deep expertise in aquatic animal health, husbandry, population management, and welfare for diverse species
* Strong understanding of water quality analysis and life support systems
* Proven experience establishing quarantine, biosecurity, and disease prevention protocols
* Demonstrated involvement in clinical or conservation research, including publications or conference presentations
* Strong financial acumen, including budget management and operational planning
* Experience working within regulatory frameworks and maintaining compliance with international standards


**What We Need From You**
* A strategic leader who can develop and implement a comprehensive veterinary medical program
* Ability to lead, mentor, and develop high\-performing veterinary and laboratory teams
* Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to influence across multiple departments
* A data\-driven and analytical mindset, with the ability to translate scientific findings into operational improvements
* Excellent communication skills, including the ability to present complex medical information clearly
* A proactive approach to innovation, research, and continuous improvement in animal care and welfare
* High levels of professionalism, integrity, and accountability
* Flexibility to work irregular hours and travel when required

data.jd_text:
**Full Time Position at American University of Sharjah:** 
 Her Highness Sheikha Jawaher Bint Mohammed Al Qasimi Endowed Chair in Women’s Leadership
   

  

**Post date:** 
 October 8, 2025
   

  

**Application deadline** 
 : February 8, 2026
   

  

 American University of Sharjah invites applicants for a full\-time faculty position at the rank of Professor who will also serve as Her Highness Sheikha Jawaher Bint Mohammed Al Qasimi Endowed Chair in Women’s Leadership. The successful candidate is expected to promote interdisciplinary research, innovative teaching and community engagement in women's leadership, advancing understanding of leadership dynamics, gender equity and empowerment. Priority will be given to distinguished scholars with a significant body of work addressing challenges, practices and strategies in women’s leadership across sectors. The Endowed Chair will play a key role in advancing the university mission to foster an inclusive environment, advocating for women’s empowerment and social equity. The selected candidate will be appointed to a full\-time, rolling\-track faculty position within an academic department that aligns with their area of expertise
   

  

**Job Qualifications**
 The Endowed Chair in Women’s Leadership is expected to have a PhD (or terminal degree) in one of the disciplines represented in the four colleges/school at AUS; a distinguished record of outstanding intellectual contributions in research and education in Women's Leadership, evidenced by high scholarly productivity and impact; excellence in teaching; proven leadership capability; and familiarity with the cultural context of the region. A successful candidate is expected to contribute to the curriculum at the undergraduate, graduate, post\-graduate and/or professional levels.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Conduct and publish original research with an explicit focus on women’s leadership and advancement, women in multicultural and complex societies, or social justice and women’s advancement in the UAE and Gulf.
* Build intellectual community and provide leadership through outreach activities that bring the community in direct contact with scholarly experts, including public discussions, workshops and symposiums.
* Create and help deliver innovative leadership programs that enable women to benefit from the latest leadership insights for the development of personal strategies that build confidence, influence and resilience.
* Advocate for women's issues and gender equity within the academic community.


**APPLICATION PROCEDURE:** 
 To apply, the following documents are requested:
 **(** 
**a)** 
 a cover letter (maximum two pages), outlining your vision for the endowed chair position, your interest in the role, and how your expertise and past experiences related to women’s leadership make you a strong candidate;
 **(** 
**b** 
**)** 
 a one\- to two\-page statement detailing your contributions to advancing women’s leadership and outlining your plans to engage both internal and external communities in realizing the vision of the endowed chair;
 **(** 
**c** 
**)** 
 your curriculum vitae, including your teaching experience and list of publications;
 **(d)** 
 your teaching philosophy; and
 **(e)** 
 your research statement.
   

  

 Please apply online at \<a href\="javascript:aus\_external\_warning\_ShowExternalUrlDialog("https://acg\-apps1\.aus.edu/cas/empapp/apply.php?p\=CAS\-26\-01");" rel\="nofollow"\>https://acg\-apps1\.aus.edu/cas/empapp/apply.php?p\=CAS\-26\-01\.
   

  

 Review of applicants will begin immediately. For best consideration, apply by February 8, 2026\. The posting is expected to remain open until it is filled. The preferred start date for the role is on or before August 15, 2026\.
   

  

**ABOUT THE UNIVERSITY:** 
 American University of Sharjah is a not\-for\-profit, independent, coeducational institution of higher education formed on the American models of liberal arts education and thoroughly grounded in Arab culture. Located in University City, Sharjah, AUS offers undergraduate and graduate degree programs to more than 6,800 students from over 100 nations. English is the language of instruction and the workplace. AUS has been ranked among the top 10 Arab universities by QS World University Rankings every year for the past 10 consecutive years.
   

  

 AUS is licensed and its programs are accredited by the Commission for Academic Accreditation of the Ministry of Education’s Higher Education Affairs Division in the United Arab Emirates. AUS has been accredited in the United States of America by the Middle States Commission on Higher Education (1007 North Orange Street, 4th Floor, MB \#166, Wilmington, DE 19801 USA) since June 2004\.
   

  

 Situated nearby Sharjah International Airport in the expansive University City area, and only 30 minutes from Dubai International Airport, AUS is located in a dynamic and cosmopolitan area that includes abundant opportunities for travel, entertainment, cultural experiences and natural beauty. Salary and benefits are competitive.
   

  

**ABOUT SHARJAH AND THE UNITED ARAB EMIRATES:** 
 The United Arab Emirates is home to close to 10 million people from more than 200 nationalities. Sharjah is the third most populous of the UAE’s seven emirates after Dubai and Abu Dhabi. For more information, see
 **https://u.ae/en/about\-the\-uae** 
 .

**Job Summary:** 




 We are seeking an experienced and visionary leader to oversee the Ministry's Volunteer Management Department and drive the development of a sustainable and impactful national volunteer ecosystem. The successful candidate will play a key role in strengthening social responsibility, developing innovative volunteer programs, and driving measurable social impact across the UAE.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Lead the development and implementation of the Ministry's volunteer management strategy, ensuring alignment with national priorities and organizational objectives.
* Develop policies, frameworks, and governance models to regulate and enhance volunteer programs across the UAE.
* Build and strengthen strategic partnerships with government entities, private sector organizations, non\-profit organizations, and community partners to expand volunteer opportunities.
* Oversee the planning, coordination, and delivery of national volunteer initiatives, campaigns, and community engagement programs.
* Develop and monitor performance indicators, impact assessments, and reports to measure the effectiveness of volunteer programs and social responsibility initiatives.
* Design innovative programs to attract, engage, develop, and retain volunteers while promoting a culture of volunteerism across society.
* Lead initiatives to match volunteers with suitable opportunities based on skills, competencies, and community needs.
* Oversee volunteer training, capability\-building, and awareness programs to enhance volunteer effectiveness and community impact.
* Drive continuous improvement by implementing best practices in volunteer management, stakeholder engagement, and service delivery.
* Manage departmental operations, including strategic planning, budgeting, performance management, governance, and resource allocation.
* Lead, develop, and mentor a high\-performing team while fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Public Administration, Social Sciences, Human Resources, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree is preferred.



  





**Experience:** 



* Minimum
 **10 years of progressive experience** 
 in volunteer management, community development, corporate social responsibility (CSR), public sector management, or social impact programs.
* Minimum
 **5 years in a leadership role** 
 managing teams, strategic initiatives, and stakeholder partnerships.
* Proven experience in developing policies, strategies, and large\-scale community or volunteer initiatives.
* Strong experience building partnerships across government, private, and non\-profit sectors.
* Demonstrated experience in performance management, governance, and strategic planning.
* Experience working within the UAE Government or public sector is highly desirable.

*“The GSMA’s MENA team is expanding and we have an exciting opportunity for a high\-performing Policy Director to work with the MENA team to engage all stakeholders with GSMA programs and policy \& technology orientated activities. The role entails a lot of travel, ability to work under pressure and a deep technical and policy background”.*
 Head of MENA
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a creative and energetic Director to lead GSMA programmes in the Middle East and North Africa. The Director will be responsible for advancing GSMA’s objectives in the MENA region. This will involve leading engagements on policy and regulations as well as being the technical expert and reference point for broader GSMA activities both within the organisation and in relations with our members. You will need to demonstrate clear understanding of mobile industry comfortable communicating this at a range of levels of detail. You will also be required to attend some GSMA working groups when needed, to provide descriptions of general industry topics and specific GSMA projects. You may be required to attend meetings of other industry forums.
   

  

 You will have a good understanding of existing and future mobile technology and be able to demonstrate knowledge of the future industry trends and their likely impacts on mobile network evolution and development. You will be able to articulate potential industry positions in areas of confluence of Mobile with other verticals, including, but not limited to, banking and finance, healthcare, education, and other service industries where mobile technology plays a critical role in shifting paradigms for solution delivery.
   

  

 You will also be able to demonstrate the ability to understand the commercial implications of technical decisions and vice versa.
   

  

 You will also engage all stakeholders with GSMA Technology programmes and technology orientated activities (MC, IoT, RCS, 5G, IMEI, Mobile Money, etc.).
   

  

 The Policy Director reports to the Head of MENA. This role works very closely with the rest of the small MENA team.
   

  

**You Will**
* Lead industry engagement and projects on spectrum and policy matters as well as broader GSMA activities in region.
* Manage Working Group and Regional Interest Group activity in region.
* Engage with member leadership in region.
* Responsible for input towards regional business planning.
* Manage programme delivery in region against HQ KPIs and member expectations.
* Responsible for delivering within the annual regional budget allocation.
* Responsible for regional reporting in accordance with HQ requirements, presenting progress against regional KPIs and defining corrective action where appropriate.

* Relevant experience working in the telecoms industry is essential. Ideally with an operator or vendor.

* Capable of delivering presentations to a technical audience on these services.
* You will be fluent in English. Arabic and/or French would be an advantage.
* A proven track record of proposition development and the ability to influence and add value to your area of business.
* Strong writing skills, messaging, leadership positioning and narrative development.
* Experience working in an international environment, ideally in the MENA/SSA region.

* Experience of working with multiple internal stakeholders and with geographically dispersed teams in a matrix structure.

* Communication

 Department Contractor

 Contingent Worker

 Working at the GSMA offers you unparalleled access to the mobile industry. We offer a chance to truly shape the direction of mobile, whatever your role. By joining the GSMA, you will be exposed to a fast\-paced rapidly evolving environment, working on global solutions, genuinely fascinating and industry\-changing projects and a stimulating and dynamic environment designed to enable you to flourish.
   

  

 In addition to architect\-designed offices and competitive compensation, our benefits include fantastic learning \& development opportunities, generous holiday allowances, four additional days off for professional development and many others.

 We care deeply about diversity, equity and inclusivity and aspire to be the best at it. The sucess of the GSMA year on year will continue to be contributed by people from all walks of life.
   

  

**GSMA Values**
 Our values not only drive our culture – they shape how we work and interact inside and outside our global organisation.
   

  

**Passionately driven**
 We approach everything we do with unparalleled capability, tenacity and commitment, knowing that the challenging scale, pace and complexity of our work is what leads to its world\-changing impact.
   

  

**Insightful leaders**

**Stronger together**
 We lean on each other so the industry can lean on us, embracing our diversity by actively seeking out perspectives and skill sets beyond our own, fuelling each other’s successes and constantly asking how we can help.
   

  

 Underpinning our values is our collective mindset to show up purposefully as good human beings every day, in every situation. **Who are we?**
 At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries.
   

  

**Who are we?**
 At Finastra, we are a global leader in financial services software, committed to broadening access to financial services and shaping the future of banking. Our solutions support over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, across more than 110 countries, powering mission‑critical capabilities in Universal Banking, Payments, and Lending.
   

  

 We are looking for a Director of Strategy, Corporate Development \& PMO to join our Universal Banking organisation. This is a high‑impact, enterprise‑level role reporting directly to the Chief of Staff, sitting at the centre of strategy execution, governance, and value delivery for one of Finastra’s most important businesses.
   

  

 This is an exciting opportunity for someone who can combine strategic thinking with strong execution discipline, and who thrives in complex, matrixed environments with senior‑level exposure.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a
 **Customer Success Director – Corporate Lending** 
 to lead customer success outcomes across a portfolio of strategic customers using solutions including
 **Loan IQ, Trade, and Corporate Channels** 
 . This role is responsible for driving customer adoption, retention, renewal readiness, and long\-term value realization while serving as a trusted advisor to customers and a key partner across Sales, Product, Professional Services, and Support teams.
   

  

 The successful candidate will combine strong customer relationship management, commercial acumen, and domain expertise in lending or financial services to ensure customers achieve their business objectives and maximize the value of their Finastra investment.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Drive customer adoption, value realization, and business outcomes across a portfolio of Corporate Lending customers.

* Lead customer engagements including onboarding, success reviews, and executive business reviews.
* Partner with Sales teams to support renewals, increase retention, and identify expansion opportunities.
* Act as a trusted advisor and executive sponsor for key strategic accounts.
* Support customer transformation initiatives including cloud migration, platform modernization, upgrades, and SaaS adoption.
* Drive adoption of new product capabilities and promote best practices for change management and user adoption.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Support, and Professional Services teams to resolve issues and improve customer outcomes.
* Provide customer insights and feedback to influence product strategy and service improvements.
* Contribute to revenue retention, customer satisfaction, and overall portfolio growth through effective customer engagement.


**Required Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities with a proactive approach to risk management.

**Benefits**
 We are proud to offer a range of incentives to our employees worldwide. These benefits are available to everyone, regardless of grade, and reflect the values we stand for:

 Enjoy unlimited vacation, subject to local regulations and business priorities. Benefit from hybrid working arrangements and inclusive policies such as paid time off for voting, bereavement, and sick leave.
   

  

**Well‑being:** 
 Access confidential one‑to‑one support through our Employee Assistance Program, connect with our network of Wellbeing Champions and Gather Groups, and take part in monthly events and initiatives designed to help you thrive—inside and outside of work.

 Medical, life and disability insurance, retirement plans, lifestyle, and other benefits.\*
   

  

**Sustainability:** 
 Paid time off for volunteering and donation‑matching opportunities to support causes that matter to you.
   

  

**Inclusion:** 
 Get involved in our inclusion communities, such as Count Me In, Culture@Finastra, Proud@Finastra, Disabilities@Finastra, and Women@Finastra—open to everyone who wants to participate and contribute.
   

  

**Career Development:** 
 Access online learning and accredited courses through our Skills \& Career Navigator tool.
   

  

**Recognition:** 
 Take part in our global recognition program, Finastra Celebrates, and share your voice through regular employee surveys that help shape our culture and ways of working.
   

  

* Specific benefits may vary by location.


 At Finastra, each individual is unique—bringing their own ideas, perspectives, cultural backgrounds, and experiences. We learn from one another, value what makes us different, and create an environment where everyone feels included, supported, and able to be their authentic selves.
   

  

 Be unique. Be exceptional. Help us make a difference at Finastra.

 The AMS Solution Design \& Delivery role supports the development and execution of ATM Managed Services solutions across the Middle East region, as part of Brink’s Rest of World region. Working closely with regional sales teams, Brink’s country teams, customers, product teams, operations, finance, and technology partners, this role translates customer needs into practical, scalable, and commercially sound AMS solutions.
   

  

 This position supports the VP, AMS Solutions \& Strategy, and peers within and outside the region, by leading solution discovery, developing solution concepts, coordinating product and operational inputs, and helping move approved solutions from customer proposal through implementation readiness. The role is customer\-facing and hands\-on, requiring strong business judgment, operational understanding, and the ability to coordinate across a complex global organization.
   

  

 This is a highly visible and important role within Brink’s IMEA region. It reports directly to the VP, AMS Solutions Development and serves as a primary regional solution architect.
   

  

 The role may support opportunities in countries such as the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, and other Middle East markets, depending on customer demand and Brink’s regional priorities.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Solution Development \& Commercial Structuring**
* Lead end\-to\-end solution development for AMS opportunities from qualification through migration readiness.
* Engage Brink’s largest bank customers and prospects in the Middle East at senior levels to translate client requirements into detailed, executable multi\-vendor AMS solutions.
* Present solutions to customers, including senior leadership.

data.jd_text:
We are a global real estate developer with a presence in over 150 offices worldwide and a strong, established footprint across the Middle East. We deliver world\-class residential and commercial developments, driven by innovation, technical excellence, and a passion for creating inspiring spaces. We are seeking a highly skilled
 **Technical Product Manager / Delivery Lead** 
 (Governed Digital \& AI Platform) to join our team in Dubai, UAE.
 



  





 We are consolidating its AI and digital products into a single governed enterprise platform: one shared technical spine, a controlled release path, and clear boundaries between the core product, modules delivered by separate teams, and standalone or experimental work.
 



  





 This role owns that platform on the technical side and leads the team that builds it. It is a deliberate hybrid of technical product manager and delivery lead. You set and hold the technical and architectural direction, and you are accountable for delivering it into production and running the engineering team that does the work. It is a hands\-on role, not a coordination seat.
 



  





  





**Reporting and team** 




 Reports to the Head of Strategic Transformation. Leads the platform engineering team (AI engineers, data engineer, graduate developer) and owns its delivery cadence, standards, and growth, including new technical hires. Serves as the technical counterpart to the product managers delivering individual modules, holding the interface contract they build against, and is the single technical owner other teams approach when new work needs a home.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 




**Platform architecture and governance** 



* Own and maintain the platform's solution architecture: one governed spine (authentication, APIs, design system, data schema) consumed across every workstream, with isolation boundaries drawn so a failure in one module never destabilises the platform.
* Define and enforce the interface contract that separately built modules must meet before entering any shared environment.
* Keep repository, naming, and URL conventions consistent across the estate so it stays legible and maintainable as it scales.



**Release and deployment** 



* Run the promotion path across Development, UAT, and Production with defined gate criteria at each stage, so nothing reaches production unreviewed.
* Manage batched releases of core components, and land externally built modules behind feature flags so a failing module can be switched off without downtime.
* Migrate the platform from local development into COMPANY's managed environment and keep the deployment pipeline automated and repeatable rather than manual.



**Integration and forward delivery** 



* Onboard incoming modules through contract compliance, integration testing, and a defined graduation gate, protecting the core release cycle throughout.
* Own the forward technical roadmap: scope, sequence, and deliver new capability, and decide what becomes a core release, an integrated module, or a retired experiment.



**Team leadership and delivery** 



* Line\-manage the engineering team: set sprint cadence, review architecture and code, uphold quality and security standards, and develop the team as it grows.
* Remain technical enough to work in the codebase, make architecture decisions, and unblock the team directly.



**Governance and assurance** 



* Ensure every capability that supports live client work is auditable, access\-controlled, and defensible, consistent with COMPANY's governed\-platform standard.



  





**Essential experience** 



* At least eight years in software delivery, including a minimum of four leading engineering or technical product teams that shipped and operated production systems.
* Proven ownership of a multi\-environment deployment lifecycle (Development, UAT, Production), CI/CD, feature flagging, and release governance on a live product.
* A hands\-on engineering background: able to read and review code, reason about API and data\-schema design, and make architecture decisions, not only coordinate those who do.
* Direct line management of developers, including setting standards and running delivery cadence.
* Experience integrating independently built modules into a shared platform without destabilising it, using interface contracts, versioning, and isolation.



**Technical competencies** 



* Modern web application architecture, API design, and data modelling.
* Cloud deployment and environment management; infrastructure\-as\-code and pipeline automation an advantage.
* Working fluency with AI\-assisted development tooling, including Claude Code, and comfort operating an application stack backed by large language models (model routing, prompting, guardrails).
* Version control, branching strategy, and code review at team scale.



**Desirable** 



* Exposure to the architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) sector, or a computational design background.
* Experience deploying enterprise AI under governance, audit, or regulatory constraint.
* A record of establishing canonical project and configuration conventions across multiple repositories.



**First\-year outcomes** 



* The platform is fully migrated to the managed environment with a documented, repeatable deployment pipeline.
* The interface contract is published and every new module onboards through it, with no integration destabilising the core platform.
* The Development, UAT, and Production promotion path operates on defined gates with no unreviewed production releases.
* The engineering team runs a predictable release cadence, with new technical hires productive.
* Agreed module deliveries are integrated on schedule against the roadmap.



  





**Scope note:** 




  





 This is a hybrid technical product manager and delivery lead role. Product prioritisation and stakeholder alignment are part of it, but the core accountability is technical: architecture, deployment, governance, and the delivery team. It is not a portfolio\-management or purely coordinating position.

**We are an applied AI lab building end\-to\-end software agents.**
 We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer, and Windsurf, the AI\-native IDE. Together, they represent our vision for collaborative AI teammates that enable engineers to focus on more interesting problems and empower teams to strive for more ambitious goals.
   

  

 Our team is small and talent\-dense. Among our founding team, we have world\-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro.
   

  

 Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real\-world tasks, apply to join us.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Applied AI Transformation Managers are technically oriented strategic advisors and operators who ensure value alignment to our customer's most strategic projects and drive program delivery across several strategic accounts. You’ll be responsible for identifying strategic opportunities for our customers to realize value from Cognition’s platform and ensuring strong value capture and reporting. You will support delivery of enterprise wide programs to implement agentic AI, specifically by designing and building the operating model and delivery model for agentic AI.
   

  

 You’ll act as a trusted advisor to senior and functional leaders, designing value realization targets and delivering transformation programs. This role embeds with a select set of Cognition’s strategic accounts for upfront strategy work through in\-depth program management and delivery. You will be on the frontlines of supporting customers turning productivity gains and quantifiable financial impact. You will pioneer the playbook for how the world’s largest enterprises get value from AI Agents.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Work with customer leadership to identify, quantify and report value targets for productivity gains and financial impact
* Ensure seamless operations and delivery for the overall customer program, in close partnership with the Cognition account team
* Ensure everyone at customer and Cog has visibility on playbook implementation, consumption metrics and value metrics
* Maintain great relationships and customer trust via delivery
* Oversee onboarding and rollout to thousands of engineers, ensuring successful deployment
* Apply world class analytical and technical program management skills to support customer executives and teams, particularly with value realization and tracking
* Build centers of excellence within accounts and empower them through tailored enablement programs


**Requirements For The Role**
* Computer science or EE undergrad
* SWE intern or full time work experience
* 3\-5 years at a big 3 strategy consulting firm with a strong background in value targeting and realization and technology strategy as well as a proven track record building and expanding client relationships
* Ideally 2\+ years experience at a startup in a customer facing role preferred
* Thrive in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments—you move quickly and grow quickly
* Demonstrated ability to learn exceptionally fast


**You might excel if you…**
* have successfully been a part of complex enterprise teams, especially sourcing and managing account growth
* have worked as a software engineer, SE, technical account manager or other technical role
* previously founded a startup or were early stage at a high growth startup
* are a competitive, highly ambitious person who loves working in high\-intensity environments


 Equal Opportunity
   

  

 Cognition is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout the hiring process \- please let us know if you need any.

**Job Purpose**
* The Plant Director is responsible for providing strategic and operational leadership for the manufacturing facility, ensuring safe, efficient, and profitable operations. The role delivers manufacturing excellence aligned with business strategy, approved budgets, and customer requirements, while ensuring compliance with UAE regulatory authorities and international standards.
* The position drives performance across safety, quality, delivery, cost, and sustainability, champions continuous improvement and advanced manufacturing practices, and builds a high performing, future ready leadership team

**Job Dimensions**

* Reports to: Manufacturing Operations Director
* Direct Reports: Business Unit Managers, Maintenance Manager, Supply Chain Manager, Purchase Manager, Production Engineering Manager, Contracts Manager and Finance Manager
* Functional reports: IT Lead, Regional HR Manager, HSE Manager, Quality Manager

 Strategy \& Operations

**Director Advisory Group Water \& Maritime Middle East**

data.jd_text:
**Director Advisory Group Water \& Maritime Middle East** 




 Would you like to contribute to Haskoning’s ambitious Strategy in the Middle East? The region is one of our strategic focus areas, currently with Water and Maritime at its core. Haskoning aims to build on this core to accelerate growth and expand other parts of the businesses through a cross\-business line Advisory Group.
 



  





**What you do as a Director Advisory Group** 




 As the Director of the Advisory Group (DAG) Water \& Maritime Middle East, you will lead, develop, and empower a dynamic international team of 30 plus highly skilled professionals based primarily in the United Arab Emirates, Oman and Saudia Arabia. You will be supported by the management team of Water \& Maritime Americas Middle East \& India and the Associate Directors in the Advisory Group based in Oman and the United Arab Emirates. In this pivotal role, you will not just manage a team — you will spearhead growth, drive innovation, and shape the future of the Haskoning business in the Middle East in a way that enhances sustainability and resilience for clients across the globe.
 



  





 Furthermore, you will also lead the development and growth of a cross\-business line Advisory Group. The group currently comprises around 10 staff and is expected to grow to approximately 50 over the next four years. You will be responsible for executing the group’s growth strategy, developing a strong and diverse team, and creating effective collaboration across different parts of Haskoning’s global business. This will include identifying new client opportunities, shaping multidisciplinary advisory services, strengthening relationships with key internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring the group achieves sustainable commercial performance. You will play a central role in establishing the cross\-business Advisory Group as a recognised platform for integrated advisory services in the Middle East, with a focus on growth, innovation, client impact, and long\-term value for Haskoning.
 



  





 In addition to the Director of Advisory Group it is expected that you will in due course assume responsibilities of Resident Director for the UAE. In this capacity, you will act as Haskoning’s senior representative in the United Arab Emirates, providing country\-level leadership across all Business Lines and Global Leading Markets. Resident Director is responsible for the effective management of the UAE entity, ensuring that local operations are aligned with company strategy, governance requirements, and regional and global priorities. This includes oversight of statutory and regulatory compliance, company registrations, finance and taxation, payroll, human resources, visas and work permits, facilities management, health and safety, risk management, and the overall performance and culture of the local office. Resident Director will also represent Haskoning with clients, partners, authorities, and other key stakeholders, helping to strengthen our market position, safeguard business continuity, and enable sustainable growth in the UAE.
 



  





 This opportunity has arisen as the current incumbent moves into a new role within Haskoning. We are seeking a successor who is committed to the Haskoning group and the region for the long term.
 



 Key Performance Indicators:
 


* **P\&L Responsibility, Commercial success and continuous improvement** 
 : Drive the commercial and financial success of the Advisory Group by fostering co\-creation with global clients and partners. Generate focused growth in our key markets by connecting teams within the Advisory Group and with other expertise centres across the globe.



  




* **Stakeholder management:** 
 Build strong communication channels within and outside Haskoning to encourage seamless cooperation and create a distinct, unified identity. You will serve as the glue that holds teams together, fostering relationships that accelerate both business and environmental impact.



  




* **People management** 
 : Cultivate an environment and culture where both individuals and the business can thrive. Develop the Advisory Group strategy as part of Haskoning’s overarching corporate and Business Line / Business Unit strategies and enable the Associate Directors to implement it successfully under your guidance and leadership.



  




* **Project Delivery** 
 (of proof of concepts, projects and support contracts), including:



 \-Meeting client's expectations, achieving required scope and quality
 



 \-Driving Financial performance
 



 \-Promoting solid and accountable project management practices.
 



  





 You will report directly to the Business Unit Director of Water \& Maritime Americas Middle East \& India and be a key member of the Business Unit Management Team, collaborating on the broader vision and strategy of our business.
 



  





**Where will you work** 




 Haskoning is a globally established and operating independent consultancy, engineering and project management firm which integrates over 140 years of domain expertise with digital technologies and software solutions. Our 6,500 colleagues work from offices in more than 25 countries across the world. Through our mission Enhancing Society Together, we take responsibility for having a positive impact on the planet.
 



 You will be based in our Dubai office with frequent travel across the region.
 



  





**What you bring** 




 We are looking for a visionary leader with a strategic mindset. You thrive in dynamic environments, have a natural ability to lead and inspire diverse teams, and are ready to drive the next chapter of growth for the Middle East.
 



  




* Higher Education in engineering, management or environmental disciplines;
* Extensive Experience in Engineering Consultancy in the Maritime or related industry, also with the knowledge of the Energy \& Industry sectors being advantageous;
* Minimum of 5 years Line management (including P\&L) responsibility, with proven experience to lead teams of at least 30 people;
* A network of clients in the Middle East region is a significant advantage;
* General management and entity management experience is an advantage;
* Fluent in English with the ability to engage stakeholders across cultures and geographies. Arabic would be an advantage but is not essential;
* An international outlook, with experience working in diverse, multicultural environments, ensuring effective communication across borders



  





**What we offer** 




 Within our company you will be able to develop yourself while working on challenging projects across the globe. Besides that, we also offer:
 


* A good work\-life balance, with the flexibility to work from home up to 2 days per week;
* 25 annual leave days per year, based on a 40\-hour work week;
* A competitive salary package;
* Lifelong learning by offering you plenty of training \& development opportunities.
* Profit share based on company profit.
* Medical insurance



  





**Are you our new colleague?** 




 We would like to meet you! Click on the apply button and upload your resume and motivation letter. After receiving your application, we will contact you as soon as possible. Are we all enthusiastic after this? Then you will receive an offer from us, and we will be happy to welcome you on board!
 



 In case of questions, please contact Anouk de Winter, recruiter, anouk.de.winter@haskoning.com.
 



 Please note the deadline for receiving applications is Wednesday the 15th of July 2026\.
 



  





 Due to the privacy law, please submit your application via the apply button and not via email.
 



***Acquisition of this vacancy by agencies is not appreciated and the candidates offered will not be taken into consideration.***

data.jd_text:
The Construction Manager – Electrical is responsible for the comprehensive planning, execution, and delivery of medium to large\-scale EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) projects, particularly in the power and infrastructure sectors. The role requires a highly experienced professional with a Degree Electrical Engineering and 8 to 15 years of proven experience in executing electrical projects across Gulf countries and/or India. The candidate must possess strong technical knowledge and leadership skills to handle complex project environments, including substations, power plants, and overhead transmission line projects.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in the construction of medium and large substations, including associated civil and electrical works. Demonstrated expertise in handling power projects such as high\-voltage substations, transmission networks, and overhead lines is essential. The Construction Manager will be accountable for overseeing all construction activities, ensuring adherence to project specifications, design drawings, and contractual obligations.
   

  

 A key responsibility of this role is to ensure the smooth execution of the entire project lifecycle, from mobilization to commissioning and final handover. The candidate must possess strong project management skills to coordinate effectively with clients, consultants, subcontractors, and vendors. The role demands excellent communication and interpersonal abilities to manage stakeholder expectations and resolve project\-related challenges efficiently.
   

  

 The Construction Manager must take full ownership of project timelines, ensuring that all activities are completed within the stipulated timeframe and budget. This includes planning resources, scheduling work, monitoring progress, and implementing corrective measures when required. Strong supervisory and leadership capabilities are critical, as the individual will be responsible for managing multidisciplinary teams and fostering a productive work environment.
   

  

 In addition to construction oversight, the candidate must ensure strict compliance with quality standards and Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) regulations. The role involves implementing and monitoring quality assurance and quality control processes to ensure that all works meet industry standards and client expectations. The Construction Manager must proactively identify and mitigate risks associated with construction activities, ensuring minimal disruption to project progress.
   

  

 Experience in subcontractor management is a crucial requirement for this position. The candidate should have a proven track record of selecting, managing, and coordinating subcontractors to ensure that all work is executed efficiently and in compliance with project specifications. This includes reviewing subcontractor performance, resolving disputes, and ensuring alignment with project objectives.
   

  

 Risk management is another key aspect of the role. The Construction Manager must identify potential project risks at an early stage and develop mitigation strategies to avoid delays or cost overruns. The ability to make informed decisions under pressure and adapt to changing project conditions is essential.
   

  

 The candidate must be self\-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently while maintaining a collaborative approach within the project team. Strong problem\-solving skills are required to address technical and operational challenges effectively. Attention to detail, combined with the ability to see the bigger picture, will enable the successful delivery of projects that meet or exceed client expectations.
   

  

 Overall, the Construction Manager – Electrical will have full responsibility for managing and supervising all construction\-related activities, ensuring the successful execution and timely completion of projects in line with contractual commitments. This role offers an opportunity to work on challenging and high\-profile projects, contributing significantly to the development of power and infrastructure sectors in the region.

Role Purpose

data.jd_text:
Role Purpose
 
 The MEP Project Manager is responsible for the overall planning, coordination, execution, and delivery of Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) works on construction projects. The role ensures that MEP systems are completed on time, within budget, and in compliance with contractual, technical, quality, and safety requirements. The MEP Project Manager leads MEP teams and coordinates with all stakeholders to achieve successful project delivery.
 


 Key Accountabilities
 
**Project Management \& Planning** 



* Manage end\-to\-end delivery of MEP works from design review to commissioning and handover.
* Review MEP contract documents, drawings, specifications, and BOQs.
* Prepare MEP execution plans, project schedules, manpower plans, and procurement strategies.
* Monitor progress against approved schedules and take corrective actions as needed.



**Technical Oversight** 



* Ensure proper implementation of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire fighting, ELV, and BMS systems.
* Resolve technical and coordination issues in collaboration with consultants and design teams.
* Review and approve shop drawings, material submittals, and method statements.



**Coordination \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Coordinate MEP works with civil, architectural, and structural teams to avoid clashes and delays.
* Liaise with clients, consultants, authorities, subcontractors, and suppliers.
* Lead MEP coordination meetings and contribute to overall project meetings.



**Cost \& Commercial Management** 



* Control MEP budgets and monitor costs, variations, and claims.
* Review subcontractor payments, variations, and final accounts.
* Support procurement activities and evaluate technical and commercial offers.



**Quality, Testing \& Commissioning** 



* Ensure implementation of QA/QC procedures for all MEP works.
* Oversee testing, commissioning, and system integration activities.
* Manage snagging, defects rectification, and final handover documentation (O\&M manuals, as\-built drawings).



**Health, Safety \& Compliance** 



* Ensure strict compliance with HSE policies and statutory requirements.
* Promote safe working practices and lead safety initiatives on site.


 Qualifications, Experience, Knowledge \& Skills
 * Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering (Master’s degree is a plus).
* 15\+ years of experience in MEP works within construction projects.
* Proven experience managing large\-scale commercial, residential, hospitality, or mixed\-use projects.
* Strong knowledge of international standards and local authority regulations.

data.jd_text:
At Lummus Technology, innovation thrives, and excellence is a shared pursuit. When you join Lummus, you are empowered to make an impact and be part of a dynamic team that celebrates creativity, encourages professional development, and fosters collaboration.
   

  

 From our technology portfolio to our global workforce, Lummus is growing at a rapid pace, and we hope that you will grow with us during this exciting time.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants International (LCI) is an autonomous business within Lummus Technology that provides technical, environmental \& social and management consulting services worldwide. We work primarily in the energy industry, with a depth of expertise in power generation, oil \& gas, refining and petrochemicals. We maintain a very strong presence in the international technical due diligence markets to support the global financial industry. LCI has a far\-reaching organization with offices in the United States, UK, the Middle East and Asia.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants is looking for a Business Development Director to grow the company into the area of technical and management consulting in the energy industry – offshore and onshore oil \& gas, LNG, pipelines, power generation and transmission, as well as refining and petrochemicals. This role will be expected to help grow the consulting practice area in the fields of oil\& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization and will primarily entail growing relationships with the financial community and project developers. Assignments require a high level of experience and ability to focus quickly on important issues.
   

  

 The individual we are seeking must be comfortable and confident to work in a seller/doer organization structure.
   

  

**Position**
 The Business Development Director will be expected to grow and lead a new consulting practice area in the fields of Oil \& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization. The group VP and the Leadership Team should have contacts and skills to help him achieve this goal. An international focus is expected. Areas of skill and knowledge should include knowledge of project financing, capex benchmarking analysis, O\&M practices and costs, M\&A support, due diligence and strategy development. The candidate will be expected to lead and participate in advisory assignments, conduct business development, and manage his/her practice business area and interface with Lummus Consultants’ senior management. Additional business areas may be identified based upon the candidate’s personal history and strengths and interests.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities**
* Grow Lummus Consultants’ business – in cooperation with the existing business heads. His growth strategy should be heavily focused on technical solutions but with a broad business perspective beyond traditional due diligence assignments.
* Develop a business plan to capitalize on existing talents and resources within Lummus Consultants and Lummus Technology; the candidate’s strengths; and market opportunities.
* Grow name recognition of Lummus Consultants in all Energy industry segments (with assistance from the Lummus Communication team and other internal resources).
* Carry out business development, marketing, and proposal preparation efforts and lead Key Account Management teams efforts.
* Lead or participate in consulting project work.
* Prepare clear and concise written reports on assignments, develop conclusions and present clear and precise written and verbal results to clients.
* Expand the Lummus Consulting practice area (globally), consistent with the business plan – identify gaps in skills and potential recruits.
* Achieve objectives with minimal oversight.
* Management of the P\&L forecast by close collaboration with his supervisor and finance.
* Report to Senior Director of Lummus Consultants in Dubai office.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Required**
* Strong leadership abilities and excellent interpersonal skills
* Strong communicator with excellent written and oral communication skills
* Must have a high degree of self\-motivation and energy
* Must have proven ability to manage business forecasting, short and long term projection
* Capability of earning respect from the team and capable of influencing others without authority
* Excellent professional image/presentation
* Knowledge of many cultures/international style
* Strong commercial savvy and negotiating skills
* Interest in being knowledgeable in all services offerings in Lummus Consultants portfolio
* Ability to work well with finance partners.
* Must have a strong balance of technical and commercial capabilities.


**Basic Qualifications**
* A degree\-educated Engineer; MBA is a plus but not required.
* The candidate should have at least 20 years relevant professional experience.
* Prior experience with an owner/operator or major engineering company and/or consultancy.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including ability to write clear and concise reports in English.
* The candidate should have strong interpersonal skills and be comfortable conversing with clients and senior management
* Demonstrated management and project management skills


**Office Location and Travel:**
* Dubai office. Relocation is not being offered.
* Job\-related travel (business trips usually requiring less than a two\-week duration; often just one or two days) which includes international travel to financial institutions in London, is an important part of the work. Time away from the office may average 10 to 30 percent of work hours.


 Lummus Technology is the global leader in developing technology solutions that make modern life possible and focus on a more sustainable, low carbon future. data.jd_text:
Would you like to contribute to Haskoning’s ambitious Strategy in the Middle East? The region is one of our strategic focus areas, currently with Water and Maritime at its core. Haskoning aims to build on this core to accelerate growth and expand other parts of the businesses through a cross\-business line Advisory Group.
   

  

**What You Do As a Director Advisory Group**
 As the Director of the Advisory Group (DAG) Water \& Maritime Middle East, you will lead, develop, and empower a dynamic international team of 30 plus highly skilled professionals based primarily in the United Arab Emirates, Oman and Saudia Arabia. You will be supported by the management team of Water \& Maritime Americas Middle East \& India and the Associate Directors in the Advisory Group based in Oman and the United Arab Emirates. In this pivotal role, you will not just manage a team — you will spearhead growth, drive innovation, and shape the future of the Haskoning business in the Middle East in a way that enhances sustainability and resilience for clients across the globe.
   

  

 Furthermore, you will also lead the development and growth of a cross\-business line Advisory Group. The group currently comprises around 10 staff and is expected to grow to approximately 50 over the next four years. You will be responsible for executing the group’s growth strategy, developing a strong and diverse team, and creating effective collaboration across different parts of Haskoning’s global business. This will include identifying new client opportunities, shaping multidisciplinary advisory services, strengthening relationships with key internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring the group achieves sustainable commercial performance. You will play a central role in establishing the cross\-business Advisory Group as a recognised platform for integrated advisory services in the Middle East, with a focus on growth, innovation, client impact, and long\-term value for Haskoning.
   

  

 In addition to the Director of Advisory Group it is expected that you will in due course assume responsibilities of Resident Director for the UAE. In this capacity, you will act as Haskoning’s senior representative in the United Arab Emirates, providing country\-level leadership across all Business Lines and Global Leading Markets. Resident Director is responsible for the effective management of the UAE entity, ensuring that local operations are aligned with company strategy, governance requirements, and regional and global priorities. This includes oversight of statutory and regulatory compliance, company registrations, finance and taxation, payroll, human resources, visas and work permits, facilities management, health and safety, risk management, and the overall performance and culture of the local office. Resident Director will also represent Haskoning with clients, partners, authorities, and other key stakeholders, helping to strengthen our market position, safeguard business continuity, and enable sustainable growth in the UAE.
   

  

 This opportunity has arisen as the current incumbent moves into a new role within Haskoning. We are seeking a successor who is committed to the Haskoning group and the region for the long term.
   

  

 Key Performance Indicators:
   

  

* P\&L Responsibility, Commercial success and continuous improvement: Drive the commercial and financial success of the Advisory Group by fostering co\-creation with global clients and partners. Generate focused growth in our key markets by connecting teams within the Advisory Group and with other expertise centres across the globe.
* Stakeholder management: Build strong communication channels within and outside Haskoning to encourage seamless cooperation and create a distinct, unified identity. You will serve as the glue that holds teams together, fostering relationships that accelerate both business and environmental impact.
* People management: Cultivate an environment and culture where both individuals and the business can thrive. Develop the Advisory Group strategy as part of Haskoning’s overarching corporate and Business Line / Business Unit strategies and enable the Associate Directors to implement it successfully under your guidance and leadership.


* Project Delivery (of proof of concepts, projects and support contracts), including:
+ Meeting client's expectations, achieving required scope and quality
+ Driving Financial performance
+ Promoting solid and accountable project management practices.


 You will report directly to the Business Unit Director of Water \& Maritime Americas Middle East \& India and be a key member of the Business Unit Management Team, collaborating on the broader vision and strategy of our business.
   

  

**Where will you work**
 Haskoning is a globally established and operating independent consultancy, engineering and project management firm which integrates over 140 years of domain expertise with digital technologies and software solutions. Our 6,500 colleagues work from offices in more than 25 countries across the world. Through our mission Enhancing Society Together, we take responsibility for having a positive impact on the planet.
   

  

 You will be based in our Dubai office with frequent travel across the region.
   

  

**What You Bring**
 We are looking for a visionary leader with a strategic mindset. You thrive in dynamic environments, have a natural ability to lead and inspire diverse teams, and are ready to drive the next chapter of growth for the Middle East.
   

  

* Higher Education in engineering, management or environmental disciplines;
* Extensive Experience in Engineering Consultancy in the Maritime or related industry, also with the knowledge of the Energy \& Industry sectors being advantageous;
* Minimum of 5 years Line management (including P\&L) responsibility, with proven experience to lead teams of at least 30 people;
* A network of clients in the Middle East region is a significant advantage;
* General management and entity management experience is an advantage;
* Fluent in English with the ability to engage stakeholders across cultures and geographies. Arabic would be an advantage but is not essential;
* An international outlook, with experience working in diverse, multicultural environments, ensuring effective communication across borders


**What we offer**
 Within our company you will be able to develop yourself while working on challenging projects across the globe. Besides that, we also offer:
   

  

* A good work\-life balance, with the flexibility to work from home up to 2 days per week;
* 25 annual leave days per year, based on a 40\-hour work week;
* A competitive salary package;
* Lifelong learning by offering you plenty of training \& development opportunities.
* Profit share based on company profit.
* Medical insurance


**Are you our new colleague?**
 We would like to meet you! Click on the apply button and upload your resume and motivation letter. After receiving your application, we will contact you as soon as possible. Are we all enthusiastic after this? Then you will receive an offer from us, and we will be happy to welcome you on board!
   

  

 In case of questions, please contact Anouk de Winter, recruiter, anouk.de.winter@haskoning.com.
   

  

 Please note the deadline for receiving applications is Wednesday the 15th of July 2026\.
   

  

 Due to the privacy law, please submit your application via the apply button and not via email.
   

  

***Acquisition of this vacancy by agencies is not appreciated and the candidates offered will not be taken into consideration.***

data.jd_text:
Inhabit is a unique, multi\-disciplinary team of professionals who are passionate about making a positive contribution to our built environment.
   

  





 We are a collective of experienced architects, designers, engineers and detailers who work both independently and in partnership to form a holistic approach to the services that we offer. We believe that our respective areas of expertise can be integrated to allow seamless interdisciplinary synergy to create buildings that are more relevant to our evolving society.
   

  





 We are focused on design\-led engineering, providing technical and comprehensive solutions that thoughtfully and creatively consider aesthetics, engineering, cost, procurement, and sustainability driving towards a building that is sensitive and inspirational within its socio\-cultural context.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**List of Responsibilities**




 The Associate Director forms part of the engineering team within the global structure of the company and assumes responsibilities that pro\-actively contribute to the growth of Façade Engineering and specialist design and engineering team within the global structure of the Inhabit and Egis company structure.
   

  





 The role assumes both KPI based and general responsibilities that actively contribute to project technical and commercial delivery, compliance, functional wellbeing, advancement and growth of facade discipline and all other specialist and general disciplines.
   

  





 This includes responsibility for all design, engineering, documentation, administration and compliance with project constraints undertaken for façade and all other disciplines. You will lead, develop, and manage a team of approx. (5\-10\) direct reports. You may also need to fulfil any legal responsibilities commensurate with your position.
   

  





 This includes responsibility for team engagement and growth, technical excellence, ethics, project leadership, design, engineering, documentation, administration and compliance with project constraints undertaken by the facade team. You will also need to fulfill legal responsibilities commensurate with your position.
   

  





 The following is an overview of responsibilities and performance standards required of the Associate Director:
   

  




* Major Function
* Project Operation / Management
* Strategic Management
* Financial Management
* Marketing and Business Development
* Staff Management, Mentoring and Training
* Client Management
* Project Management
* Consultancy Function
* Technical Excellence
* Personal Growth



**Major Function**




 Duties include but not limited to:
   

  





  

  




* Represent Inhabit on projects with clients and provide technical leadership and assistance to ensure projects meet high quality standards and are managed in accordance with timeframes and budget parameters
* Conduct presentations of proposals for prospective clients and/or projects
* Create, build and maintain business opportunities
* Manage projects and resources to ensure professional services are achieved and deliver high quality focused services on projects to ensure client satisfaction and repeat business
* Participate in a yearly management meeting to develop and contribute to strategic business planning and to set personal KPI’s relevant to your role
* Report to the Director on your performance and the performance of the team as directed
* Attend meetings with clients to manage projects according to Inhabits scope of services
* Provide training and mentoring to the team as the need arises always promoting inclusion and growth for all staff under your leadership
* Prepare project proposals including, where necessary, co\-ordination of inputs from other disciplines and report these bids / wins / losses to the Director
* Maintain regular contact with existing or prospective clients for establishing potential future work
* Active participation in a broad range of client\-focused functions to enhance the professional image of Inhabit
* Assist the Director with staff performance reviews
* Carry out research on potential materials and share knowledge and update technical library
* Keep up to date with relevant design software and products new to the market that will help develop our business
* Maintain an intimate knowledge of relevant codes and standards
* Continually strive to improve technical knowledge and encourage team technical discussions
* Evaluate opportunities for improved efficiencies and effectiveness in consultation with the Director including identifying, developing and implementing standards, systems, tools and processes to support improvement within the business
* Take an active interest in the other disciplines (BMU, Acoustics, Lighting, Sustainability, FLS etc.) to further develop your specialist skills



**Project Operation/ Management**




 You shall be responsible for profitable completion of all projects and tasks under your control whilst maintaining excellent technical standards and client satisfaction. Detailed responsibilities and/or targets include:
   

  




* Assist in the management of the project team in terms of time and cost
* Cost planning and outputs required to meet project budgets
* Business Development and marketing material preparation
* Managing clients to secure work, marketing and fee proposals
* Updating of the administrative systems for recording proposal activities
* Allocation and management of time to suit programs and project budgets
* Ensure projects are completed on\-time and without cost overrun
* Ensure high technical standing on the project such that client complaints do not arise.



**Strategic Management**




 The Associate Director will contribute to short and long\-term regional planning and assist in driving forward the strategy that embodies Inhabit’s values, vision, mission and objectives to successfully grow the business including:
   

  




* Assist in developing the regional business plan aligned to Inhabit strategic plan to be approved by the Regional Manager. Assist in setting regional objectives and in preparing and implementing strategies to achieve the business plan. Ensure staff are well informed and up to date on developments that affect them
* Assist in undertaking regional future workforce planning and projects with an emphasis on growth and innovation.



**Financial Management**




 The Associate Director shall assist in the proper financial management including:
   

  





  

  




* Assist in the development and implementation of annual budgets and ensure that adequate internal control mechanisms are in place
* Monitor financial aspects of projects including monthly invoicing to ensure the accuracy and debtor collection
* Follow up with clients on overdue fees for debtors greater than 90 days
* Assist in reviewing and monitoring monthly financial reports
* Assisting in managing business risks by following appropriate risk appraisal procedures prior to signing (and following award of) any consulting commission



**Marketing and Business Development**




 The Associate Director shall actively participate in the marketing of the practice as a multi\-disciplined engineering company and shall achieve agreed targets in all aspects of practice development, including:
   

  




* Maximise cross\-selling opportunities for Inhabit and prepare project proposals to support profit targets including, where necessary, co\-ordination of inputs from other disciplines (BMU, Acoustics, Lighting, Sustainability, FLS etc)
* Conduct presentations of proposals for prospective clients and/or projects
* Raise any challenges in competitive pricing across the region with the Regional Manager and propose solutions
* Build and expand the client base of Inhabit based on both established, prospective and new client relationships that you secure in the region
* Network within the Industry to develop industry intelligence, define and implement strategies to meet any challenges
* Ensure active participation in a broad range of client\-focused functions, networking events, conferences, seminars, committees etc. to enhance the professional image of both the Associate Director and Inhabit



**Staff Management, Mentoring and Training**




 The Associate Director is responsible for ensuring staff are managed and supported effectively including:
   

  




* Encourage and role model respectful, supportive and positive engagement and interactions across disciplines/support functions and all other Inhabit offices to support positive culture and drive engagement
* Identify the deliverables, tasks and activities required for workload throughout all phases of the project to ensure adequate staff resourcing and tools are available to meet project deliverables and expectations
* Recruitment activities (with prior approval from the Regional Manager and Regional Director, Australia and New Zealand) in accordance with company procedures
* Provide technical leadership, guidance, mentoring and support and build and oversee staff technical development to maintain standards and to operate efficiently
* Ensure staff are following Inhabit’s quality management system
* Hold regular meetings with the Technical Team to discuss scheduling of work in a planned manner including distribution of workload, resources etc. to meet deliverables
* Assist in setting objectives and standards for the expected performance of staff and encourage regular feedback discussions on project successes and challenges to capture lessons learned
* Assist in conducting regular and effective Performance Reviews in accordance within Inhabits’ review system for your direct reports and provide ongoing/regular feedback to foster work performance improvements and promote professional growth of staff
* Identify training needs of the team to increase their skill level, development and growth
* Identify training opportunities, both internally and externally including seminars, events, conferences, talks, university lectures, factory visits, construction phase training etc., to assist with the development of the team and to address any knowledge and skill gaps. Support staff writing technical notes from these training opportunities and/or project experiences
* Encourage and promote Inhabit online materials, technical notes, technical library
* Communicate regularly and proactively with Senior Management as required to assist the process of managing your work/lifestyle balance and of your team
* Ensure staff adhere to and are familiar with all Health and Safety requirements and safe work practices



**Client Management**




 The Associate Director shall continually strengthen client loyalty and gain repeat business by ensuring high quality service and creative (‘Leading Edge’) solutions to clients by way of:
   

  




* Communicate with clients to establish their needs and maintain a dialogue throughout the project
* Monitor feedback from clients and develop and implement action plans for continuous improvement
* Identify and implement ways to enhance current service offerings, systems and processes from a client and business perspective to maximise Inhabit’s competitive advantage
* Identify and implement ways to enhance internal systems, processes and procedures to improve client satisfaction
* Be a role model for exceptional favourable record in client response to timeliness, quality of work and high technical standing on projects and manage in conjunction with Project Director/Leader any client complaints
* Continually aim for repeat and new business from all clients in contact with Inhabit



**Project Management**




 The Associate Director will provide leadership to ensure the efficient and profitable completion of all tasks and projects under their control whilst ensuring the allocation of adequate resources, excellent technical standards and client satisfaction including:
   

  




* Provide overall strategy and technical solutions as required for project challenges
* Undertake or assist the project leaders with negotiation of fees and contracts where appropriate to ensure financial targets are achieved
* Manage business risks by following appropriate risk appraisal procedures prior to the signing contracts
* Allocate and manage project personnel to suit programs and project budgets
* Project lead internally with respective team colleagues to allow deliverables to be issued to client
* Coordinate and work with the design team to deliver project deliverables
* Help solve client/project team’s problems by lateral thinking and creating innovative solutions
* Ensure quality outputs and agreed cost/scheduled delivery time frames are met
* Manage projects, site meetings, design workshops and site inspection as required and/or as project planning stipulates
* As Project Leader, monitor and report on team performance against agreed timelines, and fees/budgets
* Oversee the work of Sub Consultants/Contractors and review outputs produced by them
* Ensure project sheets for each project are undertaken for compliance with project and office QA procedures



**Consultancy Function**




 The Associate Director shall assist in the consultancy functions including:
   

  




* Preparation and coordination of expressions of interest, tender submissions and similar consulting proposals
* Maintain a hands\-on approach to the provision of design and engineering, and assist in the co\-ordination of other consultancy inputs in relation to BMU, Acoustics, Lighting, Sustainability, FLS on an as needs basis
* Contribute and monitor the design and engineering of curtain wall and cladding systems, as well as specialty systems (i.e., structural glass, cables, ETFE etc.)
* Oversee engineering computations and structural façade analysis, advice and reporting
* Meet with architects to develop façade design concepts, detailing, specifications, and engineering feasibility and coordinate with other project consultants such as Builders, Contractors and Sub Contractors to determine best practice façade design outcomes
* Write and review specifications and schedules to inform and respond to site and construction related queries
* Review and comment on sub\-contractor’s shop drawings \& calculations, BD submission drawings, fabrication drawings \& material submission
* Follow the general drawing protocols and cad file system set by Inhabit
* Provide assistance during construction of façade systems including attendance mock\-up testing, shop drawing reviews and conduct factory \& site inspections



**Technical Excellence**




 The Associate Director shall assume full responsibility for work quality undertaken and ensure quality is adhered to by performing regular checks of your direct reports work and a senior peer review role on projects, including:
   

  




* Ensure project specific technical duties including engineering, design and project lead roles are effectively managed
* Identification of technically complex projects and problems that require high level input
* Undertake provision of concept design, peer review and checking services on projects to assist in maintaining high standards
* Provide technical assistance and grow the team’s capability relating to the weatherproofing and installation of various façade systems
* Assist in developing and growing the BIM capability of the office in conjunction with other team members, aligning Inhabit’s capabilities with market expectations


* Take necessary action to prevent the occurrence of design documentation and/or quality system non\-conformity
* Ensure all project documentation is maintained to a level as required by Inhabits’ QA Manager and QA system
* Endorse and facilitate the quality management system (QMS) and the Business’s commitment to quality
* Conduct all activities in accordance with the quality management system



**Personal Growth**



* Maintain a profile in the industry by participation at relevant events and involvement on committees that will assist with business growth and exposure to project a positive and professional company image
* Attend and present at internal technical forums, talks and workshops
* Keep up\-to\-date with key technical developments, software and innovations within the Industry, encouraging staff to do the same
* Present technical or commercial papers at a national or international conference/seminar



**Personal Attributes:**



* Attitude and participation towards project, client, team
* Motivation in role
* Sense of urgency when appropriate
* Confidence in role amongst team and clients
* Desire to achieve high standards, set goals or targets
* Overall commitment to your position
* Adaptability and willingness to learn
* How you apply new skills
