**Job Overview:**
 The PMO Lead directly leads the Project Manager team within the Business Solutions Department and is accountable for portfolio governance, delivery compliance, and PMO framework maturity across all concurrent projects. The PMO Lead sets the delivery standard, coaches the PM team to that standard, and governs how every project is initiated, run, escalated, and closed. As the line manager for the PM team, this role combines people leadership with structural PMO ownership, building the Center of Excellence, driving standardised controls, and producing the executive\-ready reporting that gives the Director and CCO full portfolio visibility. A core outcome is ensuring projects consistently meet or outperform pre\-estimated budgets through baseline discipline, change control enforcement, and early financial intervention.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* PM Team Leadership \& Performance Management
* Directly manage the BSD Project Manager team: set performance expectations, conduct regular 1:1s, deliver performance reviews, and support professional development
* Assign and balance project workload across the PM team based on complexity, capacity, and growth objectives, ensuring no PM is over\-extended and every project has appropriate coverage
* Coach PMs on methodology, stakeholder management, scope control, and delivery discipline, raising the standard of craft, not just compliance
* Onboard new Project Managers into the BSD delivery model: governance expectations, tooling, reporting cadence, and stakeholder engagement standards
* Act as the first escalation point for PM\-level issues: unblock delivery problems, mediate stakeholder conflicts, and provide senior judgment on complex scope or schedule decisions
* PMO Governance \& Delivery Assurance
* Own and enforce the end\-to\-end PMO governance model: stage gates (G0\-G5\), minimum project artifacts, Director approval workflows, and escalation paths
* Run delivery assurance reviews (health checks, compliance audits, and quality checkpoints) and drive corrective actions where projects deviate from standards
* Ensure consistent application of governance across all project archetypes (white\-label, grey\-label, integration, hybrid) while keeping controls pragmatic and execution\-friendly
* Chair the Change Control Board: intake, impact assessment, approval or rejection, re\-baselining, and communication to all affected stakeholders
* PMO Framework Ownership \& Continuous Improvement
* Maintain and continuously optimise the BSD PMO framework: project lifecycle, standards, templates, toolkits, and playbooks, serving as the single source of truth for how delivery is run
* Identify and eliminate systemic delivery breakdowns: scope creep patterns, late feasibility discovery, rework loops, and weak sign\-off cultures
* Operate with a Center of Excellence mindset: codify lessons learned and best practices, and continuously raise PM methodology maturity across the team
* Maintain PM onboarding documentation and standards, reducing time\-to\-productivity for new Project Managers and eliminating methodology drift
* Portfolio Reporting \& Executive Visibility
* Own the portfolio reporting cadence and outputs: weekly portfolio health review, monthly performance packs, and steering committee materials for the Director and CCO
* Provide data\-backed insights: schedule variance, budget variance, scope volatility, RAID trends, and cross\-project dependency visibility
* Establish and protect a "single source of truth" for portfolio status, with strong data quality and governance traceability across Smartsheet and reporting outputs
* Design and maintain the portfolio dashboard: real\-time RAG status, milestone tracking, resource utilisation, and financial performance across all concurrent projects
* Budget Performance, Baselines \& Financial Controls
* Ensure every project has an approved, documented baseline covering scope, schedule, and budget before execution begins. No project starts without a signed baseline
* Monitor cost performance and forecast\-to\-complete across the portfolio; initiate recovery actions and escalate to the Director when variances exceed defined thresholds
* Enforce change control discipline so that every scope change is formally assessed for time and cost impact, and approved before implementation begins
* Improve estimation hygiene and governance controls to enable projects to consistently meet or outperform pre\-estimated budgets through reduced rework, tighter CR governance, and better resource utilisation
* Partner with the Projects Financial Controller (when in post) on invoicing trigger governance, per\-project P\&L tracking, and commercial change order processes
* RAID, Dependencies \& Cross\-Project Risk
* Standardise RAID governance across the portfolio: every risk, assumption, issue, and dependency has an owner, a mitigation action, and a measurable closure criterion
* Surface and manage cross\-project dependencies proactively, driving early escalation and resolution before they become delivery blockers
* Maintain the portfolio\-level risk register and escalate strategic risks to the Director before they become crises
* Run the post\-implementation review (PIR) process on every project closeout, and embed lessons learned back into the methodology and template library


**Requirements**
**Education \& Certifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent (required)
* PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner, MSP, or MoP certification, one or more strongly preferred
* Agile certifications such as CSM, PSM, or SAFe are an advantage in hybrid delivery contexts


**Experience Requirements**
* 7\+ years in PMO leadership, portfolio governance, delivery assurance, or project controls, with a minimum of 3 years in a role with direct line management of Project Managers or delivery professionals
* Proven track record building or significantly improving a PMO framework from near\-scratch, with the ability to articulate what changed, why it changed, and what the measurable outcome was
* Demonstrated experience governing a portfolio of 8 or more concurrent complex implementations in technology, B2B, or professional services environments
* Strong background in portfolio analytics and performance reporting, including KPIs, health frameworks, trend analysis, schedule and budget variance, and RAID analytics
* Experience managing cross\-functional stakeholders including Product, Engineering, and commercial teams within a RACI\-governed delivery model
* Preferred: prior experience in a Centre of Excellence, PMO transformation, methodology office, or operational excellence function

data.jd_text:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consultancy groups specialising in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA's mission is to design safe and sustainable transport solutions to bring people together, develop social inclusion and facilitate access to employment, education and leisure throughout the world.
   

  

 For 65 years, the Group has been working alongside cities and regions to contribute to their development by creating, improving and modernising their infrastructure and transport systems, throughout the life cycle of their projects. SYSTRA is involved from the earliest stages of design through to the testing, deployment and maintenance phases. The company provides all its services in over 80 countries worldwide and generates 74% of its turnover internationally. With its new services, SYSTRA supports its clients and partners in their digital, ecological and energy transition, in order to invent the mobility of tomorrow.
   

  

 Context
   

  

***This requirement is for a bid opportunity only at this stage. Any engagement will be subject to successful project award and final client approval.***
 The Project Controls Manager will lead and manage all project controls functions across major railway and transportation infrastructure projects, ensuring effective planning, scheduling, cost control, reporting, risk management, change management, and performance monitoring. The role is critical to supporting successful project delivery in line with approved budgets, schedules, quality standards, and contractual obligations.
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

* Lead and manage the overall project controls function, including planning, scheduling, cost control, risk, change management, progress measurement, and performance reporting.
* Establish and maintain project controls procedures, systems, tools, templates, and reporting protocols in line with PMC and client requirements.
* Manage and mentor the project controls team, ensuring effective delivery across planning, cost, reporting, and risk disciplines.
* Review and monitor contractor and consultant schedules to ensure alignment with project milestones, contractual requirements, and delivery strategy.
* Analyze schedule performance, identify delays and critical path impacts, and recommend mitigation, recovery, and time impact measures where required.
* Establish and oversee cost control processes, including budget tracking, forecasting, cash flow monitoring, variance analysis, and alignment of cost with physical progress.
* Prepare and consolidate dashboards, KPIs, and project controls reports for senior management and client stakeholders.
* Lead risk and change management processes, including risk registers, impact assessments, trend monitoring, variations, and support for claims and extension of time reviews.
* Coordinate with commercial, engineering, construction, and client teams to ensure alignment on project controls matters and contract compliance.
* Ensure effective use of project controls systems, data integrity, reporting quality, and continuous improvement in controls processes and governance.


 Profile/Skills
   

  

* Minimum 20 years of experience in project controls, planning, cost, and performance management on major capital projects.
* Mandatory experience in railway or major transportation infrastructure projects.
* Strong GCC experience is required.
* Saudi Arabia experience is preferred.
* Proven experience working with PMC, client\-side, or major program management teams on large, complex projects.
* Demonstrated ability to manage project controls across multiple contracts and interfaces.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or related field is required.
* Master’s degree is preferred.
* PMP, PMI\-SP, AACE, RICS, or equivalent professional certification is desirable.
* Strong knowledge of project controls principles, scheduling techniques, cost control systems, and risk management practices.
* Proficiency in Primavera P6 and strong familiarity with cost and reporting tools.
* Strong understanding of EPC, design\-build, and FIDIC\-based contract environments.
* Ability to analyze complex data and provide strategic recommendations to project leadership.
* Strong leadership and team management capability.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to work in a high\-profile, multicultural, and fast\-paced delivery environment.
* Strong report\-writing and presentation skills for senior executive audiences.


 Systra is an equal opportunities company; this position is open to all applicants.

Req ID:523438
   

  

 From high\-speed trains, metros, monorails, trams, turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling, and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, over 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars
   

  

 Could you be full\-time
 **Project Director** 
 in
 **Riyadh, Saudi Arabia** 
 we're looking for?
   

  

**Your future role**
 Take on a new challenge and apply your project management expertise in a cutting\-edge and highly strategic environment. You'll work alongside collaborative, skilled, and passionate teammates to deliver some of the most complex rail projects in the industry.
   

  

 As
 **Project Director** 
 , you will be accountable for the successful execution of large\-scale, high\-criticality turnkey projects, ensuring contractual commitments, customer expectations, and business objectives are achieved. You will lead multidisciplinary and multi\-site teams while driving project governance, financial performance, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence throughout the project lifecycle.
   

  

 You will report to senior project leadership and play a key role in ensuring safe, profitable, and on\-time project delivery.
   

  

 We’ll look to you for:
   

  

* Ensuring accountability for project Quality, Cost, Delivery, and Planning (QCDP) performance, while optimizing the project’s financial performance, including margin and cash,
* Defining and implementing project governance strategies in line with contract requirements, including Project Management Plan (PMP) elaboration and allocation of objectives to subsystems,
* Managing project resources effectively, including staffing the project core team, escalating resource gaps, and leading multi\-site/multi\-functional teams to achieve project objectives,
* Leading and coordinating project activities and stakeholders from transfer to close\-out, ensuring proper transfer from tender to project and alignment with customer satisfaction goals,
* Engaging internal and external project stakeholders, fostering alignment towards project goals, and synchronizing internal partners while arbitrating when necessary,
* Overseeing alignment with contractual requirements, managing variation orders, and addressing claims or litigations as needed,
* Proactively managing risks, savings, and opportunities to ensure successful project delivery,
* Monitoring and reporting project progress and KPIs to senior management with transparency, ensuring adherence to business and critical project review processes,
* Building and managing strong relationships with customers and external stakeholders, ensuring alignment with contractual requirements and effective contract management,
* Maintaining compliance with applicable rules, standards, and policies, including Alstom’s Code of Ethics \& Compliance, EHS, Railway Safety, and Quality standards.


**All About You**
 We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
   

  

* Experience in project management (railway industry \- preferred), with at least 15 years of experience, including 5 years managing medium\-critical projects,
* Proven experience as a project execution leader (Project Director) with full responsibility for delivery and project financial performance on large\-scale turnkey projects valued at approximately 500 million USD or more (rail industry is desired),
* Strong EPC (Engineering, Procurement and Construction) background, with hands\-on experience operating as a main contractor and managing interactions with customers, civil works organizations, and electromechanical teams,
* Familiarity with multi\-national business cultures and cross\-functional collaboration,
* Team management skills, including the ability to coordinate and collaborate with multi\-site/multi\-functional teams,
* Leadership and entrepreneurship mindset with a results\-oriented approach,
* Conflict and crisis management expertise,
* Advanced skills in managing customer relationships and stakeholder alignment,
* Proficiency in complexity and risk management,
* Capacity to navigate political contexts and manage contractual requirements effectively.


**Things you’ll enjoy**
 Join us on a life\-long transformative journey where you'll contribute to innovative mobility solutions while developing your career in a truly global organization.
   

  

 You will also:
   

  

* Work on industry\-leading railway and transportation projects.
* Collaborate with talented teams across multiple countries and functions.
* Benefit from excellent opportunities for growth and professional development.
* Contribute to sustainable and greener mobility solutions worldwide.
* Be part of a diverse and inclusive workplace where every voice matters.


 We'll help you succeed and grow in this role by providing the support and opportunities you need to develop your career. Every day, you'll work with innovative teammates who are passionate about transforming mobility for a greener future.
   

  

**Alstom is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive working environment where all employees are encouraged to reach their full potential.**
 Job Type: Experienced

**Job Purpose:** 
 As Manager Competitive Governance, you will support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of Esports Foundation’s competitive governance structures across the Esports World Cup, Esports Nations Cup, and related competitions.
   

  

 This role is suited for someone who combines strong project execution with structured thinking, stakeholder management, and the ability to support complex governance work in a fast\-moving environment. You will help translate ideas, discussions, and strategic direction into clear deliverables, including governance models, project plans, presentations, tracking tools, briefing materials, process documents, and stakeholder updates.
   

  

 The role will act as a key execution partner and sounding board to the Director Competitive Governance. You will be expected to manage workstreams, structure ambiguous problems, prepare high\-quality materials, track progress, coordinate stakeholders, and help move governance initiatives from concept to implementation.
   

  

**Duties And Responsibilities**
**Governance Project Delivery \& Execution**
* Support the delivery of key competitive governance workstreams across EF competitions, ensuring tasks are clearly structured, tracked, and completed on time.
* Translate strategic priorities, leadership discussions, and brainstorming sessions into clear action plans, deliverables, timelines, and follow\-ups.
* Create and maintain project plans, governance trackers, decision logs, issue logs, risk registers, stakeholder maps, and implementation roadmaps.
* Drive the preparation of materials required for internal meetings, workshops, leadership updates, and stakeholder discussions.
* Ensure governance workstreams are well\-organised, documented, and progressing against agreed milestones.
* Support the Director Competitive Governance with day\-to\-day execution, prioritisation, problem\-solving, and follow\-through.


**Governance Structure \& Framework Development**
* Support the design and refinement of competitive governance structures across EF competitions, including decision\-making processes, roles and responsibilities, escalation routes, stakeholder engagement models, and operating rhythms.
* Contribute to brainstorming and shaping governance frameworks for competitions involving clubs, national teams, players, publishers, and external partners.
* Translate governance concepts into practical operating models, rules, policies, process maps, procedures, and implementation materials.
* Benchmark governance models from sports organizations, federations, member associations, consulting projects, and major competition organizers to identify relevant best practices.
* Help assess options, structure recommendations, and prepare a clear rationale for governance decisions.
* Support continuous improvement of governance frameworks based on lessons learned, stakeholder feedback, event outcomes, and evolving business needs.


**Presentations, Storytelling \& Leadership Materials**
* Prepare high\-quality presentations, briefing documents, and leadership updates that communicate complex governance topics clearly and visually.
* Structure narratives, recommendations, and decision papers for senior stakeholders.
* Turn complex information into clear, concise, and well\-organized materials for internal and external audiences.
* Build materials for workshops, governance discussions, stakeholder alignment sessions, and executive reviews.
* Support the creation of templates, dashboards, reporting formats, and communication materials to improve consistency and clarity across the function.


**Competitive Integrity, Compliance \& Policy Support**
* Support the implementation of competitive governance and integrity policies covering fair play, anti\-cheating, match\-fixing, doping, code of conduct, eligibility, and disciplinary matters.
* Assist with documentation, process design, stakeholder coordination, and follow\-up related to incident handling, escalation, and governance decisions.
* Help ensure governance and integrity requirements are embedded into competition operations, tournament planning, and event delivery.
* Maintain documentation, playbooks, SOPs, guidance materials, and process maps related to competitive governance and integrity.
* Support post\-event reviews, internal audits, retrospectives, and continuous improvement initiatives.


**Stakeholder \& Partner Coordination**
* Act as a day\-to\-day coordination point for internal and external stakeholders on competitive governance matters.
* Prepare meeting agendas, notes, action logs, decision trackers, and follow\-up materials.
* Support engagement with clubs, players, national teams, member\-style organisations, and other competition participants on governance expectations, rules, and compliance requirements.
* Help ensure governance processes are clear, fair, well\-documented, and understood by relevant stakeholders.
* Build strong working relationships across different functions, regions, cultures, and sporting or esports ecosystems.


**Reporting, Monitoring \& Insights**
* Maintain governance documentation, workstream trackers, issue logs, compliance trackers, incident records, dashboards, and reporting tools.
* Prepare regular updates for the Director Competitive Governance on progress, risks, open decisions, stakeholder issues, and emerging topics.
* Monitor developments in sports governance, federation models, major event governance, esports regulation, and competitive integrity.
* Provide structured analysis, options, and recommendations to support decision\-making.
* Identify process gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities to improve ways of working.


**Education And Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business, International Relations, Sports Law, Governance, Compliance, Political Science, Public Policy, or a related field. A master’s degree is preferred.
* 6\+ years of relevant experience in consulting, governance, sports business, regulatory environments, or a related field.


**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**
* Background in consulting firms, especially with exposure to sports or governance, is highly preferred.
* Strong project execution skills with the ability to drive workstreams, track actions, and deliver high\-quality outputs.
* Strong consulting\-style problem\-solving skills, including the ability to structure ambiguous topics and turn them into clear work plans.
* Excellent deck\-building and storytelling skills, with the ability to prepare clear, polished, senior\-level presentations.
* Strong written communication skills, including the ability to create briefing notes, reports, decision papers, process documents, and stakeholder updates.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort working with frameworks, trackers, dashboards, and structured reporting tools.
* Ability to act as a sounding board, challenge ideas constructively, and help shape practical recommendations.
* Good understanding of sport, sports business, major sports events, governance, federations, or competition environments.
* Ability to work with legal, operational, commercial, and external stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple workstreams in parallel.
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-moving, international, and event\-driven environment.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Knowledge of esports or gaming is a plus, but not essential.


**Benefits**
* Relocation support
* Transportation allowance
* Competitive compensation
* Housing allowance
* VIP medical insurance
* Opportunity to work on a new exciting project with a group of passionate professionals. You will get the freedom to excel and make a real impact


**Diversity disclaimer**
 Our mission is to build a diverse organization where our members, regardless of background or identity, have a sense of belonging. We genuinely believe that thanks to creating a collaborative environment where different perspectives are valued, we can achieve more. Together, we want to reshape the boundaries of what is achievable in the esports domain.

**Description**
 Do you want to build a career that is truly worthwhile? Working at the World Bank Group (WBG) provides a unique opportunity for you to help our clients solve their greatest development challenges. The World Bank Group is one of the largest sources of funding and knowledge for developing countries; a unique global partnership of five institutions dedicated to ending extreme poverty, increasing shared prosperity, and promoting sustainable development. With 189 member countries and more than 120 offices worldwide, we work with public and private sector partners, investing in groundbreaking projects and using data, research, and technology to develop solutions to the most urgent global challenges. For more information, visit www.worldbank.org .
   

  

**Regional Context**
 The Middle East and North Africa, Afghanistan, and Pakistan Region serves twenty two countries across different income groups, of which fourteen are active/potentially active IBRD/IDA borrowers (Afghanistan, Algeria, Djibouti, Egypt, Iran, Iraq, Jordan, Lebanon, Morocco, Pakistan, Syria, West Bank and Gaza, Tunisia, and Yemen), with a total of 251 projects and over $51 bn in total commitment. Eight are users of the Region's non\-lending services, mostly on a reimbursable basis (Bahrain, Kuwait, Libya, Malta, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, and the United Arab Emirates). The mission of the region is to foster sustainable growth with a focus on job creation and poverty reduction, economic and social inclusion, and good governance. The region attaches importance to creating a supportive work environment based on the values of teamwork, transparency, trust, and client service, underlined by professional excellence. The region places high value on diversity. The region is organized into seven Country Departments (CMUs), the Office of the Regional Chief Economist, and the Development Effectiveness Unit (MNADE).
   

  

 With an expanded regional strategy, the World Bank aims to help the region weather the current crises, move from stabilization to transformation, unlock its vast economic potential of youth and women, develop its human capital to adapt to global megatrends, and foster innovation ( https://www.worldbank.org/en/region/mena ).
   

  

**The World Bank’s GCC Country Department:** 
 https://www.worldbank.org/en/country/gcc
   

  

 The Senior Operations Officer will primarily focus on the WB KSA program. The program is delivered through a Technical Cooperation Program (TCP) Agreement with the Ministry of Finance and stand\-alone agreements with various ministries and government entities. It covers activities in a wide range of sectors connected with the Vision 2030 goals with clearly defined deliverables. In addition, the Senior Operations Officer will also serve as a Senior Government Liaison to foster and deepen the trusted relationships with clients and partners in Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 The Senior Operations Officer will report to the MENAAP Regional Hub Manager in Riyadh.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Client/Country Relations and Partnerships:
* Develop and maintain excellent and trusted relationships with the government counterparts, actively contributing to business development and growing the World Bank’s Reimbursable Advisory Services (RAS) program in Saudi Arabia.
* Actively support the country and project teams by playing a critical role in coordinating the implementation of the World Bank RAS program in the Kingdom and working with the Program Manager in the Bank dialogue with the government counterparts.
* Provide support to visiting technical teams and join key meetings with senior government agencies.
* Liaise with Global Practices and task teams to ensure consistency in reports and correspondence with the government.
* Coordinate and facilitate close partnership with IFC and MIGA towards development and implementation of joint World Bank Group programs.
* Keep abreast of latest developments in KSA and their implications for the WBG, including identification of new business opportunities.
* Develop and maintain close working relations with the Washington\-based Country Anchor Unit, the CMU staff in Kuwait, Abu Dhabi, Qatar, Oman, GP colleagues, operational services and quality staff, and regional management.
* Portfolio Monitoring and Implementation
* Undertake a monthly analysis of operational data and information.
* Oversee the development of a TCP monitoring dashboard with MoF.
* Track and report on key deliverables, the work program and budget execution.
* Monitor Program Delivery and Provide Quality Assurance
* Implement monitoring system to formally track concept notes, aide memoires, completion summaries, and budget utilization.
* Conduct regular monitoring of activities with the Operations Team in the Country Office and Headquarters.
* Participate in the review of CMU budgets and RAS billing in close cooperation with the World Bank Budget department.
* Monitor and follow up on payment arrears where needed.
* Play a key role on facilitating VIP visits to the Kingdom
* Lead the preparations for the visit, liaising with the relevant government entities and World Bank teams.
* Contribute to the preparation of briefing documents and internal and external correspondence for Bank management, and external audiences.
* Serve as the Security focal point for KSA.


 Selection Criteria
   

  

* Masters, or higher degree in a relevant field/discipline (economics, public policy, business administration, finance, or similar field relevant to the Bank’s mission).
* Minimum eight years of directly relevant experience in the government, preferably in Saudi Arabia.
* Wide range of operational experience as leader of teams.
* recognized as an operations/portfolio expert by peers and managers.
* Solutions oriented and ability to actively shape, drive, and provide high level contributions.
* Strong Organizational skills and can multi\-task and reliably deliver under tight deadlines.
* Aptitude to respond quickly to client demands, find ways to enhance effectiveness.
* Strong team player, able to collaborate closely with colleagues from diverse backgrounds.
* Strong client orientation and ability to operate effectively in complex situations, with due regard to political economy, social and cultural contexts.
* Excellent communication skills in English and Arabic, verbal and written with ability to adapt complex messages to a variety of stakeholders, balancing flexibility, with firmness and clarity of message.

data.jd_text:
The Senior Director \- Project Controls will establish and lead a high performing, standardized integrated Project Controls function within Qiddiya's Transport Business Unit, encompassing Cost Planning and Reporting, Programme (Schedule) Management and Document Control.
   

  

 Reporting to the Executive Director, Development Management Office, this role will be instrumental in bringing rigour, consistency and confidence to how cost, schedule and reporting are managed across all transport projects. The Senior Director will drive the development of a unified cost\-planning framework, ensure disciplined budget approvals and financial tracking in partnership with the Central Development Unit and strengthen programme assurance and logiv testing across the project portfolio.
   

  

 Qiddiya Investment Company is dedicated to revolutionizing the entertainment and leisure industry in Saudi Arabia, and we are looking for a dynamic and experienced Senior Director of Project Controls for our DMO Transportation Division. This pivotal role will involve overseeing and enhancing the project controls framework for the transportation infrastructure projects within the Qiddiya destination. Your leadership will ensure the efficient handling of multiple projects critical to developing a seamless experience across our entertainment platform.
   

  

**Key Objectives (First 18 Months) Responsibilities**
* Develop and implement a consistent, robust cost planning framework across all projects replacing ad hoc practices with clear methodologies, templates and governance requirements. Ensure project teams adopt the framework and are trained to apply it accurately and consistently
* Work closely with the Centrral Development Unit to define and embed a transparent budget approval and funding process, ensuring all projects have approved budgets aligned with corporate systems. Establish clear controls for ongoing budget tracking and change management, providing senior management with full confidence in reported financials
* Strengthen programme management discipline by introducing logical, evidence based schedule validation across all projects. Ensure baseline schedules, float, dependencies and critical paths are realistic and defensible. Build capability within the planning team to challenge delivery timelines and assess delay impacts objectively
* Embed cost, schedule, risk and change management integration within project reporting ensuring one version of truth and a common control baseline
* Partner closely with the Transport Business Unit Governance team to align processes, approvals and reporting with organizational standards and external assurance requirements
* Work seamlessly with the Senior Directors of Procurement, Commercial and Finance, Risk and Compliance \& Reporting and maintain strong interfaces with the Central Delivery Unit (CDU) and Strategic Delivery Unit (SDU) to ensure alignment and transparency across the delivery program
* Recruit, develop and empower a capable project controls team covering cost, programme, and document control disciplines fostering a culture of accuracy, responsiveness and continuous improvement


**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the establishment of an integrated Project Controls Framework governing cost planning, schedule management, change control and reporting across all projects
* Create detailed cost planning standards and templates, defining inputs, assumptions and review checkpoints to drive consistency across project cost plans
* Oversee the preparation, validation and ongoing maintenance of project budgets, ensuring traceability between approved budgets, cost plans and funding sources
* Collaborate with the Central Development Unit and Finance to embed the budget approval process, track funding allocations and provide transparent reporting of financial performance
* Ensure all projects maintain accurate and logically structured programmes, validated through formal schedule assurance reviews
* Manage scheduling, budgeting, cost control, and risk management activities to ensure timely and cost\-effective project execution
* Work collaboratively with project managers, engineers, and stakeholders to define project baselines and establish governance structures
* Provide expert analysis and insight into project performance, preparing detailed reporting for senior management and stakeholders
* Provide senior management with clear, reliable and data driven insights through regular dashboards and performance reviews
* Embed project control staff within project teams to ensrue accurate data capture, timely reporting and partnership with project delivery
* Ensure document control process maintain version integrity, traceability and audit readiness
* Continuously review and improve project controls processes in line with industry advancements and organizational objectives
* Maintain a strong focus on compliance, safety, and quality assurance throughout project lifecycles


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Quantity Surveying, Engineering, Construction Management, Project management or a related field; a Master's degree is preferred
* At least 15 \- 20\+ years of experience in project controls, specifically in transportation or large\-scale infrastructure projects
* Advanced capability with project Control tools (Primavera P6, CostOS, Power BI etc)
* Demonstrated leadership experience supervising project controls teams in complex project environments
* Deep understanding of project control techniques, including scheduling, cost estimation, and risk assessment methodologies
* Excellent analytical skills paired with the ability to provide strategic recommendations based on data\-driven insights
* Outstanding communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with diverse stakeholders
* Expertise in project management software and tools to drive project efficiency
* Professional certifications, such as Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent, are highly valued
* Prior experience in transport or large scale infrastructure


**Benefits**
 Offering a comprehensive compensation and benefits package.

data.jd_text:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
   

  

 If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
   

  

**Skills And Competencies**
* Extensive and demonstrable network across the Saudi government and public sector ecosystem, with credibility and sustained relationships at senior levels across ministries, regulators, public entities, government\-related institutions, and strategic national stakeholders
* Deep understanding of government transformation priorities in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, including digital transformation, regulatory modernization, data strategy, risk management, compliance, financial crime, KYC/AML, due diligence, onboarding, identity and third\-party risk workflows, and AI\-enabled innovation
* Strong ability to act as a trusted advisor and industry subject matter expert, translating complex data, analytics, risk, compliance, and solution architecture concepts into clear business outcomes and strategic value for senior stakeholders
* Excellent presentation, communication, facilitation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence C\-level, policy, regulatory, and senior operational stakeholders across both business and technical audiences
* Proven strategic and analytical mindset, with the ability to identify market trends, regulatory developments, whitespace opportunities, and emerging client needs, and translate them into actionable go\-to\-market priorities and solution opportunities
* Strong commercial acumen with experience supporting discovery, qualification, solutioning, RFP responses, Proof of Concept processes, and complex enterprise sales cycles
* Strong familiarity with risk, compliance, and workflow use cases relevant to government clients, including KYC/AML, sanctions screening, due diligence, entity verification, onboarding, counterparty intelligence, regulatory reporting, and broader public\-sector risk and decisioning workflows
* Ability to collaborate effectively across sales, product management, marketing, strategy, and solution consulting teams in a matrixed and cross\-geography environment
* Thought leadership capability, including public speaking, executive roundtables, authored content, industry engagement, and external advocacy to position Moody’s as a strategic partner in the market
* High initiative, sound judgment, and the ability to operate independently while balancing strategic advisory responsibilities with execution discipline
* Proficient in AI concepts and tools, with experience applying AI\-enabled solutions to improve workflows and solve business challenges. Demonstrates commitment to responsible AI use, AI governance, and the development of expertise in AI risk management
* Fluency in English is essential; Arabic is strongly preferred


**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Finance, Engineering, Mathematics, Public Policy, Business, or a related field
* Advanced qualifications in risk, compliance, data, public policy, finance, or technology are advantageous


**Responsibilities**
 We are seeking an experienced Industry Practice Lead (IPL) – Government for our Saudi Arabia office. This individual will serve as a government sector expert, strategic advisor, and solution lead, supporting business growth by aligning Moody’s capabilities to market needs, regulatory priorities, and client transformation agendas.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**
* Serve as the industry subject matter expert for Government in KSA, bringing deep insight into market dynamics, regulatory developments, public\-sector priorities, and client operating models
* Support sales teams through discovery, qualification, opportunity shaping, and solution design, ensuring proposed solutions are aligned to client use cases, strategic objectives, and sector\-specific requirements
* Act as a trusted advisor to clients and prospects by articulating how Moody’s capabilities can address key challenges across risk, compliance, KYC/AML, due diligence, data governance, regulatory modernization, operational efficiency, and AI\-enabled transformation
* Lead and elevate RFP, proposal, and Proof of Concept processes, applying industry best practices, transformation expertise, and solution architecture thinking to strengthen Moody’s competitive position
* Partner closely with Relationship Managers, Product Specialists, Solutions Consultants, Marketing, and Product teams to shape and execute effective go\-to\-market strategies for the government sector in Saudi Arabia
* Identify and articulate high\-value use cases for Moody’s solutions across public sector priorities such as screening, onboarding, third\-party risk, sanctions, compliance workflows, regulatory oversight, and analytics\-led decision support
* Lead external industry engagement activities, including speaking at events, participating in executive forums, publishing thought leadership, and maintaining strategic stakeholder relationships to enhance Moody’s market profile and credibility
* Gather, synthesize, and communicate market, client, and regulatory feedback to product and leadership teams to help inform roadmap priorities, solution enhancements, and future\-fit capabilities
* Identify emerging themes, policy shifts, regulatory requirements, and whitespace opportunities that can support new product innovation, market positioning, and business case development
* Contribute to strategic account planning and major pursuits by helping shape value propositions, transformation narratives, and industry\-specific points of view that resonate with senior client stakeholders
* Work cross\-functionally to ensure consistency of messaging, quality of solutioning, and effective feedback loops between market\-facing teams and internal stakeholders
* Maintain strong awareness of competitor positioning, ecosystem developments, and key industry partnerships relevant to the Saudi government sector
* Travel as required across Saudi Arabia and the region to support client engagement, strategic opportunities, and external market activity; this role is expected to require up to 50% travel and supports a hybrid working model


**About The Team**
 This role supports Moody’s continued expansion in Saudi Arabia through our Riyadh regional headquarters. You will join a high\-impact, collaborative environment at the forefront of innovation, helping government and public sector clients navigate increasing complexity through data, analytics, risk, compliance, and workflow solutions.
   

  

 The Industry Practice Lead plays a critical role in connecting market insight, client challenges, and Moody’s capabilities—working across sales, product, marketing, and solution teams to shape opportunities, strengthen market relevance, and support sustainable business growth. This is a unique opportunity to influence strategic client conversations and help position Moody’s as a trusted partner in the Kingdom’s transformation journey, particularly across priorities such as regulatory modernization, KYC/AML and compliance transformation, data\-driven decisioning, and responsible AI adoption.
   

  

 Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.
   

  

 Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consultancy groups specialising in public transport and sustainable mobility.  Context
   

  

***This requirement is for a bid opportunity only at this stage. Any engagement will be subject to successful project award and final client approval.***

The role requires a seasoned delivery leader with extensive experience in major conventional rail and freight rail infrastructure projects, with the ability to direct multidisciplinary teams, manage stakeholder and client relationships, oversee complex interfaces, and drive successful outcomes across all phases of delivery in line with schedule, budget, quality, safety, and operational objectives
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties

 Profile/Skills

* Proven project delivery experience in leading major infrastructure, rail, or transportation projects from initiation to completion.

* Strong knowledge of project management principles, contract administration, commercial management, and project controls.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large, multicultural, and multidisciplinary teams.

* Collaborate with the Global Team to leverage global tools and capabilities and get insights from other sectors on adoption and roll\-out practices.
* Lead key scale x\-functional transformation initiatives (to be aligned with stakeholders)
* Provide leadership and project management to several scale OU/market Transformation projects
* Change Management

* Working with EMEA Change Lead to seamlessly integrate a clear change management plan.
* Sharing learnings across projects and teams
* Estimate 2\-3 significant projects per year (often multiyear projects)

 Key Skills/Experience Required

Highly analytical, motivated, decisive thought leader with excellent general management skills – strong bias for action and can\-do approach to work, “out of the box” thinking using traditional and non\-traditional information sources to support recommendations and drive business results.

data.jd_text:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 As a Manager – BCG Vantage on our Client Focus path within BCG's BCG Transform Practice Area, you will work on long\-tail projects focused on Implementation, delivering value to clients via individual expertise and/or institutionalized knowledge assets (products, tools, data, workshops, frameworks, surveys, domain\-specific data, and related expertise, etc.). You will contribute to cases and proposals by contributing relevant analysis and insights and create strong impact for the client. While contributing to client cases, workshops and proposals, travel to serve clients onsite during staffing assignments is expected in order to understand client requirements and to design / develop solutions.
   

  

 You will support implementation projects, working in conjunction with business leaders, through activities such as:
   

  

* Driving key modules within implementation projects and transformation programs, focusing on executing strategies in line with established goals
* Analytical structured thinking and problem\-solving, applying business transformation principles in practical scenarios
* Supporting the activation of organizational design strategies and target operating models, including processes, governance, roles and performance management mechanisms
* Managing disciplined execution of program/project components, including initiative prioritization, business case development, roadmap and value realization tracking
* Conducting analysis to identify opportunities for process streamlining and performance improvement, grounded in business and financial impact
* Communicating with case teams and clients team members in a credible and confident way
* Ensuring high\-quality execution of project components, maintaining a focus on practical efficiency and effectiveness
* Drive process enhancements and change execution, supporting change management efforts, embedding new ways of working and enabling capability uplift through upskilling during implementation or transformation context. Additionally, as a Senior Analyst, you will contribute to codifying knowhow \& assets emerging from case and proposal work and will assist in onboarding and training junior colleagues based on your expertise.


 YOU'RE GOOD AT
   

  

* Helping solve client problems while executing long tail implementation programs
* Translating business strategies into practical actions
* Applying business and financial acumen to assess trade\-offs and support value creation
* Maintaining focus on execution discipline and outcomes
* Working collaboratively and effectively in a group dynamic, in\-person or virtually
* Working in agile ways, adapting approaches based on evolving business needs
* Communicating clearly and credibly with a diverse array of team, stakeholder, and client professionals
* Bringing a curious, flexible and creative mindset, open to new things and able to propose innovative ideas.
* Navigating complexity and ambiguity


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* 3\+ years consulting experience in operations, implementation, or transformation related roles strongly preferred
* In lieu of consulting experience, 4\+ years minimum industry experience required; 6\-10\+ years of industry experience strongly preferred
* Proven experience in effectively translating strategy into action
* Bachelor's Degree required (advanced degree preferred)
* Fluency in Arabic and English
* Strong business and financial acumen
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with ability to engage credibly with senior stakeholders


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 As a Manager – BCG Vantage on our Client Focus path, you will work face to face with clients and with BCG Project Leaders, Associates and Consultants. In the period between cases, you will collaborate with global topic leads and colleagues across BCG to bring expertise and capabilities to the service of our internal and external clients. Our team is made up a diverse pool of BCG Vantage positions that allow us to pursue exciting, innovative BCG Vantage careers.
   

  

 Additional info
   

  

 BCG Vantage is a powerhouse of expertise, seamlessly embedded within Practice Areas and markets to drive extraordinary impact. It equips BCG case teams and clients with cutting\-edge expertise, proprietary assets, actionable data, and transformative insights that empower our case teams and enable our clients to achieve their aspirations.
   

  

 With global experts across 20 Practices, covering more than 100 topics, sectors and offers, plus four focused geographic markets, BCG Vantage delivers unparalleled depth and breadth of insight \& expertise. BCG Vantage consists of three career paths, each playing a crucial role in delivering value to clients, case teams and practice teams.
   

  

 Client Focus (Embedded Expertise)
   

  

* Integrates into client\-facing teams to deliver direct client impact through expertise, know\-how, and proprietary tools and assets


 Topic Activation (Sector Expertise with Proprietary Tool \& Data Solutions)

data.jd_text:
A reputable financial technology company, is looking for a seasoned Project Delivery Manager who combines rigorous delivery discipline with deep techno\-functional knowledge of fintech platforms.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will own client implementations end to end, driving structured execution while also being the person who understands how the company's modules work, can engage meaningfully in technical discussions, and bridges business needs with platform capabilities.
   

  

 This is not a coordination role. It is a delivery leadership role that demands both craft and substance.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities:****
**Project Delivery and Governance:**
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of the company's implementation projects, from kickoff through post\-go\-live, across fintech and financial services clients in the GCC.
* Develop and maintain key project documentation, Project Charters, delivery plans, RAID logs, and progress reports, structured to drive alignment, not just record\-keeping.
* Lead steering committee engagements. Presenting delivery status, managing escalations, and keeping senior stakeholders on both sides informed and aligned.
* Manage project budgets, timelines, dependencies, and risks while maintaining compliance with SAMA and GCC regulatory and governance frameworks.
* Lead and coordinate cross\-functional teams. Aligning engineering, product, and client stakeholders around clear ownership, priorities, and delivery milestones.
* Contribute to the company's PMO. Improving delivery frameworks, reporting standards, and implementation playbooks as the function scales.


**Techno\-Functional \& Client:**
* Build deep functional knowledge of the company's modules: payments, collections, disbursements, cards, lending, open banking, so you can guide configuration decisions and resolve ambiguity without constantly escalating to product or engineering.
* Engage meaningfully in technical integration reviews, understand gaps before they become delivery blockers.
* Contribute in functional workshops, translating client business requirements into platform configurations and delivery scope that both engineering teams and clients can commit to.
* Act as a trusted delivery partner to clients, building long\-term relationships through transparency, delivery excellence, and a genuine understanding of their business.
* Stay current on digital banking trends, payments innovation, and emerging technologies to keep the company's delivery approach sharp and forward\-looking.


****Role Requirements:****
**Experience \& Background:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 6–10 years in project management or delivery roles within consulting, fintech, or banking technology in the GCC with a track record of owning complex implementations end to end.
* Proven experience in team leadership, cross\-functional coordination, and task allocation across multi\-disciplinary delivery teams.
* Proven experience delivering complex core banking or retail banking implementations, or end\-to\-end card management programs is a must.
* Previous experience in Product Management or Techno\-Functional Role is a plus


**Project Management Skills:**
* Strong command of project planning, risk management, dependency tracking, and budget oversight across the full delivery lifecycle.
* Fluency in both Agile and Waterfall methodologies, comfortable adapting the approach to the project context rather than defaulting to one.
* Hands\-on with modern PM tools: Jira, Confluence, MS Project, or equivalent with documentation and reporting treated as a first\-class habit.
* Solid understanding of risk, governance, compliance, and SAMA regulatory frameworks in Saudi Arabia's fintech landscape.


**Techno\-Functional Skills:**
* Basic functional understanding of payments infrastructure: how payment rails, collections, disbursements, reconciliation, and open banking flows work end to end.
* Enough technical depth to engage in API integration discussions and spot where integration decisions will create downstream issues.
* Ability to contribute in functional requirement workshops producing specs that engineering and clients both trust.
* Capacity to make independent platform and configuration decisions, you understand the product deeply enough to resolve grey areas without constant escalation.


**Soft Skills \& Culture:**
* Strong communication and presentation skills, equally effective in a C\-level steering committee and a technical integration review.
* People\-first leadership, you build trust quickly, create clarity in ambiguity, and foster collaboration across delivery teams without micromanaging.
* Ownership mindset, you take accountability for outcomes, not just activities, and you bring adaptability and maturity to fast\-moving environments.
* Arabic Native and very good English command is a must for client\-facing contexts across the GCC.


****Nice to Have:****
* Experience delivering API\-first, open banking, or embedded finance platforms in a SaaS environment.
* Previous experience in product management or techno\-functional consultancy.
* Background in solution consulting, pre\-sales, or functional analysis for fintech or banking platforms.
* Familiarity with core banking systems or payment switching infrastructure.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile certifications.

**Job Description**
 Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented
 **Senior Project Controls Manager** 
 to join our team! In this role you will be responsible for leading planning, scheduling, cost control, risk management, and reporting functions across a portfolio of complex utility projects (electric, gas, water, wastewater, or T\&D).
   

  

 This role provides strategic oversight of project controls processes, ensures data integrity, and partners with project leadership to deliver capital programs on time and within budget, while meeting regulatory and safety requirements.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has extensive experience in the utilities sector, managing large, multi\-year capital programs, and leading a team of project controls professionals.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing;**
**Leadership \& Strategy**
* Lead the development and implementation of project controls strategies, standards, and procedures for utility capital projects and programs.
* Manage, mentor, and develop a team of planners, schedulers, cost engineers, and analysts.
* Serve as a key advisor to project and program leadership on schedule, cost, risk, and performance trends.
* Drive continuous improvement in project controls tools, processes, and reporting, aligned with industry best practices (e.g., AACE, PMI).


**Planning \& Scheduling**
* Oversee the development, integration, and maintenance of detailed project and program schedules using tools.
* Ensure schedules reflect realistic work sequencing, resource constraints, outage windows, permitting, environmental, and regulatory requirements specific to utilities.
* Monitor schedule performance, perform schedule health checks, and develop recovery or acceleration plans as required.
* Conduct schedule risk analyses and scenario planning for major projects and programs.


**Cost Management \& Forecasting**
* Lead the establishment of project baselines, including budgets, cash flows, and cost breakdown structures.
* Oversee cost tracking, forecasting, and earned value management, including variance analysis and root\-cause identification.
* Ensure accurate and timely monthly cost reporting, including commitments, actuals, contingencies, and forecast at completion.
* Coordinate with Finance, Procurement, and Project Management to reconcile project financials and align with corporate reporting.


**Risk \& Change Management**
* Implement and maintain risk management processes, including risk registers, qualitative and quantitative risk assessments, and mitigation plans.
* Oversee project change management processes: evaluate change requests, assess schedule and cost impacts, and ensure proper approvals and documentation.
* Manage contingency development and utilization, ensuring transparency and governance around drawdowns.


**Reporting \& Governance**
* Develop and maintain standardized dashboards and reports for executive leadership, project sponsors, and regulatory stakeholders.
* Present schedule, cost, and risk updates at governance forums, steering committees, and portfolio review meetings.
* Ensure compliance with internal governance frameworks, regulatory requirements, and audit standards.


**Stakeholder \& Interface Management**
* Collaborate with Engineering, Construction, Operations, Environmental, Regulatory, Procurement, Real Estate, and Finance teams to integrate project controls data.
* Act as a liaison between field project teams and corporate functions to resolve issues and align priorities.
* Support external reporting and filings for regulators and public agencies as required (e.g., capital plans, rate cases).


**Systems, Tools \& Data Integrity**
* Own and optimize project controls systems and tools (e.g., P6, cost management systems, business intelligence tools).
* Ensure data quality, consistency, and integrity across all project controls functions.
* Champion digitalization initiatives, including automation of reporting, data analytics, and integration of field data into project controls.


**What You'll Bring;**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Finance, Business, or related field required.
* Master’s degree in a related discipline preferred.
* Minimum 15 years of progressive project controls experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
* Significant experience in the utilities sector (electric transmission \& distribution, gas infrastructure, water/wastewater, generation, or similar regulated infrastructure).
* Proven track record managing project controls on large, complex, multi\-year capital programs or portfolios.
* Deep knowledge of project controls disciplines: planning \& scheduling, cost control, earned value, risk, and change management.
* Strong understanding of utility project lifecycles, including permitting, right\-of\-way, outages, construction constraints, and regulatory oversight.
* Proficiency in scheduling software and cost management tools; experience with PowerBI, Tableau, or similar analytics tools is highly desirable.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills; ability to interpret complex data and communicate insights clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Excellent leadership, people management, and coaching skills, with experience building and leading high\-performing teams.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, including the ability to present to senior executives and external stakeholders.
* Ability to work effectively in a matrixed environment and manage multiple priorities across a portfolio of projects.
* Adherence to approved project and program schedules.
* Accuracy of cost forecasts versus actuals and budgets.
* Timeliness and quality of project controls reporting.
* Effectiveness of risk identification, mitigation, and change control.
* Stakeholder satisfaction (project teams, executives, regulators).
* Team engagement, development, and retention metrics.


 Parsons equally employs representation at all job levels no matter the race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability or genetic information.

You will lead project teams, drive decision\-making, and manage key stakeholder relationships, ensuring high\-quality outcomes across all stages of design and delivery.
   

  

 You are expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, provide leadership across multiple workstreams, and act as a trusted advisor to clients.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Contract \& Scope
   

  

* Lead project set\-up, including contract finalisation, internal alignment and mobilisation of the team
* Fully understand and manage the contract, ensuring compliance with key obligations and deliverables
* Define, agree and manage scope across all disciplines, ensuring clarity of responsibilities
* Lead the appointment and coordination of sub\-consultants, including scope, fees and agreements
* Identify and manage changes to scope, leading variation preparation, negotiation and agreement with the client
* Ensure all deliverables meet WSP quality standards and client expectations


 Communication \& Team Leadership
   

  

* Act as the primary interface with the client, operators, tenants, and key stakeholders
* Provide clear leadership, establishing a high\-performing “one team” culture
* Lead client engagement, workshops and presentations, including executive\-level reporting
* Manage complex stakeholder environments, including retail tenants, landlords, operators and authorities
* Support clients with strategic decision\-making, balancing commercial, operational and design priorities
* Proactively manage expectations, risks and issues to maintain trust and project momentum Programme
* Lead development of detailed, realistic programmes aligned with retail delivery and tenant fit\-out requirements
* Manage programmes proactively, identifying and mitigating risks to delivery
* Coordinate with design teams to ensure alignment with anchor tenant, F\&B and retail unit handover milestones
* Oversee integration of base build, shell \& core, and tenant fit\-out packages
* Ensure programme reflects authority approvals, procurement strategies and phased handovers
* Work with Planning \& Controls to maintain robust P6 programmes and client reporting


 Design \& Technical Coordination
   

  

* Lead multidisciplinary design coordination through all stages (Concept to IFC and construction support)
* Ensure alignment between brand standards, operational requirements and technical design solutions
* Oversee design reviews, ensuring buildability, compliance and coordination across disciplines
* Drive high\-quality outputs through structured QA/QC processes
* Ensure coordination between landlord criteria and tenant requirements


 Risk Management
   

  

* Establish and lead the project Risk Register, ensuring regular review and active management
* Identify key risks associated with retail phasing, tenant changes, authority approvals and programme constraints
* Develop and implement mitigation strategies
* Escalate critical risks to senior leadership and clients as required


 Commercial Management
   

  

* Lead all project commercial aspects, including budget management and financial reporting Manage project invoicing, cost tracking and financial performance
* Lead preparation, negotiation and agreement of variations
* Provide commercial advice to clients, particularly relating to programme impacts and tenant\-driven changes


 Delivery \& Handover
   

  

* Oversee project delivery through to completion, ensuring alignment with client and operational objectives
* Coordinate phased handovers, including base build and tenant fit\-out interfaces
* Ensure smooth transition to supervision / construction teams
* Lead project close\-out, ensuring all deliverables, approvals and documentation are complete


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture or related field
* 13\+ years professional experience, with a strong focus on retail, mixed\-use or commercial developments
* Proven track record delivering complex, multidisciplinary projects from Concept through to IFC and construction
* Demonstrable experience in retail delivery, including tenant coordination and fit\-out integration
* Experience working with major developers, operators or retail brands preferred
* Experience managing large, multidisciplinary teams and multiple stakeholders


 Core Competencies
   

  

* Strong leadership and ability to operate at a senior, client\-facing level
* Strategic thinking with ability to manage competing priorities
* Excellent stakeholder management, particularly within complex retail environments
* Commercial acumen and contractual awareness
* Strong programme and risk management capability
* Ability to drive quality, coordination and technical excellence
* Collaborative and proactive communication style
* Ability to lead and motivate multidisciplinary teams
* Strong understanding of health and safety in design


**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
 Join our close\-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.
   

  

**With us, you can. Apply today.**

Our AI\-powered cybersecurity platform secures operational technology (OT) and Internet of Things (IoT) infrastructures for enterprises and government entities across energy, manufacturing, transportation, resources, and critical infrastructure.
 



 As the Regional Program and Engagement Manager, MEA, you will play a critical role in ensuring the successful delivery of Nozomi Networks' Professional Services engagements across the Middle East and Africa region. You will act as a trusted advisor to customers, partners, and internal stakeholders, overseeing project execution from planning through delivery while driving operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and business outcomes. This role combines customer engagement, program management, and delivery governance, requiring strong coordination skills, commercial awareness, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, customer\-focused environment.
 


**In this role, you will:** 
* Manage a portfolio of customer engagements across the MEA region, ranging from small to complex deployments, ensuring successful delivery aligned with customer expectations, project scope, budget, and timelines.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for customers, partners, and internal stakeholders, fostering trusted relationships and driving high levels of customer satisfaction.
* Lead project planning, execution, governance, and delivery activities while ensuring adherence to Professional Services methodologies and quality standards.

* Identify opportunities to strengthen customer relationships, support adoption, drive positive customer feedback, and contribute to expansion opportunities.
* Manage customer training coordination and operational activities related to training delivery, ensuring a seamless customer experience.
* Support operational excellence through project administration, reporting, delivery acceptance management, billing milestone tracking, and compliance with internal processes and systems.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of Professional Services processes, tools, reporting capabilities, AI Powered tools and service offerings to enhance efficiency and scalability.


**To be successful in this role you have:** 
* 5–7 years of project or program management experience within cybersecurity, enterprise software, IT services, or Professional Services organizations.
* Demonstrated experience managing customer\-facing projects throughout the full project lifecycle, from initiation through successful delivery and closure.
* Planning \& Organizational Skills Ability to manage a portfolio of projects ranging from small to complex engagements while maintaining accuracy, prioritizing effectively, and meeting deadlines.
* Strong customer engagement and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust, navigate complex situations, and maintain productive relationships with customers, partners, and internal teams.
* Communication Skills Ability to communicate project status, risks, billing readiness, and operational updates clearly to stakeholders.
* Excellent planning, organizational, and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong problem\-solving and critical\-thinking capabilities, with the ability to identify risks, develop mitigation strategies, and drive issues to resolution.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and executive audiences.
* A collaborative and team\-oriented mindset, with the ability to influence and coordinate cross\-functional teams without direct authority.
* High levels of accountability, ownership, and attention to detail, with a commitment to delivering exceptional customer outcomes.
* Adaptability and resilience, with the ability to remain effective and solution\-focused in changing and high\-pressure environments.
* Ability to understand customer technical requirements and translate them into actionable project plans and delivery activities.
* Training Coordination \& Operational Management: Ability to coordinate customer training engagements, manage schedules, logistics, communications, and stakeholder expectations, ensuring a seamless and positive customer experience throughout the training lifecycle.
* Expert use of MS Office Suite, CRMs (SFDC preferred)
* Experience using project management platforms a such as MS Project, Wrike, Jira, or equivalent solutions.
* A proactive approach to leveraging AI and automation tools to improve efficiency and enhance day\-to\-day execution.
* Project Administration Ability to manage project setup, documentation, schedules, deliverables, and project records accurately.
* Reporting \& Data Analysis Experience preparing project status reports, dashboards, KPIs, forecasts, and executive summaries.
* Financial \& Commercial Awareness Understanding of project budgets, billing milestones, revenue recognition concepts, invoicing processes, and forecasting.
* Project Management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent is preferred.
* Willingness and ability to travel if required.

 Nozomi Networks is the leader in OT and IoT Cybersecurity. We protect the world's critical infrastructure, industrial and government organizations from cyber threats by providing exceptional network visibility, threat detection and operational insight. We’re always innovating and we hire the best at what they do to ensure our customers always have access to fast product enhancements, exceptional engineering support and rapid deployment across continents. If you like a challenge, and value integrity and customer success, we invite you to help Nozomi Networks build the future of OT and IoT cybersecurity.
