data.jd_text:
Riyadh Air (RX), headquartered in the Saudi Capital, is the new national airline that’s shaping the future of flying. It seeks to lead the aviation industry by transforming Saudi Arabia into a global aviation and trade hub \- a digitally native airline that will connect the kingdom to more than 100 destinations.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Are you a technology delivery leader who thrives on complexity, scale, and the challenge of connecting enterprise systems in a fast moving, digital first environment?
   

  

 In this pivotal role, we are seeking a Manager, Integration Delivery to lead the end to end delivery of our integration capabilities.
   

  

 You'll will shape and execute the enterprise integration delivery model, ensuring secure, reliable, and scalable connectivity across internal systems and third party platforms that underpin the airline’s digital and operational ecosystem.
   

  

 Importantly, you are required to drive integration delivery excellence by analysing current integration maturity, defining target state architectures, and managing complex, multi stream delivery across APIs, messaging, and event driven integrations.
   

  

 Central to your success in this role, you will work closely with Product, Architecture, Engineering, DevOps, and business stakeholders to ensure predictable delivery, strong governance, and alignment with enterprise standards and business priorities.
   

  

 This is a unique opportunity to influence Riyadh Air’s core technology foundation and play a critical role in building one of the aviation industry’s most advanced digital integration landscapes.
   

  

**About You**
 Degree qualified, you will demonstrate a minimum of 10 years of IT delivery experience with a strong focus on enterprise integration initiatives, integration platforms, or complex technology programs.
   

  

 You'll bring hands‑on experience delivering integration solutions using modern integration patterns such as API‑led connectivity, messaging, and event‑driven architectures, along with a strong track record of leading cross‑functional teams and working with engineering, architecture, and product partners to deliver complex, platform‑level capabilities.
   

  

 Critically, you should have strong analytical instincts and the ability to translate business, architectural, and technical requirements into clear delivery plans, roadmaps, and execution strategies.
   

  

 Your ability to manage complex stakeholders, govern delivery execution, mitigate risk, and drive continuous improvement across integration delivery will make you successful in this role.
   

  

 We’d love to hear from you even more if you have experience within airline, travel, or large‑scale enterprise environments, familiarity with platforms such as IBM Cloud Pak for Integration or similar technologies, and experience operating within agile or product‑led delivery models.
   

  

 This is your opportunity to shape the future of air travel. Bring your best and show us why you can own this position within Riyadh Air.
   

  

 Please submit your application by clicking on the Apply button. Our Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing applications shortly.

Tahaluf is the largest B2B live and on\-demand events organiser in Saudi Arabia by space, attendance, colleagues, and revenue. It is a joint venture between Informa PLC, the Saudi Federation for Cybersecurity, Programming and Drones (SAFCSP), and the Events Investment Fund (EIF).
   

  

 Tahaluf is bold, visionary, and determined to make an impact. Our team fosters a culture of collaboration, creativity, and a little fun, here teamwork rules and work feels as exciting as the events we create. Scaling at this pace also requires exceptional local partners, and Tahaluf is proud to work with a range of government and non\-government organisations at the forefront of Saudi Arabia’s B2B and B2C large\-scale events scene.
   

  

 Be part of something BIG with Tahaluf’s series of record\-breaking events: LEAP and Cityscape \- the largest events in the world in their respective fields of tech and real estate; Black Hat MEA \- a Guinness World Record holder for the largest CTF competition during the event; and CPHI Middle East \- the largest pharma debut event in history, to name just a few. Tahaluf is making a huge impact on the global events sector.
   

  

 Join our ambitious and highly committed team, unafraid to push boundaries and disrupt the status quo. From day one, you’ll dive into large\-scale projects under the guidance of a supportive leadership team that will encourage your personal development and open doors to new opportunities.
   

  

**Job Description**
 This role brings deep expertise in gaming investment and deal\-making into the Investor and Startup Programme infrastructure. The primary mandate is designing the investment programmes and deal\-making activations that make Gaming event the strongest investment event in the global gaming calendar. The role also flexes across the broader Investor and startup program portfolio, supporting investor programming at other events where sector knowledge and investor relationships add value. The event provides the structure; this person provides the sector depth, does the heavy lifting with the gaming and tech investment community, and raises the bar on investor experience across every event they touch.
   

  

**Gaming Investment Programme**
* Design investment programmes and deal\-making formats for gaming conference that attract international investors, publishers and funds and set a global standard for capital\-meets\-talent events.
* Build and own the gaming investor pipeline from scratch: identify gaming VCs, publisher venture arms, sovereign funds with gaming mandates, angel networks, and accelerator programmes, and conduct targeted outreach.
* Manage the investor application and vetting process verifying fund credentials, investment thesis alignment, and genuine intent to engage with gaming studios and founders.
* Develop the content and format for all gaming investment activations: reverse pitches, hosted buyer programmes, closed\-door investor roundtables, and live deal\-making showcases.
* Work with the B2B Content Producer to ensure the investment content track is credible, current, and attracts the right calibre of participant.
* Design the investor experience end\-to\-end: investor lounge, curated sessions, concierge meetings, and investor\-only programming that delivers a premium environment.
* Own the investor\-side matchmaking process by working with internal teams to ensure match quality and deal relevance are high.
* Manage investor delegate communications, matchmaking logistics, and on\-site facilitation to ensure the programme delivers real outcomes, not just introductions.
* Track and report on investment programme outcomes: deals initiated, capital committed, follow\-up meetings generated.


**Cross\-Portfolio Investor Support**
* Support the investor programme across other Investor \& Startup program portfolio events contributing investor relationships, outreach, and programming input where sector knowledge adds value.
* Contribute to investor outreach campaigns across portfolio events with the marketing and cross\-functional teams.
* Provide investor program cover for senior team members during high\-volume pre\-event and on\-ground periods.
* Curate a balanced, high\-quality investor room for each assigned event, reflecting that event’s sector focus and strategic objectives.
* Programme investor\-focused roundtables, LP introductions, and deal\-flow sessions in collaboration with the special value programmes team.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date investor records in internal management tools covering fund details, investment thesis, meeting history, and post\-event feedback.
* Track investor programme KPIs across assigned events: investor count, AUM represented, meetings held, investment signals generated, and investor NPS.
* Conduct post\-event investor debriefs, gather feedback, and share improvement recommendations with the program lead.
* Maintain and nurture investor relationships year\-round, ensuring warm relationships carry forward into future editions.
* Develop new ideas for value\-driven investor programme features and lead on concept note development for future editions.


**Qualifications**
* 4–5 years of experience in investor relations, investor programme management, or VC/LP engagement ideally within an event, ecosystem, or gaming industry context.
* Demonstrated expertise in the gaming investment landscape: VCs, publisher venture arms, sovereign funds with gaming mandates, angel networks. This is the core credential.
* Demonstrable experience curating and managing high\-touch investor experiences, not just registration and logistics, but genuine investor engagement design.
* Strong existing network within the gaming and tech investment community, particularly in MENA, APAC, or Europe.
* Understanding of how the gaming investment chain works from pre\-seed accelerators through to sovereign capital deployment.
* Sector knowledge in cybersecurity, fintech, or other technology verticals is an advantage for cross\-portfolio event support.
* Excellent relationship management skills, able to manage senior investor relationships with professionalism and discretion.
* Comfortable working across multiple simultaneous events with different investors, geographies, and sector focuses.
* Experience with investor management platforms, CRM tools, and event management systems.
* Strong written English is mandatory; Arabic is a meaningful advantage.


**What You Will Bring**
 Deep expertise in gaming investment and deal\-making is the non\-negotiable. Must understand how funding rounds, publishing deals, and M\&A transactions work in gaming and know the regional investors, funds, and studios that matter, particularly across Saudi Arabia and MENA. Comfortable in investor conversations and able to hold their own in a room with fund managers, portfolio directors, and publishing executives. Able to design investor programmes from the ground up that bring international capital to an event and raise the bar on what a gaming investment activation can be. Equally capable of plugging into broader Investor and startup programs across events and adding immediate value through relationships and sector credibility.
   

  

**Additional Information**
**Core Benefits:**
* Medical Insurance for individual and family
* Annual leave – 25 days
* School fees contribution, 40,000 SAR per child per year, up to a max of three children
* Wellbeing Benefits
* Remote working on Sundays
* Working anywhere – 1 month every year

* Individual annual flight allowance\* (Expat only)

* SAR 2,500 towards shipping goods/excess baggage costs on production of receipts/invoices

data.jd_text:
**Job Description Summary**
 In this role, you will head up and oversee all engineering activities within the project, ensuring sound adherence to Quality, Cost, and Time (QCT) delivery criteria. We are looking for a professional to manage design activities, the project engineering budget, and the design change process. You will coordinate all technical tasks—whether executed by our internal teams or by partners and subcontractors—to ensure seamless technical integration for our Grid Solutions projects.
   

  

 You will ensure that optimized, cost\-effective, and operationally efficient technical solutions are implemented in alignment with customer expectations and the project schedule. You will be accountable for design performance, deadlines, and quality, working within the strategic framework developed alongside our Project Managers.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Engineering Management \& Project Integration**
* Accountability for the end\-to\-end engineering lifecycle, ensuring all technical deliverables meet project Quality, Cost, and Time (QCT) targets.
* Integrating engineering activities with Procurement, Construction, and Commissioning to ensure a seamless project flow and prevent functional silos.
* Heading up multidisciplinary design teams (internal and external) to drive technical excellence and operational efficiency throughout the project.


**Technical Governance \& Interface Management**
* Managing the Design Freeze process and technical scope boundaries (Division of Responsibility) among all project partners.
* Overseeing the resolution of complex technical interfaces between the customer, partners, and third\-party contractors to ensure system compatibility.
* Maintaining sound control over the engineering budget and workload, identifying and mitigating technical risks before they impact project financials.


**Client Management \& Technical Compliance**
* Technical Compliance \& Integrity: Ensuring all engineering deliverables and the final solution strictly adhere to contractual obligations, client technical specifications, and all mandatory national (e.g., SEC, Saudi Grid Codes) and international (e.g., IEC, IEEE) regulatory standards.
* Technical Authority: Acting as the primary technical contact for the Customer and local utility providers, heading up technical negotiations and presentations.
* Approval Management: Securing timely design approvals through systematic management of technical queries and customer comment cycles.


**Quality, Safety \& Performance Excellence**
* Ensuring Safety by Design principles and EHS requirements are embedded in every stage of the engineering process.
* Monitoring engineering performance through key metrics (KPIs) and driving continuous improvement in design efficiency and quality.
* Steering the final documentation process (As\-Builts, O\&M Manuals) and contributing to project Lessons Learned (Return of Experience \- REX).


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related field.
* Minimum 7 years of established experience heading up primary design activities within EPC environments, specifically in Transmission and Distribution, Power Generation, or the Energy sector.
* Systematic understanding of international standards (IEC, IEEE, ANSI, NEMA, CIGRE) and regional regulations, including Saudi Electricity Company (SEC) standards and technical specifications (TMSS, TESP, TCP).
* Experience engaging with Saudi utility providers and clients to align project deliverables with national grid requirements.
* Practical experience with High Voltage (HV) GIS/AIS substations ranging from 132kV up to 400kV and above.
* Successful track record in technical project management within multidisciplinary and international team environments.
* Willingness to travel globally and work in various locations as required by project needs.
* Sound communication and negotiation skills.
* Professional fluency in English for effective communication with international stakeholders and local clients.


**Desired Characteristics**
* Extensive experience in High Voltage Substation Primary Design, covering general layouts, civil guide design, earthing and lightning protection systems, and GIS/MV/Control building arrangements.
* Understanding of project execution risks and financial processes.
* Demonstrated ability to foster collaboration and build effective teams.
* Conducting detailed design reviews for substation steel structures, electrical safety clearances, and cable routing.
* Demonstrated understanding of High Voltage and Medium Voltage equipment design review, ideally supplemented by insights from Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs) and site visits.
* Communicating effectively across multidisciplinary departments and functions to achieve shared project goals.
* Systematic approach to identifying and resolving complex technical challenges.
* Experience in fostering a collaborative team environment and building professional relationships with diverse stakeholders.
* Systematic communication of technical data through effective presentation skills to various audiences.
* Project management competencies applied throughout the engineering lifecycle.
* Demonstrating commitment, sound judgment, and a purposeful approach to technical strategy while inspiring team members.
* Professional fluency in Arabic
* Ability to live and work in Riyadh.


******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 No

**Job Description Summary**
 Détient globalement l'activité de contrôle de projet et définit des spécifications fonctionnelles cohérentes et des processus globaux communs pour la mise en œuvre des projets. Activités menées pour mieux comprendre ou répondre à terme aux attentes du client Exerce un im
data.jd_text:
**Job Description Summary**
 Détient globalement l'activité de contrôle de projet et définit des spécifications fonctionnelles cohérentes et des processus globaux communs pour la mise en œuvre des projets. Activités menées pour mieux comprendre ou répondre à terme aux attentes du client Exerce un impact sur les approches, projets et programmes du domaine fonctionnel ou de l'organisation et des méthodes de travail affectées. Influe sur la qualité, l'efficacité et l'efficience de sa propre équipe. Contribue significativement à l'élaboration des priorités. Se fonde sur des pratiques et des politiques professionnelles façonnées par le rôle. Le rôle dispose d'une autonomie modérée, nécessitant un haut niveau de discernement opérationnel.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Rôles et responsabilités**
* Sert de manager/responsable technique pour développer un périmètre de travail, met en place le planning et contrôle les activités d'ingénierie des projets clients. Assure le leadership technique et sert d'interface avec la gestion des propositions, l'estimation des coûts, les partenaires, les clients, l'Ingénierie de produit GE Vernova, l'approvisionnement, les sous\-traitants d'Ingénierie.
* Développer des connaissances spécialisées dans sa discipline. Prodigue ses conseils en matière de meilleures pratiques et/ou de qualité. Est conscient des derniers développements techniques dans son propre domaine. Contribue à l'élaboration de stratégies et de politiques, et assure la mise en œuvre dans les limites de son domaine de responsabilités.
* Possède une connaissance approfondie des meilleures pratiques et de la manière dont son propre domaine s'intègre aux autres. Possède une connaissance pratique de la concurrence et des facteurs qui les différencient sur le marché.
* Fait preuve de discernement pour prendre des décisions ou résoudre des tâches ou des problèmes moyennement complexes dans les domaines de l'exploitation, de la gestion des produits, de la fabrication, de la technologie ou de l'ingénierie. Adopte une nouvelle perspective sur les solutions existantes. Utilise son expérience technique et son expertise en analyse de données pour appuyer les recommandations. Fait appel à des ressources limitées internes et externes en dehors de sa propre fonction pour l'aider à prendre une décision.
* Agit en tant que ressource pour ses collègues moins expérimentés. Peut piloter de petits projets avec des risques et des besoins en ressources modérés. Explique les informations difficiles ou sensibles. S'efforce d'établir un consensus. Développe les compétences de persuasion nécessaires pour influencer les autres sur des sujets relevant de son domaine.


**Qualifications De Base**
* 
* Pour les rôles en dehors des États\-Unis \- Ce rôle nécessite une expérience avancée de la fonction et de la station de travail audio numérique. Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une maîtrise dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent).
* Pour les rôles aux États\-Unis \- Maîtrise d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 6 ans d'expérience dans la fonction).


**Caractéristiques souhaitées**
* Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité démontrée d'analyse et de résolution des problèmes. Capacité démontrée à diriger des programmes/projets. Capacité à documenter, planifier, lancer et exécuter des programmes. Compétences établies en gestion de projet.Remarque : Pour se conformer aux exigences légales américaines en matière d'immigration et autres, il est nécessaire de préciser le nombre minimum d'années d'expérience requis pour tout poste basé aux États\-Unis. Pour les rôles en dehors des États\-Unis, pour assurer la conformité avec la législation applicable, les juristes doivent mentionner le niveau d'expérience requis et non PAS un nombre minimum d'années.Cette description de poste a pour but de fournir un guide détaillé du rôle. Toutefois, il n'est pas prévu de modifier ou de restreindre et/ou d'élargir de quelque manière que ce soit les tâches requises de chaque employé, telles qu'elles sont définies dans leur contrat de travail respectif et/ou convenues d'un commun accord entre un employé et son responsable.


******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 No

data.raw_snippet:
**Job Description Summary**
 Verantwortung für die globale Projektsteuerungsaktivität und Förderung einheitlicher Funktionsspezifikationen und gemeinsamer globaler Prozesse für die Projektimplementierung. Tätigkeiten, die dazu dienen, die Erwartungen des Kunden besser zu verstehen oder letztendlich
data.jd_text:
**Job Description Summary**
 Verantwortung für die globale Projektsteuerungsaktivität und Förderung einheitlicher Funktionsspezifikationen und gemeinsamer globaler Prozesse für die Projektimplementierung. Tätigkeiten, die dazu dienen, die Erwartungen des Kunden besser zu verstehen oder letztendlich zu erfüllen Beeinflusst Ansätze, Projekte und Programme im Funktionsbereich oder der betroffenen Unternehmensorganisation und die Arbeitsweise.Beeinflusst die Qualität, Effizienz und Effektivität des eigenen Teams.Hat wesentlichen Einfluss auf die Prioritäten.Geleitet von professionellen Praktiken und Richtlinien, die von der Rolle selbst geprägt sind.Die Rolle verfügt über eine moderate Autonomie und erfordert ein hohes Maß an operativem Urteilsvermögen.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten**
* Dient als technischer Leiter/Manager, um einen Arbeitsumfang zu bestimmen und die Engineering\-Aktivitäten für Kundenprojekte zu planen und zu überwachen. Bieten technische Führung und dienen als Schnittstelle zu Angebotsverwaltung, Kostenschätzung, Partnern, Kunden, GE Vernova Product Engineering, Beschaffung und Engineering\-Subunternehmern.
* Entwicklung von Fachwissen in der eigenen Disziplin.Dient als Ressource für bewährte Verfahren/Qualität.Hat Kenntnis der neuesten technischen Entwicklungen im eigenen Bereich.Trägt zur Strategie\- und Richtlinienentwicklung bei und gewährleistet die Umsetzung im Verantwortungsbereich.
* Verfügt über fundierte Kenntnisse zu Best Practices und über die Integration des eigenen Bereichs in andere Bereiche; verfügt über fundierte Kenntnisse des Wettbewerbs und der Faktoren, die das Unternehmen auf dem Markt auszeichnen
* Verwendet Urteilsvermögen, um Entscheidungen zu treffen oder moderat komplexe Aufgaben oder Probleme in den Bereichen Betrieb/Produktmanagement, Fertigung, Technologie oder Konstruktion zu lösen.Betrachtet bestehende Lösungen aus einer neuen Perspektive.Verwendet technische Erfahrung und Fachwissen für die Datenanalyse, um Empfehlungen zu unterstützen.Verwendet mehrere interne und begrenzte externe Quellen außerhalb der eigenen Funktion, um Entscheidungen zu treffen.
* Dient als Ressource für Kollegen mit weniger Erfahrung.Kann kleine Projekte mit moderaten Risiken und Ressourcenanforderungen leiten.Erklärt schwierige oder vertrauliche Informationen; arbeitet, um einen Konsens zu schaffen.Entwicklung von Überzeugungsfähigkeiten, die erforderlich sind, um andere bei Themen innerhalb des Fachgebiets zu beeinflussen.


**Grundqualifikationen**
* Diese Rolle erfordert umfangreiche Erfahrung. Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor\-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule.


**Gewünschte Eigenschaften**
* Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Nachweisliche Fähigkeit, Probleme zu analysieren und zu lösen. Nachweislich eFähigkeit, Programme/Projekte zu leiten. Fähigkeit, Programme zu dokumentieren, zu planen, zu vermarkten und auszuführen. Dokumentierte Projektmanagementfähigkeiten.Hinweis:Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind.Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden.Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern.Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern.


******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 No

data.jd_text:
As a Threat Management \& SOC Sub\-Competency Lead, you will be responsible for shaping the vision, strategy, and execution of advanced Security Operations Centers (SOCs) and threat management programs across the region. You will oversee large\-scale SOC build and transformation projects, drive innovation in detection and response, and advise C\-level stakeholders on cyber resilience strategies. This role requires a balance of strategic leadership, technical oversight, business development, and people management to position the firm as a market leader in SOC and threat detection services.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We’re looking for a visionary and strategic cybersecurity leader to lead the Threat Management sub\-competency across the MENA region. You will define and execute the strategy for building, transforming, and scaling world\-class Security Operations Center (SOC) and Threat Management capabilities for governments, national entities, and leading enterprises.
   

  

 This role is central to EY’s mission to build a safer digital economy and to support national cyber transformation programs across the Middle East and the wider MENA region.
   

  

 This is a unique opportunity to lead national and sector\-wide SOC initiatives, deliver cutting\-edge managed detection and response solutions, and be part of a leading firm that helps organizations stay ahead of today’s evolving cyber threats.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Define and lead the regional strategy and growth plan for SOC and Threat Management services across MENA.
* Own the Threat Management sub\-competency P\&L, driving market growth, operational excellence, and maturity practice.
* Oversee delivery of SOC build, transformation, and managed SOC engagements for government and enterprise clients.
* Develop and manage advanced threat detection, incident response, and threat hunting programs.
* Guide integration of threat intelligence, threat modeling, and red/purple team collaboration into SOC operations.
* Act as a trusted advisor to CISOs, CIOs, and boards, providing strategic guidance on SOC maturity and cyber resilience.
* Ensure SOC services comply with regulatory requirements (e.g., NCA ECC/DCC, ISO 27001, PCI DSS) and align with EY global standards and industry best practices.
* Drive innovation in detection engineering, AI/ML\-driven analytics, SOAR (Security Orchestration, Automation \& Response), and XDR.
* Accountable for assigned accounts, client relationship management, account growth, revenue, timely project execution, invoice collection, and maintain margins etc.
* Lead client\-facing workshops, executive presentations, and threat landscape briefings.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional practices (e.g., Cloud Security, Offensive Security, IR, Risk Advisory) to deliver integrated threat management programs.
* Build, develop, and retain a high\-performing team of SOC leaders, detection engineers, and threat hunters across Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, and the wider region.
* Lead strategic go\-to\-market initiatives, proposals, and client pursuits focused on SOC transformation and MDR.
* Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning, enabling local talent growth and certification advancement.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong leadership presence with ability to influence C\-level stakeholders and regulators.
* Visionary mindset with proven success in scaling SOC services across geographies and industries.
* Strong business acumen with experience in P\&L ownership, business development, pipeline management, and service commercialization.
* In\-depth knowledge of SOC operations, detection engineering, SIEM/SOAR/XDR technologies, and threat hunting practices.
* Strong understanding of threat intelligence and incident response coordination.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills — capable of bridging technical detail and strategic business outcomes.
* Visionary mindset with a track record of driving transformation and innovation in cybersecurity operations.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 12–15\+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity, with focus in SOC leadership, threat management, or managed detection and response.
* Proven experience leading large\-scale SOC transformations (build, operate, transfer models or managed SOC services).
* Demonstrated track record advising government, defense, financial, or critical infrastructure clients.
* Strong technical expertise with:
* SIEM: Splunk, IBM QRadar, Microsoft Sentinel
* SOAR: Cortex XSOAR, Splunk Phantom, Demisto
* EDR/XDR: Defender XDR, CrowdStrike Falcon, SentinelOne, Palo Alto Cortex
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or related field.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GIAC (GCIA, GCDA, GCTI, GRID), GCIH, CCSP, SANS.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience advising at the national or sector\-wide level on SOC and threat management strategy.
* Exposure to cyber threat intelligence operations and integration into SOC workflows.
* Experience leading AI/ML\-driven SOC initiatives, advanced analytics, and automation programs.
* Prior leadership in global or regional managed security services (MSSP/MDR).
* Experience presenting at conferences, publishing thought leadership, or contributing to cyber standards.


**What We Offer**
 We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.**
**The Exceptional EY Experience. It’s Yours To Build.**
**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform, and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.jd_text:
The Director \- Asset Application Operations is responsible for managing the operations, configuration, governance, and continuous availability of asset and park applications across the Qiddiya portfolio. This includes Vista and VGS ticketing and point\-of\-sale platforms, Maximo, ERD/Yardi, and all park\- and complex\-related applications, ensuring system availability, data accuracy, revenue integrity, and compliance with safety, leasing, and PCI DSS standards.
   

  

 The role oversees ticketing, guest\-facing, maintenance, leasing, and QHSE application operations to maintain guest experience continuity, asset reliability, lifecycle visibility, and operational integration across parks, sports, entertainment, and complex venue
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Manage day\-to\-day operations of Vista and VGS ticketing, admission, and point\-of\-sale platforms across Qiddiya entertainment venues.
* Govern product, pricing, capacity, promotions, and season\-pass configurations through controlled change management.
* Ensure integration between ticketing, POS, access control, CRM, payment gateways, and ERP systems.
* Oversee daily reconciliation of ticketing and POS revenue with Finance.
* Ensure PCI DSS compliance for payment processing and cardholder data.
* Lead peak\-day, major\-event, and degraded\-mode operational readiness, including load testing and command center support.
* Manage Maximo and ERD/Yardi environments supporting maintenance and leasing operations.
* Validate work orders, preventive maintenance schedules, asset hierarchies, tenant information, and lease transactions.
* Maintain standardized master data for assets, locations, tenants, and contracts.
* Manage release calendars and outage windows to minimize operational disruption.
* Oversee operations of all park and complex applications, including F\&B and retail POS, access control, RFID/cashless systems, lockers, virtual queuing, ride operations, and guest mobile applications.
* Maintain the application portfolio, support model, and venue\-specific SLAs.
* Coordinate major incident management and event\-day operational support with Park Operations.
* Ensure application readiness for seasonal operations, new attractions, and venue openings through onboarding, integration testing, and hypercare.
* Ensure QHSE checklists, incident records, and corrective actions are maintained within applications.
* Prepare and maintain audit\-ready documentation, including SOPs, operational controls, and supporting evidence.
* Monitor statutory inspections, certifications, renewals, and compliance dashboards.
* Collaborate with Safety and Engineering teams to enhance workflows and compliance processes.
* Monitor KPIs and dashboards for asset downtime, maintenance backlog, lease performance, revenue reconciliation, and SLA compliance.
* Oversee reconciliation of ERD revenue with Finance and resolve discrepancies.
* Maintain application governance controls, including access, change, and data quality management.
* Ensure operational documentation, knowledge bases, and support procedures remain current.
* Manage vendor support queues and prioritize issues based on business criticality.
* Deliver user training and operational guidance for inspections, work orders, lease amendments, and renewals.
* Manage UAT planning, execution, approvals, and release readiness.
* Monitor vendor SLAs, escalation processes, and service handovers across application support teams.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; Master's preferred.
* 10\+ years of experience in asset, park, or ticketing application operations.
* ITIL certification or equivalent required.
* Experience with Maximo and ERD/Yardi.
* Experience with Vista and VGS ticketing and POS platforms.
* Knowledge of integrations across ticketing, access control, CRM, ERP, and payment systems.
* Knowledge of PCI DSS, revenue reconciliation, and audit compliance.
* Experience managing major incidents, 24/7 operations, and event readiness.
* Experience with QHSE processes, vendor management, and SLA governance.
* Entertainment, theme park, or real estate industry experience preferred

In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!
   

  

 At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. **Job Description**
 Parsons are looking for an incredibly talented
 **Director of Systems \& Rolling Stock** 
 to join their team.
   

  

 As the Director of Systems \& Rolling Stock, you will provide the technical vision, engineering leadership, and governance required to deliver a world\-class, fully automated (GoA4\) driverless rail system. Operating client\-side within a highly dynamic, developer\-led environment, you will bridge the gap between master planning, and core rail systems.
   

  

 You will own the technical integrity of the system, driving decisions across the entire lifecycle—from concept and design management to procurement and eventual integration. A critical part of your mandate is managing technical consultants, ensuring internal governance framework compliance, and managing alignment with interfacing developers.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* System Ownership: Serve as the ultimate technical authority for all railway sub\-systems, including Grade of Automation 4 (GoA4\) signaling (CBTC), rolling stock, power supply/traction, telecommunications, SCADA, and depot equipment.
* Interface Architecture: Lead the integration of rail infrastructure into master\-planned developer sectors, ensuring civil, structural, and architectural interfaces match the system's spatial and functional needs.
* Innovation \& Future\-Proofing: Ensure the system leverages modern, reliable automated rail technologies optimized for the unique environmental conditions of Saudi Arabia.
* Consultant Oversight: Act as the primary client interface managing international engineering consultants, Project Management Officers (PMOs), and specialized shadow operators. Hold partners accountable to strict deliverables, quality, and timelines.
* Internal Governance: Establish and execute technical review gateways, safety assurance protocols (RAMS), and configuration control boards. Ensure all systems engineering processes comply with international standards and local regulations.
* Risk \& Value Engineering: Identify technical risks early and implement mitigation strategies. Run rigorous value engineering exercises to optimize capital expenditure without compromising safety, capacity, or performance.
* Stakeholder Integration: Coordinate directly with internal and external real estate development teams to align the rail system's alignment, station footprints, and utility corridors with adjacent mixed\-use developments.
* Commercial Mindset: Navigate a developer\-led environment by understanding how delivery timelines, construction phasing, and rail boundaries impact the broader commercial master plan.
* Conflict Resolution: Resolve complex technical interface conflicts between transit systems and real estate assets, protecting the rail system’s operational performance while facilitating developer progress.


**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
* Experience: Minimum of 15 years of experience in major rail infrastructure projects, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role operating client\-side or within a major project management consultancy.
* Technical Expertise: Proven track record of delivering fully automated, driverless rail transit systems (GoA4 / CBTC). Deep technical understanding of rolling stock procurement, systems integration, and automated depot operations is essential.
* Developer Environment: Demonstrated experience working within developer\-led, giga\-project, or complex multi\-stakeholder real estate environments.
* Consultant Management: Mastered the art of directing and evaluating Tier 1 international engineering and design consultants.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, or Systems Engineering. A Master’s degree or relevant professional certifications (e.g., Chartered Engineer, PMP) is highly advantageous.
* Regional Knowledge: Experience navigating the regulatory landscape, environmental challenges, and supply chain dynamics of Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC region is preferred.


 Parsons equally employs representation at all job levels no matter the race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability or genetic information.

data.jd_text:
**Overview**
 The Market Director – Rail shall develop and oversee all service delivery, inclusive of win work, client management and delivery of services for clients \& projects for the Rail Market for the Middle East. They shall be directly responsible for the performance of the Rail Market from a revenue and EBIT perspective as outlined within the Markets yearly targets.
   

  

 Your role
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Profitable Delivery**
* Overall responsibility for the Rail Market within the Middle East business. This includes but is not limited to:
* Bid Reviews \& Bid Drafting – Undertake the role of Project Director and/or Market Director during the bid process and manage the bid process in its entirety. Develop win themes and retain responsibility for successfully pricing projects. As required manage the bid budget and liaise with the business to identify and engage the correct SME's (supported by Capabilities) for bid development and answers.
* KAM \& Client Development – KAM \& Client Development activities are to be undertaken with a primary focus on the Market (secondary focus being alignment and support to other Markets and Accounts). This is to be service agnostic, and the principal focus is in developing profitable and resilient Client relationships. Accounts will define best practice and support selection of client account managers (training and development).
* Bid Reporting – Provide weekly feedback and insight confirming available opportunities and outlining decisions on which bids to respond to.
* Proactive Win Work – Engage proactively with clients to define opportunities prior to bids being released and incorporate these opportunities into our CRM and future opportunities pipeline.
* Revenue Management – Proactively manage Revenue and EBIT KPI's throughout the year utilising the financial tools and techniques as defined by the business.
* Capture Planning – Lead 'Client Value Proposition' workshops \& strategy development to align services with client needs (supported by Capabilities).
* Working at Risk – Responsible for the development of working at risk strategies and provide recommendations for relevant approvers.
* Starting the Job Right – Responsible and Accountable for the implementation of successful project start up including but not limited to Project Risk Management, Stakeholder Management and Project Management plans.
* Project Review (process) – Lead project review process and proactive management of commercial performance.


**Market Lead – Operational Excellence**
* Market Director – Rail shall ensure that the best tools, techniques and approaches are utilised across your Market (supported by Capabilities). Identify new ways of working where required that will improve the commercial performance of your Market. This includes:
* Process \& Procedures – Define, administer and develop Market specific tools and techniques. Ensure clarity on the process, its application and the relevant training and communications to ensure compliant adoption throughout the Market.
* Market Risk Management – Advise the business on Market risks and the relevant mitigation plans. Create a quarterly Market risk management plan and issue to key leaders and stakeholders within the business.
* Market Trends – Identify, through either direct relationships or analytical tools, key trends within the Market and provide specific action plans as required to develop AtkinsRéalis capability to meet the needs of the Market.
* Project Delivery Oversight – Accountability and Responsibility for all Market projects and clients to ensure that delivery aligns with the contractual commitments and manage team performance accordingly.


**Leadership \& Management**
* Establish and develop the overall behaviours for success within the Market. Ensuring positive behaviours and responsibilities are encouraged, developed and endorsed in the management of the following:
* Organisation Design \& Operating Model – Collaboration with the Strategy \& Transformation Team (Responsible) to review, develop and approve any adjustments to the Market operating model. This is inclusive of organisation design, organisation interface definition and assignment of roles and responsibilities.
* Collaborative Behaviours – Lead by example and demonstrate critical behaviours of accountability, inspiration, collaboration, inclusivity and integrity.
* Learning \& Development – Identify and drive development and inspire the Market resources in line with both the organisation goals and the career aspirations of the individuals.
* Market Team Budget \& Deployment – Deliver the operational oversight and management activities in line with the Budget provided by the SVP Infrastructure Market. Ensure the team is appropriately sized to achieve EBIT and utilisation targets.
* Training – Identify and if required deliver Market based training to improve the capability of the wider business as required.
* Technical Excellence – Oversee and ensure best in class delivery of Market projects.
* Lessons Learnt – Retain and develop a lesson learnt log across the Market activities. Identify areas for improvement and collaboratively develop robust and clear action plans. Communicate pertinent lessons learnt to the business.
* Digital Transformation – Focus on the incorporation of 'digital' into services to create value propositions.
* PDR \& Team Development – Define and assist inclusively in the successful delivery of PDR's'and career development for resources within the Market (supported by Capabilities).


**Key Interfaces (Others)**
* Marketing and Communications – Develop a Market specific 'Marketing and Communications' Strategy outlining what the approach is to engage with the wider Market to drive AtkinsRéalis business performance.
* Thought Leadership – Produce thought leadership articles and papers in alignment with the Market 'Marketing and Communications' Strategy.
* Peer Review – As required provide Peer Review activities for adjacent Capability, Markets and Accounts.
* Performance Feedback (service levels) – Communicate to business feedback on Market performance – deliverables, people, financial \- positive or negative (integrity).


**Key Performance Indicators**
 The Market Director – Rail shall develop and oversee all service delivery, inclusive of win work, client management and delivery of services for clients \& projects for the Rail Market for the Middle East. They shall be directly responsible for the performance of the Rail Market from a revenue and EBIT perspective as outlined within the Markets yearly targets.
   

  

 The various measurable aspects to this role and associated KPI's'are as follows:
   

  

* Market Strategy – Market performance aligned with LRP, Business Plan and proposed targets specific to Rail. This includes achieving targets for P\&L, EBIT and Headcount.

Ensure Rail resource is managed in line with the Overhead budget as provided during the business planning cycle. * Leadership \& Vision (Accountable, Inspiring, Inclusive, Collaborative \& Integrity) – Provide leadership and demonstrate positive AtkinsRéalis behaviours with performance defined by team feedback through pulse surveys and other feedback avenues (as prescribed by HR).

**About You**
* Extensive Profit \& Loss management capabilities.

* Regional mentor for top talent.

data.raw_snippet:
Req ID: 517408
   

  

 At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high\-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Eve
data.jd_text:
Req ID: 517408
   

  

 At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high\-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
   

  

**Your future role** 
 "Take on a new challenge and apply your engineering and project management expertise in a new cutting\-edge field. You’ll work alongside innovative, dedicated, and collaborative teammates. You'll play a pivotal role in shaping the future of transportation by performing the basic and detailed power supply engineering activities of a traction project (metro, tramway, or mainline). Day\-to\-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (including civil and MEP partners/contractors), manage all the Power Supply interfaces with local utility, and much more."
   

  

 We’ll look to you for:
   

  

* Lead MV/LV Traction Engineering: Ensure project implementation aligns with Design for Quality standards; propose solutions for performance and reliability.
* Perform Engineering Activities: Handle basic and detailed engineering for HV, MV, LV power supply and DC traction systems.
* Develop Technical Documentation: Prepare electrical architectures, technical, functional, and interface specifications; conduct clause\-by\-clause reviews and gap analysis.
* Prepare Calculation Notes: Short circuit, cable sizing, power balance, power factor study, UPS and battery sizing, earthing, protection coordination, MCB coordination, and basic structural calculations.
* Manage Interfaces: Identify and manage interfaces between power supply subsystems and other project subsystems.
* Allocate Requirements: Perform transverse requirement allocations in collaboration with specialists; develop requirements from standards, certifications, safety, and customer specifications.
* Supplier Coordination: Work closely with DC traction equipment suppliers; define architecture, operational modes, and functionalities; write subsystem specifications.
* Provide Project Support: Deliver method statements, testing procedures, and training as required.
* Procurement \& Validation: Write technical purchasing specifications, evaluate supplier offers, validate documents, define standards, and participate in factory acceptance tests.
* Verification \& Validation (V\&V): Define and execute verification strategies with engineering, certification, and validation teams.
* Site Issue Resolution: Investigate and resolve technical issues at site, implement modifications, and ensure problem closure.
* Provide technical support to Construction and Testing \& Commissioning teams; participate in site testing and commissioning when required.
* Perform project\-level KPI reporting and métier\-level reporting (via weekly reports).
* Support the PrEM in implementing and updating engineering risk mitigation plans, managing change orders, optimizing QCD, and participating in design reviews.


**Coordinate and manage** 
 interfaces with:
   

  

* Regional and central engineering teams/experts

data.jd_text:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission\-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting\-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
   

  

 Your impact
   

  

 Jacobs is seeking an experienced Commercial Director to oversee the commercial, contractual, financial, procurement, risk, and claims management activities for construction supervision and consultancy services associated with major infrastructure projects. The role ensures the effective administration of consultancy agreements, construction contracts, variations, claims, and commercial compliance while safeguarding the interests of the client and ensuring projects are delivered within approved budgets and contractual frameworks. The Commercial Director provides strategic commercial leadership to the supervision team, supports decision\-making on contractual matters, and oversees commercial governance throughout the project lifecycle.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Commercial Leadership \& Strategy**
 Develop and implement commercial management strategies that support the successful delivery of large\-scale infrastructure programs, ensuring alignment with client objectives and contractual requirements. Provide strategic commercial advice to project leadership regarding project performance, commercial risks, contract obligations, and financial impacts while establishing robust commercial controls, reporting systems, and governance frameworks to support effective decision\-making and project success.
   

  

**Contract Administration \& Management**
 Lead the administration and management of construction contracts, consultancy agreements, and service contracts, ensuring compliance with contractual provisions and project requirements. Interpret contract conditions, provide contractual guidance to project teams, manage correspondence related to commercial matters, review contractual notices, and oversee the implementation of contract administration procedures in accordance with FIDIC and other applicable contract forms.
   

  

**Cost Management \& Financial Control**
 Oversee project cost monitoring, valuation of works, budget tracking, financial reporting, forecasting, and change management processes to ensure projects remain within approved budgets. Review contractors’ payment applications, evaluate financial implications of contract modifications, verify cost assessments prepared by the supervision team, and provide accurate commercial reports to clients and senior stakeholders.
   

  

**Variations, Claims \& Dispute Resolution**
 Manage the assessment, evaluation, negotiation, and resolution of contractor claims, variations, extension of time requests, and contractual disputes. Ensure all submissions are reviewed in accordance with contractual provisions, maintain detailed records supporting entitlement assessments, provide recommendations to the Engineer and Client, and support dispute avoidance and resolution initiatives to mitigate project impacts.
   

  

**Procurement \& Tender Support**
 Provide commercial support during procurement and tendering activities by contributing to tender preparation, bid evaluations, commercial assessments, contract negotiations, and award recommendations. Ensure procurement activities comply with client policies and project requirements while supporting the development of fair and commercially balanced contract arrangements.
   

  

**Risk Management**
 Identify, evaluate, and manage commercial and contractual risks associated with large infrastructure projects. Maintain risk registers, assess the potential impact of emerging issues, develop mitigation strategies, and provide regular commercial risk reports to project leadership and clients to support proactive project management and informed decision\-making.
   

  

**Stakeholder \& Client Management**
 Act as the primary commercial advisor to the client, project management team, contractors, and key stakeholders on all commercial and contractual matters. Build strong relationships with clients, government authorities, consultants, contractors, and project partners while leading negotiations, resolving commercial issues, and ensuring transparency and collaboration throughout project delivery.
   

  

**Team Leadership \& Development**
 Lead and mentor commercial managers, quantity surveyors, contract administrators, cost engineers, and commercial specialists within the construction supervision team. Establish performance objectives, provide professional development opportunities, encourage knowledge sharing, and foster a high\-performance culture focused on excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
   

  

**Governance \& Compliance**
 Ensure all commercial activities are conducted in accordance with contractual obligations, client requirements, company policies, industry standards, and applicable regulations. Establish strong commercial governance processes, support project audits, maintain comprehensive commercial records, and ensure adherence to ethical and professional standards in all commercial dealings.
   

  

 Here's what you'll need
   

  

 Bachelor's degree in quantity surveying, Commercial Management, Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Law, Finance, or related discipline.
   

  

 Professional certifications such as MRICS, MCIOB or equivalent.
   

  

 Minimum 20 years of commercial, contracts, or quantity surveying experience within infrastructure and construction projects.
   

  

 Strong experience with FIDIC or similar forms of contract, including claims, variations, and dispute resolution.
   

  

 Proven track record in cost management, contract administration, and commercial leadership on large\-scale, multi‑package projects.
   

  

 Excellent negotiation, analytical, and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to develop and defend well\-reasoned commercial positions.
   

  

 Strong leadership and team management skills, with experience managing multi‑cultural commercial/QS teams.

data.jd_text:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consultancy groups specialising in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA's mission is to design safe and sustainable transport solutions to bring people together, develop social inclusion and facilitate access to employment, education and leisure throughout the world.
   

  

 For 65 years, the Group has been working alongside cities and regions to contribute to their development by creating, improving and modernising their infrastructure and transport systems, throughout the life cycle of their projects. SYSTRA is involved from the earliest stages of design through to the testing, deployment and maintenance phases. The company provides all its services in over 80 countries worldwide and generates 74% of its turnover internationally. With its new services, SYSTRA supports its clients and partners in their digital, ecological and energy transition, in order to invent the mobility of tomorrow.
   

  

 Context
   

  

***This requirement is for a bid opportunity only at this stage. Any engagement will be subject to successful project award and final client approval.***
 We are seeking a highly experienced Project Director / Technical Director to lead the study and design delivery of major metro projects. The ideal candidate will bring at least 20 years of professional experience in rail and metro infrastructure, with strong expertise across the full project development cycle, including feasibility studies, concept design, preliminary design, and tender documentation phases. Experience in multidisciplinary design management, including coordination of out\-of\-country design
   

  

 centres and subconsultants, is essential. Experience in the Middle East will be considered a strong advantage.
   

  

 This role requires both strategic leadership and deep technical oversight, ensuring high\-quality multidisciplinary design delivery, effective client engagement, commercial performance, and successful coordination across internal teams, international design offices, and external stakeholders.
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

 The Project Director / Technical Director will provide overall leadership for metro study and design assignments, ensuring that technical, commercial, and program objectives are achieved. The successful candidate will direct multidisciplinary teams involved in rail planning, civil, structural, geotechnical, systems, stations, depots, track, MEP, architecture, and interface management.
   

  

 The role includes leading and reviewing project development activities from early\-stage feasibility and concept studies through preliminary design and tender package preparation. The candidate will oversee technical quality, design integration, risk management, client communication, stakeholder coordination, and management of distributed design delivery models involving international design centres and specialist subconsultants.
   

  

 The individual will also act as the senior point of contact for clients, authorities, partners, and key project stakeholders, supporting business development activities where required and contributing to bid preparation, methodology definition, resource planning, and project strategy.
   

  

* Lead the delivery of metro and urban rail study/design projects from feasibility stage through tender stage.
* Provide technical direction and strategic oversight across multidisciplinary design teams.
* Manage project scope, schedule, budget, resources, and overall performance.
* Lead multidisciplinary design management across internal teams, out\-of\-country design centres, and subconsultants.
* Ensure effective coordination, interface management, and quality control across geographically distributed design teams.
* Oversee the preparation and review of feasibility studies, concept designs, preliminary designs, and tender documents.
* Ensure integration between civil, structural, architectural, track, systems, depot, and operational requirements.
* Ensure compliance with client requirements, local regulations, international standards, and project governance procedures.
* Manage interfaces with clients, authorities, operators, contractors, and other stakeholders.
* Identify project risks and opportunities and implement mitigation strategies.
* Support value engineering, constructability reviews, and design optimization.
* Provide leadership in quality assurance and technical review processes.
* Review and manage the outputs of partner organizations and specialist subconsultants to ensure alignment with project requirements.
* Mentor senior engineers and discipline leads and foster a high\-performance project environment.
* Support proposals, bids, and business development initiatives related to metro and rail opportunities.


 Profile/Skills
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Transportation Engineering, or another relevant engineering discipline.
* A master’s degree in a relevant field is preferred.
* Minimum 20 years of relevant professional experience in metro, rail, or major urban transit infrastructure projects.
* Demonstrated experience in metro projects is essential.
* Proven experience in the following project phases is mandatory:
+ Feasibility studies
+ Concept design
+ Preliminary design
+ Tender stage / tender documentation

* Strong experience in multidisciplinary design management.
* Proven experience managing design delivery involving out\-of\-country design centres and subconsultants.
* Strong experience in the management and coordination of multidisciplinary design teams.
* Proven ability to lead large and complex transportation infrastructure projects.
* Experience dealing directly with clients, government authorities, and key stakeholders.
* Middle East project experience is a strong advantage.
* Professional registration or chartership is an advantage.
* Strong knowledge of metro and urban rail project development.
* Understanding of alignment design, station planning, depot concepts, interfaces, and systems integration.
* Familiarity with international design codes, rail/metro standards, and project delivery best practices.
* Strong understanding of tender documentation, technical specifications, design reports, and scope definition.
* Ability to review and challenge technical solutions to ensure safety, efficiency, and value.
* Strong capability in managing design interfaces across multiple disciplines, offices, and external consultants.


 Systra is an equal opportunities company; this position is open to all applicants.

* Identify partnership opportunities that support PepsiCo’s business priorities, reputation goals, and social impact agenda.

**Preferred Competencies**

* Ability to identify opportunities and turn ideas into actionable programs.
* Comfortable building relationships and working across different functions and markets.
* Creative thinker with a practical approach to execution.
* Strong project management and coordination skills.
* Collaborative, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment.
* Passion for community impact, partnerships, and purpose\-driven initiatives.

data.jd_text:
At AlixPartners, we solve the most complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action when it really matters; creating value that has a lasting impact on companies, their people, and the communities they serve. By understanding, respecting, and honoring the needs of our employees, clients, and communities, AlixPartners actively promotes an inclusive environment. We strongly believe in the value that diversity brings to our experiences and are committed to the perpetual enhancements of initiatives, policies, and practices. We hold ourselves accountable by providing the space for authenticity, growth, and equity for everyone.
   

  

 AlixPartners has embraced a hybrid work model to provide flexibility and support our employees’ work\-life integration. Our hybrid model combines a mix of in\-person (at client site or AlixPartners office) and remote working. Travel is part of this position, but the frequency may vary based on client, team, and individual circumstances.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Are you ready to build a future that exceeds your expectations? At AlixPartners, a leading global consulting firm, we help CEOs, boards, and owners tackle their most complex, high\-value challenges—often those making front\-page news and shaping Board Room agendas.
   

  

 Our Energy \& Process Industries (EPI) practice works with healthy, underperforming, and distressed companies across the refining, petrochemicals, and broader downstream value chain. We are seeking an experienced and entrepreneurial Director to lead and expand our Refining \& Chemicals platform. This role requires a proven leader who can drive transformational client delivery, spearhead business development, and manage multiple high\-stakes engagements simultaneously.
   

  

 You will collaborate with C\-level executives at national, integrated, and independent energy and chemicals companies, as well as institutional investors and portfolio firms. Drawing on your deep industry expertise, you’ll deliver measurable results across strategy, operations, capital, and performance.
   

  

 As part of our collaborative, fast\-paced team, you will work on urgent, high\-impact situations—helping clients unlock value while pursuing your own professional development and growth aspirations.
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end client delivery across strategy, operational improvement, cost transformation, and commercial performance in refining and petrochemicals
* Serve as a trusted advisor to senior executives and boards—especially in situations of urgency, complexity, or underperformance
* Oversee and coordinate multiple concurrent client engagements, ensuring excellence in delivery and outcomes across teams
* Drive business development efforts with both existing and new clients—developing relationships, shaping opportunities, and converting high\-value mandates
* Build and develop the practice, including talent development, capability building, and cross\-functional collaboration across AlixPartners globally
* Collaborate closely with peers in turnaround, restructuring, due diligence, and value creation to bring multi\-disciplinary solutions to clients and investors


 The Performance Improvement Director \- Refining \& Chemicals (Energy \& Process Industries Practice) is a permanent role located in Riyadh and reports to the Partner.
   

  

 This description is not designed to encompass a comprehensive listing of required activities, duties or responsibilities.
   

  

 What you’ll need
   

  

* A minimum of 15 years of experience with a blend of strategic consulting and industry leadership in refining, petrochemicals, or downstream
* Experience may include time with:
* A top\-tier strategy firm at Senior Manager or Principal level
* A global energy or chemicals operator in VP or senior functional/strategy roles
* An institutional investor or PE\-backed portfolio company with a focus on value creation
* Demonstrated ability to lead both delivery and business development across complex client portfolios
* Deep understanding of global energy markets, value chains, and regional dynamics, with experience in the Middle East a strong plus
* Prior involvement in M\&A, commercial diligence, or post\-deal transformation is advantageous
* A track record of high\-impact problem solving, boardroom presence, and driving results under pressure
