data.title: Senior Lead Auditor Industrial Construction
data.raw_snippet:
**Job Purpose** 




 The Senior Lead Auditor – Industrial Construction is responsible for leading and executing complex risk\-based internal audit engagements across construction, engineering, project management, technology and related business processes. The role provides independent and objective
data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose** 




 The Senior Lead Auditor – Industrial Construction is responsible for leading and executing complex risk\-based internal audit engagements across construction, engineering, project management, technology and related business processes. The role provides independent and objective assurance on the adequacy and effectiveness of governance, risk management, internal controls, compliance, project controls, and compliance controls. The position is expected to identify control weaknesses, assess operational and construction risks, recommend practical improvements, and support management in strengthening accountability, compliance, cost control, project governance, and system reliability.
 



**3\. Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities** 




**Audit Planning and Execution** 



* Lead construction, project, operational, construction, compliance, and risk\-based audit engagements in accordance with the approved annual audit plan and internal audit methodology.
* Develop audit programs, risk\-control matrices, testing procedures, work plans, and audit scopes aligned with business risk, project complexity, and technology dependencies.
* Conduct walkthroughs, interviews, process reviews, data analysis, sampling, testing, and evidence validation to assess the design and operating effectiveness of controls.
* Ensure audit workpapers are complete, accurate, properly referenced, and supported by sufficient and appropriate audit evidence.
* Coordinate with process owners and project stakeholders to obtain required documentation, clarify audit observations, and validate facts prior to report finalization.



**Construction, Engineering, and Project Audit** 



* Review the effectiveness of controls across construction project lifecycle activities, including tendering, estimation, budgeting, contract administration, procurement, subcontractor management, project execution, cost control, billing, claims, variations, and project close\-out.
* Assess compliance with approved project budgets, contracts, delegation of authority, procurement procedures, site instructions, change management procedures, and project governance requirements.
* Evaluate project controls relating to cost, schedule, quality, scope, risk, progress measurement, earned value, material management, manpower utilization, and equipment deployment.
* Review contractor and subcontractor payments, progress certifications, variation orders, claims, back charges, retention, advance payments, and supporting documentation.
* Identify risks relating to cost overruns, delays, weak documentation, contract leakage, non\-compliance, duplicate payments, unauthorized commitments, and ineffective project monitoring.



**Risk, Governance, and Compliance** 



* Identify key operational, financial, contractual, compliance, fraud, cybersecurity, and technology risks and assess whether controls are appropriately designed and operating effectively.
* Evaluate compliance with government regulations (engineering, construction, HSE), company policies, delegation of authority, approval matrices, project governance requirements, contractual obligations, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Support fraud risk assessments, special reviews, and investigations relating to construction projects, procurement activities, contractor claims, system access, or technology misuse, where required and authorized.
* Provide practical and value\-adding recommendations to address control deficiencies, reduce risk exposure, improve project governance, and strengthen technology control environments.
* Monitor agreed management action plans and follow up with responsible owners to ensure audit findings are addressed within agreed timelines.



**Reporting and Stakeholder Management** 



* Prepare clear, concise, and well\-supported audit reports highlighting observations, risk ratings, root causes, business impact, recommendations, agreed management actions, owners, and target completion dates.
* Discuss audit findings with project teams, business process owners, and senior management in a professional and constructive manner to ensure factual accuracy and practical resolution.
* Escalate significant project risks, control breakdowns, suspected fraud indicators, and high\-risk findings to the Head of Internal Audit / Audit Director, as required.



  





**Team Leadership and Quality Assurance** 



* Lead, guide, and review the work of assigned auditors to ensure audit objectives are achieved and deliverables meet internal audit quality standards.
* Coach junior auditors on construction audit techniques, technology audit testing, audit documentation, stakeholder communication, and report writing.
* Ensure audit engagements are completed within agreed timelines, budgeted hours, and required quality standards.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of audit tools, templates, risk assessment processes, data analytics, project audit procedures, and technology audit methodologies.
* Maintain current knowledge of construction industry practices, project controls, contract management, IT governance, cybersecurity, data analytics, and regulatory developments relevant to the organization.



**4\. Decision\-Making Authority** 



* Recommend audit scope, testing approach, risk ratings, and control improvement actions for review and approval by the Head of Internal Audit / Audit Director.
* Escalate significant construction, project, contract, technology, cybersecurity, compliance, and fraud\-related risks in accordance with internal audit protocols.
* Prioritize audit fieldwork activities and allocate tasks to assigned auditors within approved engagement plans.
* Provide professional audit conclusions based on audit evidence gathered, while final audit report issuance remains subject to internal audit leadership approval.



**5\. Key Internal and External Interfaces** 



* Internal: Construction, Engineering, Project Controls, Contracts, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Governance, Risk and Compliance, HR, and Business Unit Management.
* External: External auditors, consultants, contractors, subcontractors, technology vendors, regulatory advisors, and relevant authorities, where applicable and as authorized.



**6\. Qualifications, Experience, and Certifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field within Industrial Construction. A master’s degree is an advantage, as is a specialization in main pipelines and energy infrastructure.
* Professional certification such as CIA, PMP, RICS or equivalent is preferred.
* Prior hands\-on experience operating within the CIS (Commonwealth of Independent States) market is essential.
* Minimum of 8–10 years of relevant experience in internal audit, project audit, construction audit with at least 3 years in a lead audit or supervisory capacity.
* Strong experience auditing construction and project processes, including contract administration, procurement, subcontractor management, project cost control, claims, variations, progress certification, and project governance.
* Experience in large, diversified, project\-based, construction, engineering, infrastructure, energy or multinational organizations is an advantage.
* Hands\-on experience with ERP systems, project management systems, document management platforms, and data analysis tools. Experience with SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Primavera, Power BI, or similar systems is preferred.



**7\. Required Knowledge, Skills, and Competencies** 



* Strong understanding of construction operations, project controls, contracts, procurement, commercial management, internal controls, and risk\-based auditing.
* Strong ability to read and analyze project documentation. Proven track record of verifying construction compliance with project designs and engineering standards. Deep understanding of and strict adherence to industrial HSE policies.
* Excellent command of both Russian and English (written and spoken) is strictly required.
* Ability to interpret project budgets, contracts, variation orders, claims, payment certificates, system logs, workflow approvals, access rights, policies, procedures, and technical documentation.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, investigation, root\-cause analysis, and data interpretation skills.
* Strong report writing skills with the ability to present complex construction and technology issues clearly, accurately, and professionally.
* High level of integrity, independence, confidentiality, professional skepticism, and attention to detail.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to challenge constructively and influence corrective actions.
* Ability to manage multiple audits, deadlines, and priorities in a fast\-paced, project\-driven environment.
* Leadership capability to guide audit teams, review workpapers, and ensure high\-quality audit deliverables.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. Data analytics capability is an advantage.



**8\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 




  




* Quality, accuracy, and completeness of audit workpapers, testing results, and audit reports.
* Number and significance of construction, project, contract, technology, cybersecurity, and compliance risks identified and resolved.
* Timely closure of agreed management action plans and follow\-up audit findings.
* Practicality and effectiveness of audit recommendations in improving project governance, cost control, compliance, and technology control environments.
* Stakeholder satisfaction with the clarity, relevance, and value of audit outputs.
* Effectiveness in leading assigned audit teams and maintaining internal audit quality standards.
* Compliance with internal audit methodology, professional standards, and ethical requirements.



**9\. Working Conditions** 



* Office\-based role with regular visits to project sites, construction locations, branches, subsidiaries or business units as required by the audit plan.
* May require extended working hours during critical audit periods, project reviews, system reviews, investigations, reporting deadlines, or special assignments.

data.jd_text:
We are looking for a highly technical, execution\-focused Product Delivery Lead to bridge the gap between closed sales and active customer success. In this role, you will own the critical onboarding phase, ensuring that new enterprise customers are seamlessly integrated into our SaaS platform despite having highly specific, complex data requirements.
   

  

 You will be the orchestrator who turns a signed contract into active, AI\-driven value. By combining a deep understanding of our product portfolio with expertise in data ingestion techniques and ontology mapping, you will eliminate friction in the setup process. Your ultimate goal is to accelerate the "Time\-to\-Value" for our customers, ensuring they can leverage our Agentic AI tools and sustainability solutions as quickly and effortlessly as possible.
   

  

**Jobs To Be Done**
* Lead the end\-to\-end technical onboarding and implementation of our SaaS solutions for new enterprise customers.
* Serve as the primary bridge between the customer's technical teams and our internal engineering/data teams to define and execute data ingestion strategies.
* Manage complex data requirements, including leading ontology mapping exercises to ensure customer data seamlessly aligns with our AI models.
* Develop, manage, and execute detailed delivery project plans, ensuring timelines, milestones, and customer expectations are consistently met.
* Partner closely with the Business Developer to ensure a smooth handover from the sales cycle and align on strategic customer goals.
* Create repeatable, scalable onboarding playbooks to continuously reduce friction and speed up the delivery lifecycle for future customers.
* Troubleshoot early\-stage data integration roadblocks, ensuring a frictionless transition into "business\-as\-usual" platform usage.


**Education Requirements**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Certifications in Project Management (e.g., PMP, Prince2, Scrum Master) are highly valued.
* Bonus points for certifications or coursework in Data Engineering, Cloud Architecture, or Database Management.


**Experience**
* 5\+ years of experience in technical delivery, SaaS implementation, solutions architecture, or technical account management.
* Proven track record of successfully onboarding B2B enterprise customers with heavy data integration requirements.
* Hands\-on experience navigating data ingestion pipelines, APIs, ETL processes, and complex data mapping/ontology mapping.

**Manages Cross\-functional team of full\-stack developers (backend \+ frontend \+ mobile) across multiple product areas** 




  





**About the role** 




 We run multiple product areas on a shared microservices platform. You will own end\-to\-end delivery, architecture, and code quality for your assigned product areas, run their squads, and represent them in cross\-product platform decisions.
 



  





**What you'll do** 




 • Lead a squad of 5–10 engineers (backend, frontend, mobile) across your assigned product areas sprint planning, design reviews, PR reviews, 1:1s, performance management.
 



 • Own architecture decisions inside your product areas and partner with other Tech Leads and the Head of Technology on platform\-wide concerns (shared auth, common backend, mobile app, analytics pipeline).
 



 • Set engineering quality bars: PR review standards, branching / cherry\-pick discipline between QA and production, test coverage, migration safety, incident response.
 



 • Drive technical roadmap conversion from product requirements — break down work, estimate, sequence, ship.
 



 • Be hands\-on: write code on critical paths, unblock the team, prototype risky changes yourself, ship hotfixes.
 



 • Run incident response for production issues in your product areas — root\-cause analysis, post\-mortems, prevention.
 



  





**Must\-have experience** 




 • 7\+ years building production web platforms; 2\+ years leading engineering teams.
 



 • NestJS monorepos (apps \+ libs structure) — multiple apps per service sharing typed libs.
 



 • Next.js App Router with server components, ISR / SSR, dynamic routes.
 



 • TypeScript end\-to\-end (strict mode), modern React (hooks, MUI, Tailwind).
 



 • PostgreSQL at scale — schema design, indexing, query optimisation, Sequelize ORM, migration discipline. Familiarity with Azure Cosmos DB for PostgreSQL for distributed workloads is a plus.
 



 • Search platforms — Azure AI Search (scoring profiles, semantic configurations, synonym maps) and / or Elasticsearch (mappings, aggregations, dashboards).
 



 • Azure application platform: Container Apps, App Services, Function Apps, Service Bus, Storage Blob, Front Door.
 



 • CI/CD on Azure DevOps Pipelines — build → ACR push → container app update; cherry\-pick workflows for promoting QA → production.
 



 • AI integration experience — Azure OpenAI (chat, embeddings), prompt design, structured JSON response\_format, retries / fallbacks.
 



  





**Nice to have** 




 • Marketplace / multi\-vertical platform experience.
 



 • Mobile app delivery (Flutter or React Native) — Android \+ iOS.
 



 • BullMQ / queue\-based async processing.
 



 • Multi\-tenant / B2B subscription / quota systems.
 



 • Regional payment integrations.
 



 • Moderation systems (Implio or similar).
 



 • ERP integration (e.g. Microsoft Dynamics 365\).
 



 • Third\-party ATS / recruitment integrations (e.g. Zoho Recruit).

**Role Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 The
 **Service Line Manager – Managed Infrastructure Services** 
 is accountable for the operational stability, performance, and continuous improvement of on\-premise infrastructure services, including data centers, servers, storage, virtualization, and network platforms.
   

  

 The role focuses on executing operational plans, ensuring service availability, managing escalations, and driving compliance with organizational, contractual, and regulatory requirements. The role works closely with internal delivery leaders, security services, vendors, and functional teams to resolve complex operational challenges and ensure infrastructure reliability that directly supports business outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Roles \& Responsibilities**
**Strategic**
* Execute managed infrastructure operational plans aligned with Malomatia’s service delivery objectives and customer contractual commitments.
* Own service stability, availability, and performance for managed infrastructure services, ensuring reliability of business ‑ critical systems.
* Identify process gaps, operational inefficiencies, and service risks, recommending and driving continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure adherence to organizational policies, service standards, contractual SLAs, and regulatory requirements, particularly for government and regulated customers.
* Provide practical inputs to refine infrastructure operational policies, service frameworks, and runbooks based on real service experience.
* Proactively identify infrastructure risks and capacity constraints, recommending mitigation and improvement actions.


**Operational**
* Oversee and govern infrastructure monitoring tools and operational dashboards to enable proactive detection and prevention of incidents.
* Lead and own resolution of complex infrastructure incidents, acting as the primary escalation point for service\-impacting issues.
* Ensure infrastructure services consistently meet agreed SLAs, service levels, and availability targets.
* Drive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for major or recurring incidents and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
* Review, approve, and govern infrastructure changes, ensuring risk mitigation and minimal service disruption.
* Coordinate change scheduling, stakeholder communication, and risk assessment in alignment with operational and customer requirements.
* Manage vendor and OEM relationships, including SLA management, maintenance contracts, and technical escalations.
* Collaborate closely with internal delivery, security, and functional teams to ensure secure, aligned, and stable operations.
* Maintain accurate infrastructure documentation, including SOPs, diagrams, configurations, and service records; support audits and operational reviews.


**People Management**
* Lead and develop the managed services team, promoting accountability, collaboration, and operational discipline in line with Malomatia values.
* Provide ongoing performance feedback, coaching, and mentoring to team members, focusing on operational excellence.
* Contribute inputs to performance appraisals, promotions, and incentive recommendations for direct reports.
* Support skill development, knowledge advancement, and succession planning for critical operational roles.
* Drive employee engagement and retention by building a motivated, ownership\-oriented service delivery team.


**Qualifications**
**Job Specifications**
**Desired Educational Background**
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field from a recognized university
   

  

**Language Requirement**
* English (mandatory) / Arabic (preferred)


**Desired Experience**
* 8\+ years of experience in Infrastructure Operations and Managed Services.
* Strong background working in a Managed Services Provider (MSP) or large system integrator.
* Hands‑on experience supporting enterprise or government infrastructure environments.
* Proven experience working in SLA‑driven, contract‑based service delivery models.
* Demonstrated ability to take ownership of operational outcomes, not just technical delivery.
* Strong communication skills and confidence in dealing directly with customers.
* Familiarity with ITIL or equivalent service management frameworks
* Exposure to government, utilities, finance, or other regulated environments.
* Practical experience implementing or operating under ITIL\-aligned processes.
* Experience transitioning infrastructure from project delivery to steady ‑ state managed service.
* Experience working with vendors and OEM support models.


**Job Specific Skills**
* Strong knowledge of on\-prem infrastructure technologies
* Monitoring tools, alerting, and proactive operations
* Advanced troubleshooting and performance optimization
* Data center operations (power, cooling, racks, hardware lifecycle)
* Exposure to hybrid/cloud environments (desirable)
* Basic understanding of information security and compliance


**Competencies**
**Technical**
* Managed Infrastructure Operations
* SLA \& Service Performance Management
* Incident \& Escalation Ownership
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
* ITIL\-based Service Management
* Team Leadership \& Mentoring
* Presales Support \& Service Transition
* Operational Governance \& Compliance


**Behavioral**
* Critical Thinking \& Problem Solving
* Customer Centricity
* Results Orientation
* Team Leadership \& Development
* Attention to Detail
* Collaboration \& Cultural Alignment
* Strong Interpersonal Skills


**About Malomatia**
**ABOUT US**
 malomatia is a leading Qatar\-based IT services and solutions provider, bringing together top Qatari and international talent to deliver innovative, end\-to\-end technology solutions that empower clients to achieve their strategic goals.
   

  

**Our mission**
 Empowering Qatar’s businesses and governments to leap into the digital future with agile, knowledge\-driven solutions.
   

  

**Our vision**
 To become Qatar’s trusted knowledge partner in digital transformation, disrupting industries, shaping the future, and building a world\-class tech ecosystem.
   

  

**Driving change that makes a real impact**
 Since 2008, malomatia has been driving Qatar’s digital transformation through innovative, ISO\-certified IT solutions. With expertise across key public and private sectors, we empower the nation’s vision with advanced services in cloud, cybersecurity, AI, and contact center excellence, elevating the role of technology in shaping Qatar’s sustainable future.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Established in 2008, malomatia is a Qatari leader in IT services and digital transformation. We serve key sectors including Government, Healthcare, Education, Customs, and Transportation, delivering impactful solutions that support national development goals. Powered by a diverse team of skilled Qatari and international IT professionals, we deliver innovative, high\-value digital solutions tailored to the unique needs of our clients.
   

  

 Our mission is to inspire customers to thrive through digital excellence, and we envision becoming the trusted partner of choice in building a smarter society through technology and talent. We are driven by core values that define our culture and approach: ownership, integrity, empathy, teamwork, transparency, agility, excellence, trust, and innovation.
   

  

 Join us in shaping the future of technology in Qatar

**Description**
*Position at Al Jazeera Media Network*
**Head of Media Institute Operations** 
 will lead the AJMI Operations section within Network Operations, overseeing the operational, technical, and facility support services required for the successful delivery of Al Jazeera Media Institute training programmes, workshops, conferences, events, and media development initiatives.
   

  

 This position reports directly to the Director of Network Operations and is responsible for the strategic leadership and operational management of the institutes technical and operational functions. The role ensures the effective planning, delivery, and continuous improvement of operational services, technical support, facilities management, resource planning, and training operations.
   

  

 As the Head of Media Institutes Operations you will be accountable for maintaining a high\-performing operational environment that enables the successful delivery of learning programmes, practical training, live productions, and special events, while ensuring operational excellence, service quality, compliance, and the efficient utilisation of people, facilities, and technical resources.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead and manage the day\-to\-day operations of AJMI training facilities, studios, control rooms, editing suites, classrooms, theatres, and learning environments.
* Ensure operational readiness and availability of technical systems, production facilities, training equipment, audiovisual systems, and event infrastructure.
* Coordinate operational and technical support for media training programmes, workshops, practical exercises, simulations, and hands\-on learning activities.
* Support the delivery of training programmes covering television production, directing, journalism, camera operations, lighting, sound, editing, digital media, and related media disciplines.
* Oversee operational support for conferences, seminars, forums, workshops, media summits, and special events hosted by AJMI.
* Manage facility bookings, resource scheduling, and utilization planning to support training and operational requirements.
* Coordinate technical support for live demonstrations, training productions, remote learning activities, and media development programmes.
* Ensure effective operation and readiness of theatre facilities, video wall systems, presentation technologies, production equipment, and training platforms.
* Coordinate with Engineering and Technology teams regarding maintenance, upgrades, lifecycle planning, fault resolution, and technical support activities.
* Maintain operational documentation, equipment inventories, asset records, and facility utilization reports.
* Identify and implement operational improvements that enhance training delivery support, service quality, resource utilization, and facility effectiveness.
* Prepare operational performance, utilization, and service reports for management review.


**Other Responsibilities**
* Support strategic development initiatives and future expansion of AJMI facilities and services.
* Participate in planning and delivery of major AJMI events, conferences, and special projects.
* Contribute to technology evaluation, operational improvement, and service enhancement initiatives.
* Support budgeting, procurement, and resource planning activities.


**Education**
* Bachelor Degree in Media, Communications, Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, Data Analytics, or related field. Postgraduate qualifications in a related field are preferred.


**Experience**
* Minimum 10 years of professional experience in broadcast operations, media production support, training facilities management, technical operations, event operations, or related environments.
* Minimum 3 years should have been in a leadership, standards, or supervisory role.

data.jd_text:
**About Kotinos** 




 Kotinos is a sports advisory and representation firm based in Doha, working with athletes, institutions, events, and sports\-related products across the region and internationally. We operate across athlete representation, sports marketing, consulting, events, research, and data, with a focus on building commercially successful and strategically positioned sports properties.
 



  





 Kotinos is entering an exciting phase of growth. We are expanding our commercial portfolio, building new sports properties, and creating partnership opportunities for ambitious brands that want to connect with sport, culture, talent, communities, and major moments across Qatar, the GCC/MENA region, and international markets. We are looking for a senior commercial leader who can help shape this next chapter.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 The Director \- Sponsorship \& Brand Partnerships will lead sponsorship sales and brand partnership development across Kotinos’ athlete portfolio, events, and company\-led sports products.
 



  





 This is a senior revenue\-generating role for a proven commercial closer. The successful candidate will bring a strong personal network of brand, agency, and corporate decision\-makers across Qatar, the wider GCC/MENA region, particularly KSA and UAE, and international markets. The Director will act as Kotinos’ senior commercial lead for sponsorship and brand partnerships. They will work closely with the internal team to refine sponsorship assets, shape compelling commercial propositions, approach the market, lead pitch conversations, negotiate terms, close deals, and help build a structured, repeatable sponsorship sales engine.
 



  





 This is an opportunity for someone who wants to do more than sell existing inventory. The role requires someone who can help build the commercial future of Kotinos: creating new opportunities, developing relationships with leading brands, supporting athletes and events, building the sponsorship function, and contributing to the wider growth of the organization.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Commercial Leadership \& Revenue Generation** 



* Lead Kotinos’ sponsorship and brand partnership revenue across athletes, events, and company\-led sports products.
* Personally originate, pitch, negotiate, and close sponsorship and commercial partnership deals.
* Bring and activate an existing, current, and usable network of brand, agency, and corporate decision\-makers from day one.
* Own opportunities from first conversation through to signed agreement, ensuring strong commercial momentum, clear next steps, and proper handover for delivery.
* Lead negotiations with sponsors and partners, ensuring deals are commercially valuable, deliverable, and aligned with the relevant athlete, event, or product.



  





**Partnership Strategy, Packaging \& Market Positioning** 



* Shape how Kotinos’ athletes, events, and sports products are positioned to brands and commercial partners.
* Work with the internal team to refine sponsorship proposals, pitch decks, pricing, rights packages, and commercial narratives.
* Ensure every commercial proposition is clear, sponsor\-focused, and answers the key questions: why this opportunity, why this brand fit, what value is created, what the sponsor receives, what it costs, and what happens next.
* Translate reach, visibility, engagement, audience data, earned media value, and business outcomes into credible sponsor value.
* Use brand feedback, market insights, and performance data to improve future proposals, pricing, packaging, renewals, and upsell opportunities.



  





**Pipeline, Reporting \& Commercial Discipline** 



* Identify and pursue opportunities across sectors including banking, telecom, airlines, luxury, automotive, FMCG, technology, real estate, tourism, media, entertainment, \& etc.
* Build and manage a structured sponsorship pipeline and CRM discipline across Kotinos.
* Ensure each opportunity has a clear stage, owner, next step, value, probability of closure, and follow\-up date.
* Provide leadership with clear visibility on active opportunities, stalled deals, revenue forecasts, commercial priorities, and key blockers.
* Ensure outreach, follow\-ups, reporting, and internal coordination are consistent, professional, and commercially focused.
* Build a more disciplined, scalable, and repeatable approach to sponsorship sales and brand partnerships.



  





**Team Building \& Organizational Growth** 



* Help build and develop Kotinos’ sponsorship function.
* Identify the people, capabilities, tools, and processes required to scale the commercial function over time.
* Support the recruitment, onboarding, and development of future team members within sponsorship sales and partnerships.
* Mentor and guide junior or supporting team members involved in research, proposals, outreach, account management, and partnership delivery.
* Work collaboratively across Kotinos to connect opportunities with the company’s wider ambitions.



  





**Candidate Profile** 



* The ideal candidate is a senior commercial partnerships professional with at least 10 years of experience in sponsorship sales, brand partnerships, commercial rights, media sales, sports business, events, entertainment, or related sectors.
* They are a proven closer, not only a strategist or relationship manager. They are comfortable personally contacting brands, leading pitch meetings, negotiating commercial terms, and being directly accountable for revenue.
* The successful candidate must bring an existing and up\-to\-date contact base of relevant brand, agency, and corporate decision\-makers that can be activated immediately after joining. This is a core requirement of the role.
* They should also have the commercial discipline to professionalize the sponsorship sales process, including pipeline tracking, follow\-up cadence, brand feedback capture, proposal improvement, and commercial reporting.
* We are looking for someone entrepreneurial, ambitious, and hands\-on; someone who is excited by the opportunity to build, sell, lead, and grow with Kotinos.



  





**Required Experience** 



* Minimum 10 years of relevant commercial experience.
* Proven track record of closing sponsorship, partnership, media, event, entertainment, or brand deals.
* Strong existing and active network of senior brand, agency, and corporate decision\-makers across Qatar, GCC/MENA, and international markets.
* Strong understanding of sponsorship sales, brand objectives, rights packaging, commercial storytelling, and partnership ROI.
* Experience building or managing a sponsorship sales pipeline, CRM, or structured commercial reporting process.
* Experience working with athletes, sports properties, events, media platforms, entertainment assets, or brand\-facing partnership environments is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated ability to manage a sales pipeline and report clearly on commercial progress.
* Ability to communicate, pitch, and negotiate fluently in Arabic and English.



  





**Location** 




 The role is based in Doha, Qatar, with expected travel across the GCC/MENA region and potentially internationally for brand, partner, and event meetings.
 



  





**Compensation** 




 The role will include a fixed salary and performance\-based commission linked to closed sponsorship and partnership revenue.

**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The incumbent will be responsible for supporting department in the implementation of Portfolio Risk Appetite framework at Group, Region, Country and various Portfolio levels, monitoring of Risk Appetite and Portfolio performance against Risk appetite metrics as well as taking Risk mitigating actions, ensuring underlying data and reporting processes are effective and accurate, recommending portfolio optimisation by facilitating economic capital Risk contribution concept and portfolio correlations, contributing to portfolio Risk project activities, embedding business objectives ascertaining Risk Appetite and tolerance as they relate to future strategy of the Bank, taking into account the Board’s overall degree of Risk aversion, current financial situation, and external market factors.
   

  

**Therefore, Experience In The Following Key Points Is Essential**
* Credit Risk Models
* Portfolio Monitoring
* RAROC (Risk\-Adjusted Return on Capital)
* Data Analysis and Problem Solving


 Main Responsibilities

 Bring insightful judgment in the interpretation of Risk information and its impact on the business model of the
   

  

 Bank.
   

  

 Management of fundamental prudential Risks of the Bank’s credit Risk
   

  

 Support in the oversight and formulation of advice to the Senior Management on the current Risk exposures of
   

  

 the Bank and future Risk strategy with due consideration to the current and prospective macroeconomic and
   

  

 financial environment.
   

  

 Continuously rate / highlight the high Risk sectors/ industries/ customer segments and take adequate and timely
   

  

 mitigating actions / recommendations to reduce, diversify, shifting of these Risks.
   

  

 Assess independently from business line executives, and with due regard to materiality, whether a proposed
   

  

 product launch or the pricing of Risk in particular transactions is consistent with the Risk tolerance determined by
   

  

 the Senior Management.
   

  

 Implements KPI’s and best practices for Portfolio Risk Performance.
   

  

 Promote cost consciousness and efficiency and enhance productivity, to minimise cost, avoid waste, and optimise
   

  

 benefits for the bank.
   

  

 Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent.
   

  

* Customer (Internal \& External): \- \- \- \- \-


 Coordinate with Compliance to obtain updates on regulatory changes pertaining to Risk to assess their impact on
   

  

 the Group’s different portfolio Risk profiles.
   

  

 To assist customers in all their queries on Bank’s product and seek solution to their requests.
   

  

 Maintain activities in accordance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/units to achieve
   

  

 improvements in turn\-around time.
   

  

 Build and maintain strong/effective relationships with related departments/units to achieve the Group’s objectives.
   

  

 Provide timely/accurate data to external/internal Auditors, Compliance, Financial Control and Risk when required.
   

  

* Internal (Processes, Products, Regulatory): \- \- \- \- \-


 Review and propose necessary changes to the existing portfolio management techniques and procedures for the
   

  

 domestic and overseas business in light of changing market conditions based on Basel Committee
   

  

 recommendations/ other best practices and QCB or any host regulator regulations and guidelines to ensure that a
   

  

 sound environment for identifying, assessing, measuring, monitoring and controlling Risk is in place.
   

  

 Introduce a mechanism for periodic reporting of the Group’s portfolio quality trends to the relevant management
   

  

 levels.
   

  

 In coordination with Credit, and other division heads, oversee the establishment of a portfolio limits structure
   

  

 (sector, industry, product, currency, country, region etc.) for the Group for approvals and for managing the Risk
   

  

 concentrations.
   

  

 In coordination with different bodies in the Bank ensure availability of the necessary tools, systems, and MI reports
   

  

 adequate for monitoring of limits that relate to borrowers, counterparties, cross\-border Group entities and more
   

  

 specifically excess over limit, past due loans, expired facilities, classification of advances per credit rating criteria,
   

  

 related party exposure and credit concentration, .
   

  

 Assist in identifying undue Credit Risk concentrations and in implementing new Portfolio Credit Risk Management
   

  

 technologies. Reviews credit concentrations by asset segmentation in terms of credit facilities, industry sectors,
   

  

 past due ageing and collateral coverages,
   

  

* Learning \& Knowledge: \- Possess superior knowledge of portfolio credit Risk Management best practices including but not limited to


 pertinent Basel II \& Basel III Framework. \- Proactively identify areas for professional development of self and undertake development activities. \- Seek out opportunities to remain current with all developments in professional field.
   

  

* Legal, Regulatory, and Risk Framework Responsibilities: \- Comply with all applicable legal, regulatory and internal compliance requirements including, but not limited to,


 Group Compliance Policies and Procedures (AML \& CTF, Sanctions Policy, Data Protection Policy, Fraud Control

 monitor, manage and report risks. \- Ensure systematic good outcomes for clients in accordance with Conduct Risk policy. \- Support the framework of RCSA, KRI, Incident reporting and remediation, as appropriate, in accordance with the
   

  

 Operational Risk Management requirements. \- Maintain appropriate knowledge to ensure full qualification to undertake the role. \- Complete all mandatory training provided by the Bank, attain, and maintain the required levels of competence. \- Attend mandatory (internal and external) seminars as instructed by the Bank.
   

  

* Other: \- Ensure high standards of data protection and confidentiality to safeguard commercially sensitive information. \- Maintaining utmost confidentiality concerning customer and internal bank information obtained during the course


 of business and provide such information on a need to know basis only to Senior Management of QNB, Audit and

data.jd_text:
**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The incumbent will be responsible for proactively managing QNB Group’s selected Corporate Banking portfolio, Branches and affiliates (the “Selected Portfolio”) in order to achieve the function’s set targets for revenue, profit, profitability and volumes, in compliance with established QNB Group credit policies, procedures, standards, regulatory requirements and best international market practice.
   

  

 The individual will also be involved in the formulation of corporate branch strategies and the implementation of the GCIB initiatives (including GWB and GAM) across his portfolio. As well as, identify potential new business opportunities for other business area functions or branches within the QNB Group, aligned to the approved Global Account Management concept and co\-ordinate with them to facilitate Group synergies and cross selling of products and services. To improve QNB’s profitability, revenue generation as well as service and delivery enhancement, in order to ensure that clients banking’ needs are comprehensively identified and efficiently met, within the QNB Group, on a priority basis.
   

  

 Main Responsibilities
   

  

* Ensure implementation of the strategies and plans to achieve all volume, revenue, and profit targets for the Selected Portfolio function.
* Support the EVP International Corporate in the development of Key Performance Indicators for the systematic performance monitoring, quality measurement and performance evaluation of the Selected Portfolio function
* Meet target budgets for Selected Portfolio’s client relationships comprising assets and liability product sales and profits for the Selected Portfolio function, in accordance with QNB’s overall corporate budget and strategy.
* Coordinate periodically between Selected Portfolio, Group’s corporate branches network and subsidiaries to review financial performance and ensure achievement of budget and financial objectives
* Implements KPI’s and best practices for International Corporate Relationship Management.
* Promote cost consciousness and efficiency and enhance productivity, to minimise cost, avoid waste, and optimise benefits for the bank.
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent and delegate authority to the respective staff and monitor exercise of the same.
* Demonstrate clear understanding of the important factors behind the bank's financial \& non\-financial performance.
* Coordinate and liaise activities with international and regional Branches, Retail, Treasury and Head Office support functions including but not limited to GSF and GTB, QNB Capital and QNBFS (“QNB Functions”) to provide support and cross selling opportunities intra QNB Group departments, units and functions.
* Ensure provision of a focal ‘one point of contact’ to Selected Portfolio of clients and ensure superior customer service and a customer friendly approach to proactively meet their needs and resolve their queries.
* Assist customers in all their queries on Bank’s product and seek solution to their requests.
* Maintain, develop and enhance core bank relationships with the existing clients as well as identify, market and build effective new bank relationships.
* Maintain activities in accordance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/units to achieve improvements in turn\-around time.
* Build and maintain strong and effective relationships with QNB Functions in order to achieve the QNB Group’s goals and objectives, including cross\-selling targets.
* Provide timely and accurate information to the external and internal auditors and the Group’s compliance function when required.
* Implement the approved corporate banking strategy within the function to achieve and exceed the business objectives.
* Maintain, conduct and ensure that activities of the Selected Portfolio comply with regulatory policies and procedures and best market practice.
* Manage, coach and motivate the team of Selected Portfolio’s VPs, AVPs, Managers and Associates to maintain and improve service quality and ensure that the Selected Portfolio meets their set financial and non\-financial targets.
* Continuously monitor, manage and evaluate the Selected Portfolio credit profile to ensure targets are met and any necessary corrective measures are implemented on a timely basis, as required. The portfolio should be managed in accordance within the Bank’s prescribed risk management parameters.
* Review, conduct due diligence and credit assessment, and recommend approval of credit proposals to the relevant approving authority.
* Ensure each VP International Corporate Relationship management has a balanced portfolio and continuously monitor to ensure that each portfolio is destined to achieve its set target and, if appropriate, take corrective action to redirect portfolio management if there is insufficient progress towards the achievement of its set target.
* Provide technical expertise and guidance to Selected Portfolio’s VPs and AVPs to ensure their credit proposals adequately address all relevant risk factors and meet minimum acceptable standards.
* Monitor / develop the Selected Portfolio function’s database ensuring that function personnel perform sales activity in accordance with incumbent’s directives and timely update the database of client contacts.
* Perform / assign function personnel to systematically visit client premises, conduct meetings and prepare / deliver presentations.
* Ensure that all requisite facility and account documentation are collected by function personnel and are timely transferred for credit review and safe custody.
* Ensure all necessary procedures are in place to identify and timely report any customer related negative developments and early signals regarding potentially problematic accounts / relationships and ensure that suitable remedial action is taken by function personnel.
* Ensure that function’s personnel perform cross selling activities to enhance QNB’s overall relationship with customers by coordinating activities with QNB Functions.
* Supervise the roll\-out of conventional corporate banking products targeted to Selected Portfolio clients.
* Develop and maintain professional relationships with key managers of existing and potential clients to provide a broader range of communication, service consistency and proactive response to client’s needs.
* Work in liaison with Group Communications and the Marketing \& Product Management Unit to devise Selected Portfolio specific marketing strategies, client target lists etc. to defend and increase QNB’s current market share.
* Track and report on transaction volumes, budget performance and client\-wise overall portfolio profitability and periodically report to EVP International Corporate and to other executive management of the Group to assess the performance of the Selected Portfolio customer base, as requested.
* Recommend all administrative operational aspects of unit personnel (e.g. leave schedule, training, appraisal etc.) in accordance with established HR policies and procedures.
* Oversee recruitment, provide motivation, guidance to employees and reinforce high standards concerning performance, and adherence to the Bank’s values and mission.
* Encourage, solicit and reward innovative ideas even in day\-to\-day issues.
* Continuous Improvement:
* Set examples by leading improvement initiatives through cross\-functional teams ensuring successes.
* Identify and encourage people to adopt practices better than the industry standard.
* Continuously encourage and recognize the importance of thinking out\-of\-the\-box within the team.


**Education And Experience Requirements**
* University graduate preferably with a Major in in the banking industry, preferably with local / gulf / regional responsibility (dependent on the portfolio coverage) experience. Masters preferred
* At least 15 years’ experience of relevant experience, preferably within a highly rated international bank
* Well\-informed of the market competitive structures, industry practices and any regulations relevant to regional and International Corporate clients segment.
* Informed of the market competitive structure, industry practices and compliance and regulatory requirements of Selected Portfolio countries.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills (including report writing) in English and Arabic.
* Excellent people relationship skills and awareness of risk management concept and practices.
* Understanding of the relevant laws, regulations and practices pertaining to Corporate Banking products.
* Ability to make decisions and follow through with initiatives.
* Personal integrity and self\-management.
* Planning, organizing, and analytical ability.
* Results oriented.
* Ability to motivate and lead teams from diverse cultural backgrounds.
* Familiar with the balanced scorecard approach.
* Strong customer service orientation.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to communicate both verbally and in writing with all levels of management.


 Note: you will be required to attach the following:
   

  

* Resume/CV
* Copy of Passport or QID
* Copy of Education Certificate

data.jd_text:
Chief Investment Officer (Confidential)
 



**Location:** 
 Doha, Qatar
 



  





 The Opportunity
 



 We are conducting a confidential search for an exceptional Chief Investment Officer to lead the investment strategy, investment platform, product innovation, and capital markets activities of a rapidly growing investment business.
 



  





 This is not a traditional portfolio management role.
 



 The successful candidate will combine institutional investment expertise with commercial leadership, bringing the ability to design investment products, originate investment opportunities, raise institutional capital, and build scalable investment platforms serving sovereign wealth funds, institutional investors, family offices and high\-net\-worth clients.
 



 The CIO will play a central role in shaping the firm's future investment strategy while partnering closely with Executive Management and the Board to drive long\-term growth.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Investment Strategy \& Portfolio Leadership
* Develop and execute the firm's investment strategy across public and private markets.
* Lead strategic asset allocation and portfolio construction across multiple asset classes.
* Provide investment recommendations to Executive Management, Investment Committee and Board.



  





 Develop investment policies, governance frameworks and portfolio risk management processes.
 



 Monitor macroeconomic developments, capital markets and emerging investment opportunities globally.
 



  





 Investment Platform \& Product Development
 



 Lead the development, structuring and launch of institutional investment products.
 



 Design and oversee:
 


* Listed investment funds
* Private investment funds
* Alternative investment funds
* SMAs
* Co\-investment platforms
* Structured products
* Bespoke institutional mandates
* Work closely with Legal, Compliance, Operations, Finance and Distribution to successfully commercialize investment solutions.
* Develop differentiated investment propositions for institutional investors, sovereign wealth funds, pension funds, insurers, family offices and UHNW clients.
* Partner with distribution teams to support fundraising initiatives, investor presentations and product positioning.



  





 Investment Origination \& Transaction Execution
 



 Lead the sourcing and execution of investment opportunities across multiple asset classes
 



  





 Oversee:
 


* Financial modelling
* Valuation
* Commercial analysis
* Due diligence
* Investment Committee papers
* Transaction structuring
* Negotiations
* Execution



  





 Coordinate external advisors including investment banks, legal counsel, consultants and placement agents.
 



  





 Institutional Capital \& Commercial Leadership
 



 Develop long\-term relationships with:
 


* Sovereign Wealth Funds
* Pension Funds
* Insurance Companies
* Family Offices
* Institutional Asset Managers
* Banks
* Development Finance Institutions
* Strategic Partners



  





 Support capital raising initiatives through strong institutional engagement.
 



 Represent the firm with investors, regulators and industry stakeholders.
 



 Identify strategic partnerships and new business opportunities that strengthen the investment platform.
 



  





 Leadership
 


* Build and lead a high\-performing investment organization.
* Develop investment professionals across research, portfolio management, product development and investment execution.
* Promote a culture of disciplined investment decision\-making, innovation, collaboration and commercial excellence.
* Serve as the principal investment adviser to Executive Management and the Board.



  





 Candidate Profile
 



 The successful candidate will demonstrate experience across most of the following areas:
 



 Investment Leadership
 


* Leading multi\-asset investment strategies
* Strategic and tactical asset allocation
* Investment Committee leadership
* Portfolio construction
* Investment governance
* Risk management



  





 Listed Funds
 


* Demonstrated experience managing, overseeing or launching listed investment funds or publicly traded investment vehicles.
* Investment Product Development
* Hands\-on experience designing, structuring and launching investment products including institutional funds, alternative investment vehicles, SMAs, structured products or bespoke client mandates.



  





 Asset Class Experience
 



 Strong experience across several of the following:
 


* Public Equities
* Fixed Income
* Private Equity
* Private Credit
* Infrastructure
* Real Estate
* Venture Capital
* Structured Products
* Hedge Funds
* Alternatives
* Multi\-Asset Portfolios



  





 Breadth of experience across multiple asset classes is considered highly desirable.
 



 Sector Experience
 



  





 Experience investing across multiple sectors including, but not limited to:
 


* Financial Services
* Infrastructure
* Energy
* Industrials
* Technology
* Healthcare
* Consumer
* Real Estate
* Aviation
* Logistics
* Telecommunications



  





 Candidates with broad cross\-sector investment experience will be preferred.
 



  





 Commercial Capability
 



 The ideal candidate will demonstrate the ability to combine investment excellence with commercial execution through:
 


* Investment origination
* Product commercialization
* Institutional fundraising
* Client engagement
* Strategic partnerships
* Business development



  





 Candidates coming from primarily buy\-side backgrounds should be able to demonstrate why their experience equips them to successfully lead a commercially focused investment platform with strong institutional client engagement and product development responsibilities.
 



  





 Qualifications
 


* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business or related discipline
* MBA or Master's degree preferred
* CFA, CAIA or equivalent professional qualification highly desirable
* 15\+ years of relevant investment experience
* Proven experience in institutional investment management, investment banking, capital markets, private markets or alternative investments
* Experience presenting to Boards and Investment Committees
* Strong institutional network across global investors



  





 Critical Competencies
 


* Multi\-Asset Investment Strategy
* Investment Product Innovation
* Listed \& Private Fund Management
* Capital Markets
* Investment Banking
* Institutional Capital Raising
* Investment Origination
* Portfolio Construction
* Financial Modelling
* Transaction Structuring
* Investment Governance
* Commercial Leadership
* Institutional Relationship Management
* Team Leadership



  





 Ideal Background
 



 Candidates are likely to come from positions such as:
 


* Chief Investment Officer
* Deputy Chief Investment Officer
* Global Head of Investment Solutions
* Global Head of Multi\-Asset
* Managing Director – Investment Banking
* Managing Director – Capital Markets
* Managing Director – Infrastructure \& Real Assets
* Head of Institutional Investments
* Head of Alternatives
* Head of Product \& Investment Solutions
* Head of Private Markets
* Head of Asset Management
* Senior Portfolio Manager (Institutional)
* Head of Investment Products
* Partner – Private Equity or Infrastructure
* Managing Director – Structured Finance
* Head of Institutional Capital Markets



  





 What We Will Be Looking For
 



 During the selection process, candidates will be expected to demonstrate:
 


* Experience managing or overseeing listed investment funds.
* A proven track record in designing and launching investment products.
* Breadth of investment experience across multiple asset classes.
* Cross\-sector investment expertise.
* The ability to transition investment expertise into a commercially driven investment platform focused on institutional clients, product innovation, and capital formation.

**If you’re looking to unlock new job opportunities, take a look at the possibilities right on your doorstep here at HSBC.**
 HSBC Corporate Banking provides international financial services solutions that support businesses ranging from large corporates to mid\-market enterprises in a variety of industry sectors all over the world. Leveraging the strength, scope and expertise of our global product network, Corporate Banking is positioned as an essential partner to large and mid\-market enterprises seeking to maximise their potential internationally, offering streamlined business access to HSBC’s international network and broad range of market leading banking products and services.
   

  

**The Role**
 HSBC’s Corporate \& Institutional Banking (CIB) – International Mid\-Market (IMM) team in Qatar is looking for a high\-performing Relationship Director to manage and grow a portfolio of internationally minded Corporates and with revenues from $100m to over $2bn.
   

  

 You’ll act as a trusted advisor to clients with cross\-border ambitions, connecting them to HSBC’s international network and full suite of corporate banking solutions.
   

  

**In This Role You’ll Be Responsible For**
* Growing and deepening client relationships
+ Expand existing IMM relationships and originate new\-to\-bank opportunities aligned to HSBC’s international strategy.

* Be a strategic advisor
+ Provide consultative insights to help clients navigate complex cross\-border and global market dynamics.

* Own the client experience
+ Deliver best\-in\-class service and act as a senior escalation point for client needs.

* Drive sustainable revenue growth
+ Partner with product specialists (e.g., Treasury \& Cash Management, Trade, FX, Lending/Debt solutions) and colleagues across HSBC’s global network to increase HSBC’s share of the client’s global wallet.

* Lead credit and risk discipline
+ Credit assessment, deal structuring, approvals support, and ongoing monitoring across the portfolio.

* Manage operational, regulatory and financial crime risk
+ Ensure adherence to internal controls, policies, and external regulations.

* Build networks and market profile
+ Strengthen internal connectivity and enhance HSBC’s presence in the local business community and with professional intermediaries.


**What You’ll Need (minimum Requirements)**
* Bachelor’s degree is required to obtain a work permit.
* 10\+ years’ experience in Corporate/Commercial Banking or Financial Services with relationship management accountability.
* Strong knowledge of corporate banking products: cash management, trade, FX, lending/structured solutions.
* Solid credit and lending experience, including complex facilities and risk assessment.
* Strong stakeholder management and ability to collaborate across product and risk teams.
* Exceptional communication and influencing skills.
* Client\-centric mindset, commercial acumen, and ability to deliver in a fast\-moving environment.


 For further details and application information please visit our careers site.
   

  

 We support our staff to adopt flexible and alternative ways of working where possible, including working from home and different hours subject to approvals.
   

  

 HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working, and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make an outstanding addition to our vibrant international team.
   

  

 Siemens Digital Industries is a leading innovator in automation and digitalization. Our mission is to support customers in maximizing growth, profit opportunities and ecological footprint in the discrete and process industries. Ready to create your own journey?
   

  

 Join our Digital Industry as Senior Project Manager and help us transform the everyday by finding solutions and making the world a more inquisitive place for tomorrow.
   

  

**You‘ll make an impact by:**
* Managing customer projects end\-to\-end across the full project lifecycle, from handover through final acceptance, with responsibility for cost, schedule, quality, EHS and customer satisfaction.
* Actively steering project planning, execution, monitoring and control in line with PM@Siemens standards.
* Managing risks, opportunities, changes and claims, including identification of mitigations and commercial impacts.
* Coordinating cross\-functional and cross\-regional project teams, including engineering centers, partners and subcontractors.
* Supporting proposal, contract clarification and customer discussions by contributing project execution know\-how and solution understanding.


**Your success is grounded in**
* 10\+ years of experience in solution or automation project execution, with several years acting as fully accountable Project Manager for medium to large, cross\-organizational projects.
* Strong mastery of project management across the full lifecycle, including project planning, scheduling, cost control, forecasting, reporting, and governance according to PM@Siemens standards.
* Proven competence in risk and opportunity management, change management, claim management, and contract interpretation, including identification of commercial impacts and mitigation strategies.
* Solid understanding of industrial automation and process control solutions, including Distributed Control Systems (DCS), PLC and HMI\-based systems.
* Hands\-on project exposure to Siemens automation and digitalization products and systems such as SIMATIC PCS 7 (DCS), SIMATIC S7 (PLC), WinCC / HMI systems, and integration of industrial communication technologies.

* Demonstrated ability to manage diverse stakeholders, including customers, internal engineering teams, global engineering centers, suppliers, and partners, without direct line management responsibility.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical solutions and Siemens capabilities clearly to customers.
* High level of intercultural competence and experience working in international, virtual, and cross\-regional project environments.
* Fluency in English for professional project communication; ability to operate confidently in customer meetings, reviews, and negotiations.


**Transform the everyday with us**
 We value your outstanding identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.

**About the role:** 




  





 The Technical Manager leads the multidisciplinary technical function of the project, ensuring that engineering, architectural, structural and MEP works are reviewed, coordinated and executed in accordance with the Contract Documents, project specifications, applicable codes and the original design intent.
 



 The role requires sound engineering judgment to evaluate contractor proposals, resolve multidisciplinary technical issues, manage design changes and technical risks, and provide clear engineering recommendations to the Project Director, Employer and Engineer throughout the project lifecycle.
 



  





**Job Responsibilities:** 




  





 •Lead the technical review of shop drawings, material submissions, RFIs, engineering calculations, method statements and specialist contractor submissions.
 



 •Review contractor design proposals, value engineering submissions and alternative technical solutions while maintaining compliance with the Contract Documents and design intent.
 



 •Coordinate multidisciplinary reviews involving Architecture, Structure, Civil, Infrastructure, MEP and specialist systems.
 



 •Identify design deficiencies, constructability issues, coordination conflicts and technical risks before implementation.
 



 •Lead technical workshops and resolve interface issues between consultants, contractors, subcontractors and suppliers.
 



 •Review delegated design packages submitted by specialist contractors.
 



 •Assess the impact of design changes on safety, functionality, operation, maintenance, programmer and cost.
 



 •Provide technical guidance to Resident Engineers, discipline engineers and inspectors.
 



 •Coordinate technical matters with the Employer, Engineer, Authorities and Design Office.
 



 •Review temporary works proposals for technical adequacy.
 



 •Ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications and applicable codes.
 



 •Prepare technical reports, engineering assessments and formal correspondence.
 



 •Support the Project Director in resolving complex technical issues.
 



  





**Required Experience:** 




  





 •Minimum 15 years' post\-graduate engineering experience.
 



 •Minimum 8 years in a Technical Manager or Senior Technical Engineer role.
 



 •Experience on large mixed\-use developments, shopping malls, high\-rise buildings, hotels or similar mega projects.
 



 •Demonstrated experience managing multidisciplinary technical reviews during construction.
 



 •Experience coordinating with international consultants, specialist subcontractors and authorities.
 



 •Previous GCC experience, preferably in Saudi Arabia.
 



  





**Education** 




 •Bachelor's Degree in Civil or Architectural Engineering.
 



 •Master's Degree in Engineering or Construction Management is desirable.
 



  





**Certifications** 




 •Membership of the Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE) or an equivalent recognized professional engineering body (e.g., CRPEP for Bahrain).
 



 •Additional professional certifications and continuous professional development are desirable.
 



**Skills** 




 •Strong multidisciplinary engineering knowledge covering Structural, Architectural and MEP systems.
 



 •Thorough understanding of constructability, engineering coordination and building system integration.
 



 •Ability to review engineering calculations and specialist design submissions.
 



 •Sound knowledge of delegated design responsibilities.
 



 •Good understanding of construction methodologies and sequencing.
 



 •Ability to identify technical risks and develop practical engineering solutions.
 



 •Working knowledge of BIM coordination and multidisciplinary model review.
 



 •Excellent technical report writing.

data.jd_text:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 As a Service Project Manager at Siemens Energy, you will be at the forefront of driving impactful projects that enhance our global energy solutions. This role targets experienced project managers with a background in electrical engineering, renewable energy, or mechatronics, who are adept at navigating complex challenges and leading diverse teams. Your work will directly contribute to Siemens Energy’s mission of delivering sustainable energy solutions, fostering innovation, and ensuring compliance with quality standards. Expect a collaborative team culture that values diversity, creativity, and continuous improvement, where your leadership will inspire and empower others to achieve shared goals.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Lead cross\-functional teams across various locations, ensuring effective collaboration and accountability for project outcomes.
* Develop and implement structured communication plans to maintain transparency with stakeholders and facilitate milestone tracking.
* Manage the full project lifecycle, from scope definition to closure, ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
* Utilize Siemens Energy tools and digital platforms for data\-driven decision\-making, process optimization, and comprehensive reporting.
* Drive change through coaching and mentoring, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement within the team.
* Proactively identify and mitigate risks using procurement plans and responsibility matrices, ensuring project health and compliance.


**What You Bring**
* A Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, mechatronics, or a related field, with specialization or certification in project management (IPMA\-C or PMP is a plus).
* 5 to 10 years of experience in project management or team leadership, with a proven track record of managing complex projects in a multinational and multicultural environment.
* Strong documentation skills for project reporting, milestone tracking, and stakeholder communication, with familiarity in audit processes and quality gates (QMiP, FAC, etc.).
* Proficiency in project lifecycle management, budgeting, risk analysis, and contract handling using Siemens Energy standards and tools.
* Excellent interpersonal skills for managing relationships, resolving conflicts, and communicating effectively with diverse stakeholders.
* Initiative, adaptability, and ownership in achieving project outcomes under dynamic conditions, with a focus on innovation and analytical thinking.


**About The Team**
 Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
   

  

 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
   

  

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
   

  

**Rewards/Benefits**
* Opportunities to work with a global team
* Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects
* Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens\-Energy platform


 https://jobs.siemens\-energy.com/jobs
   

  

 The job posting will remain open for applications for 14 days from the posting date.

We deliver only the best, so we are always in search of the best people to join our ever\-growing talent team.
   

  

 This role combines strategic leadership, operational management, and regulatory accountability, with overall responsibility for ensuring the entity operates in compliance with the CBB Rulebook, the CBB Law, and all applicable Bahraini legislation.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Contribute to the development and execution of the Company’s business strategy and objectives.
* Oversee day\-to\-day operations and ensure efficient business performance.
* Monitor business activities, financial performance, and budgeting processes.
* Promote and maintain a strong culture of compliance and risk awareness.
* Ensure adherence to all applicable regulatory requirements, internal policies, and industry standards.
* Act as a key point of contact with relevant regulatory authorities and ensure timely and accurate reporting.
* Collaborate with internal control functions, including audit and risk, to ensure robust governance and oversight.
* Build and maintain relationships with external partners, vendors, and stakeholders.
* Oversee outsourcing arrangements and ensure appropriate controls are in place.
* Identify potential risks and implement mitigation strategies and action plans.
* Prepare regular reports for senior stakeholders, including the Board and shareholders.
* Stay informed on regulatory developments and industry best practices, assessing business impact where necessary.
* Lead and support a team of professionals across business functions.


**Requirements:**
* An academic degree at bachelor’s level or above; MBA or postgraduate qualification considered an advantage.
* A minimum of 7 to 10 years in investment business, capital markets, brokerage, or related financial services, of which at least 5 years at senior management level.
* A good understanding of the markets, including OTC derivatives (such as CFDs and Knock\-Out Options), equities, and the broader investment services landscape.
* Track record of leading an organisation or business unit with significant financial and operational responsibilities.
* Ability to build and maintain relationships with regulators, investors, clients, and other key stakeholders.
* Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to manage relationships across shareholders, regulators, and clients, and to build strategic alliances and partnerships.
* High\-level awareness of corporate governance, risk management practices, and the regulatory obligations.
* Must satisfy the regulator’s fit and proper requirements, including competence, integrity, and financial soundness.
* Must not be employed at any other firm. Any external non\-executive positions must be disclosed and assessed for compatibility with full\-time commitment and conflict of interest obligations.
* Strong leadership and team management capabilities.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience driving business growth and achieving KPIs.
* High level of accountability, initiative, and collaboration.
* Fluency in English.


 Be a key player at the forefront of the digital assets movement, propelling your career to new heights!
   

  

 Join a dynamic and rapidly expanding company that values and rewards talent, initiative, and creativity.
   

  

 Work alongside one of the most brilliant teams in the industry.
